rows.gacha|des|32001:
In general, the base rate is applied to all Pactspirits. For Rate Up and Minimum Guarantee, the rates are subject to actual rules.
[Boon Rules]
The base rate of acquiring a Legendary Pactspirits is 1.500%. If you fail to obtain any Legendary Pactspirit after 50 Boons, the next Boon's rate of yielding a Legendary Pactspirit will be increased from 1.500% to 3.000%, and if this Boon doesn't yield a Legendary Pactspirit either, then the chance of obtaining a Legendary Pactspirit with the next Boon will be increased from 3.000% to 4.500%. This process repeats itself with a 1.500% rate increase for every Boon until the rate of acquiring a Legendary Pactspirit reaches 100.000%. Once a Legendary Pactspirit is obtained, the next Boon's chance will be reset to the base rate.

For every 10 Boons, at least 1 Pactspirit that is Rare or better is guaranteed.

[Rate Ups]
When the PYO (Pick-Your-Own) feature is enabled, you can pick a designated amount of Pactspirits in the Pactspirit List to get a 25.000% chance to obtain the Pactspirits you picked (if you picked multiple Pactspirits, they will share the chance equally). If that doesn't get you a Pactspirit you picked after getting 3 Legendary Pactspirits, the next Legendary Pactspirit you get from Boons is guaranteed to be a Pactspirit you picked. The count will be reset once a Pactspirit you picked is obtained.

[Duplicate Pactspirits]
When you receive Duplicate Pactspirits, they will be converted into a certain amount of Pactspirit Proofs. Surplus Proofs can be traded for Insight Essence at the in-game shop

[Boon Item List]
Legendary Pactspirits Base Rate: 1.500%
Rare Pactspirits Base Rate: 12.000%. When obtaining a Rare Pactspirit, there is a 30% chance it will be Ball of Thread - Gold Leaf
Magic Pactspirits Base Rate: 86.500%. When obtaining a Magic Pactspirit, there is a 30% chance it will be Happy Chonky - Emerald
The Legendary Pactspirit Starfish Chanter will only appear in this Boon and will not be available in any other Boon. The season-exclusive gameplay of the season-exclusive Pactspirit will be added to the Season Rotation Pool once the season comes to an end. And the chances of that season-exclusive gameplay appearing in the next season will be reduced. The exclusive Pactspirit is only available in the current pool.
The exclusive Pactspirit's effects remain valid permanently.

rows.season|season_des|1351:
Season Background
A strange disease called Vorax has infected the monsters of Leptis!
Once infected, they turn crimson and enter a state of extreme hyperactivity and frenzy. They even devour each other, absorbing the endlessly multiplying diseased tissue within their bodies to evolve into more powerful and grotesque monstrosities.
As the crisis looms, Mad Doctor Shelley's underground clinic officially opens for business!

New Gameplay
This clinic is home to the best Vorax specialist in all of Leptis!
The first stage of treatment is to find suitable patients. Defeat Vorax Elites in Netherrealm stages to collect the Vorax Substance on them. Obtaining sufficiently potent doses of Vorax Substances is the foundation of treatment.
The second stage of treatment is to visit Mad Doctor Shelley's underground clinic to start the Surgical Preparation phase.
Here, Hunters will perform surgeries on Vorax-infected monsters in preparation for further surgeries in different directions based on monsters' diverse racial talents.
During this stage, Hunters can choose freely from dozens of Surgical Instruments and Potions, combining them in various ways to gradually cultivate the ultimate Vorax host.
Each race has extremely rare Special Potions. These Special Potions provide a set of special medications, which increase in potency with each round, until a miraculous Potion with super high Ultimate Activity is created.
The surgery officially begins in the third stage of treatment!
Hunters will now have to dispose of the powerful monsters they just created.
Defeat them to recover precious Vorax antidotes from their bodies and exchange them for corresponding rewards.
Antidote Vials in the Operating Theater will fill up as more monsters are defeated, and the rewards earned by exchanging them become increasingly better as their potency increases.

New Development System
Grafting lets Hunters craft Vorax Gear-unrestricted by Strength, Intelligence, or Dexterity, with a shared affix pool across different parts, and even capable of holding Legendary affixes.
Use Normal Organs to add Basic or Advanced affixes to Vorax Gear. Use Special Organs to add Ultimate affixes to Vorax Gear. Use Core Organs and Sutures to add Legendary affixes to Vorax Gear.
Vorax Corrosion increases the tier of Vorax Gear affixes, potentially increasing all pre-fixes and suffixes by 1 - 2 tiers.

rows.season|season_des|632:
Season Background
During the distant Epoch of War, a warrior known as Ralph wielded his blade against thousands of formidable foes in the Eternal Coliseum of gold, and he reigned undefeated. Now, the Epoch of War is but a distant memory, yet his brave and fearless spirit still lives on and shines brilliantly like gold, even to this day. O' warrior, defeat the countless enemies roaming the Netherrealm, advance to the Eternal Coliseum's center, and win the unparalleled rewards of the Invincible Champion!

Combat Frenzy
Blessed by the God of War, the rare monsters in the stage have a chance to be upgraded into Gladiator monsters of various tiers. Defeat them to enlarge your physique, or upgrade your Life and Energy Shield to achieve the same effect.
As your Physique grows, your Skill Area increases, and your Minions deal more damage. Rush into a frenzy and grow endlessly stronger!

Precious Drops
All exclusive items' drop rates are tripled during the preseason. Enjoy the feeling of being surrounded by Precious drops!
In addition, Gladiator monsters drop precious Proofs of Champion. Use the Proofs of Champion to enter the Eternal Coliseum, defeat the countless enemies that await there, and claim the almighty commendations of the God of War!

rows.manual_rule_des|des|2002080122:
<RichText>To perform R&D, Hunters must spend a set number of Mods.
Once initiated, each round presents a random selection of colored Chips to choose from. If the selected Chip colors (in any order) match a target sequence, the R&D succeeds, granting the weapon the corresponding effects. If the colors do not match any sequence, the R&D fails.
There are 2 types of R&D: Basic R&D and In-Depth R&D. Basic R&D only requires Hunters to choose 3 Chips, whereas In-Depth R&D requires Hunters to choose 4. Basic R&D only yields Intermediate sequences. Advanced sequences can only be obtained from In-Depth R&D. Each weapon can only have 1 sequence, but Hunters can perform R&D repeatedly until the desired target sequence is obtained.
</>

rows.gacha|des|34001:
In general, the base rate is applied to all Pactspirits. For Rate Up and Minimum Guarantee, the rates are subject to actual rules.
[Boon Rules]
The base rate of acquiring a Legendary Pactspirits is 1.500%. If you fail to obtain any Legendary Pactspirit after 50 Boons, the next Boon's rate of yielding a Legendary Pactspirit will be increased from 1.500% to 3.000%, and if this Boon doesn't yield a Legendary Pactspirit either, then the chance of obtaining a Legendary Pactspirit with the next Boon will be increased from 3.000% to 4.500%. This process repeats itself with a 1.500% rate increase for every Boon until the rate of acquiring a Legendary Pactspirit reaches 100.000%. Once a Legendary Pactspirit is obtained, the next Boon's chance will be reset to the base rate.

For every 10 Boons, at least 1 Pactspirit that is Rare or better is guaranteed.

[Rate Ups]
When the PYO (Pick-Your-Own) feature is enabled, you can pick a designated amount of Pactspirits in the Pactspirit List to get a 25.000% chance to obtain the Pactspirits you picked (if you picked multiple Pactspirits, they will share the chance equally). If that doesn't get you a Pactspirit you picked after getting 3 Legendary Pactspirits, the next Legendary Pactspirit you get from Boons is guaranteed to be a Pactspirit you picked. The count will be reset once a Pactspirit you picked is obtained.

[Duplicate Pactspirits]
When you receive Duplicate Pactspirits, they will be converted into a certain amount of Pactspirit Proofs. Surplus Proofs can be traded for Insight Essence at the in-game shop

[Boon Item List]
Legendary Pactspirits Base Rate: 1.500%
Rare Pactspirits Base Rate: 12.000%. When obtaining a Rare Pactspirit, there is a 30% chance it will be Letice
Magic Pactspirits Base Rate: 86.500%. When obtaining a Magic Pactspirit, there is a 30% chance it will be Shocket
The Legendary Pactspirit Monument Knight will only appear in this Boon and will not be available in any other Boon. The season-exclusive gameplay of the season-exclusive Pactspirit will be added to the Season Rotation Pool once the season comes to an end. And the chances of that season-exclusive gameplay appearing in the next season will be reduced.

rows.season|season_window2|1541:
New Gameplay
Interact with the Nameless Coffins in Netherrealm stages to start the Vigil. Defeat the ceaseless tide of Wraiths and claim generous rewards!
Within the time limit, the faster you defeat Wraiths, the faster they spawn-and the greater your rewards!
Vigil Anomalies and Noble Coffins may appear at random, bringing Anomaly monsters that grant rich rewards, or altering the gameplay rules for additional rewards.

New Development System
Install Nether King's Divinity to enhance the effects of Divinity Slates and harness the mysterious power of Nether King.
rows.collection|unlocked_text|20703:
The Church provides accommodation to those who seek protection out of "goodwill".

Hah, I know them too well. The "goodwill" means a one-off "donation" of 100,000 Tremissis, as well as a monthly fee of 2,000 Imperial Gold per capita to cover daily expenses.

In return, the Church shall provide an absolutely safe environment, including patrolling crusaders and impenetrable defense traps. Out of curiosity, I tried touching the trap-a powerful light Spell immediately pierced through by body. My bones would have been fried if I wasn't wearing that "Portable Ember-Drive Mechanical Armor with Superb Defense".

Just when I cursed the fools who lived here and started to retreat, I heard a clicking sound underneath. Turned out it was an alarm.

Five church members in gray robes immediately appeared and stabbed my beautiful belly with their blades!

Fortunately, my armor worked wonders and they couldn't even land a scratch. But high-concentration Ember was way too expensive, so I quickly left.

What a bloody stupid place!

1. Whenever you are defeated in a Nightmare, you will randomly lose 1/6 of your total Dream Bubbles (rounded down).

2. The portion that has been rounded down will be recorded. Once the total rounded-down portion reaches 1, an additional bubble will be deducted when you are defeated, the remaining rounded-down portion less than one will be recorded, and the process will keep repeating.

3. Bubbles will not be deducted immediately. Instead, all bubble deductions will take effect when settling the successful or unsuccessful escape from the Nightmare.

4. Some Dream Omens can change these basic rules. Refer to the description of specific omen effects.

rows.gacha|des|6003:
In general, the base rate is applied to all Pactspirits. For Rate Up and Minimum Guarantee, the rates are subject to actual rules.
[Boon Rules]
The base rate of acquiring a Legendary Pactspirits is 1.500%. If you fail to obtain any Legendary Pactspirit after 50 Boons, the next Boon's rate of yielding a Legendary Pactspirit will be increased from 1.500% to 3.000%, and if this Boon doesn't yield a Legendary Pactspirit either, then the chance of obtaining a Legendary Pactspirit with the next Boon will be increased from 3.000% to 4.500%. This process repeats itself with a 1.500% rate increase for every Boon until the rate of acquiring a Legendary Pactspirit reaches 100.000%. Once a Legendary Pactspirit is obtained, the next Boon's chance will be reset to the base rate.

For every 10 Boons, at least 1 Pactspirit that is Rare or better is guaranteed.

[Rate Ups]
When the PYO (Pick-Your-Own) feature is enabled, you can pick a designated amount of Pactspirits in the Pactspirit List to get a 50.000% chance to obtain the Pactspirits you picked (if you picked multiple Pactspirits, they will share the chance equally). If that doesn't get you a Pactspirit you picked after getting 1 Legendary Pactspirit, the next Legendary Pactspirit you get from Boons is guaranteed to be a Pactspirit you picked. The count will be reset once a Pactspirit you picked is obtained.

[Duplicate Pactspirits]
When you receive Duplicate Pactspirits, they will be converted into a certain amount of Pactspirit Proofs. Surplus Proofs can be traded for Insight Essence at the in-game shop

[Boon Item List]
Legendary Pactspirits Base Rate: 1.500%
Rare Pactspirits Base Rate: 12.000%
Magic Pactspirits Base Rate: 86.500%
After obtaining 12 PYO Battle Pactspirits, this Boon will automatically end.

rows.season|season_des|831:
Season Background
Unfold a piece of cold Snowpaper and apply colorful Paint to the white snow.
Breathe life into everything as you fill in the snowy landscape with colors.
Eventually, the empty frozen canvas becomes a vibrant work of art.
After the last brush falls, the painter also becomes part of the painting.
What magnificent scenery awaits the one who created the world on this frozen canvas and entered it?

New Gameplay
After collecting Snowpaper Fragments in the Netherrealm, Hunters will select a difficulty and consume these fragments to unfold the canvas. After the canvas is unfolded, Hunters will need to defeat monsters in Netherrealm stages of the corresponding difficulty to collect various colors and types of Paint.
Hunters will need to place the corresponding Paints in the appropriate areas according to the Coloring Paint instructions, upgrade the Paints, and obtain new Coloring Paints until the canvas is completed.
After the painting is completed, Hunters can enter the frozen canvas of their painting to challenge monsters created from paint and the gameplay to get Splendor Eggs containing various rewards.

New Development System
Several Exclusive Support Skills have been added for most Active Skills, increasing the damage dealt by these skills and changing their form, giving them many unexpected amazing effects that will enrich Hunters' combat experience.
Collect Exclusive Support Skills and Inspiration Essences that are used to upgrade skills from the Frozen Canvas gameplay to create more powerful, more diverse, and more creative new builds.

rows.season|season_des|631:
Season Background
I am lost within the mist.
I cannot find my way back.
Who extinguished my lantern? Who's calling out my name?
I break the hands of the Clock Tower and tear open the mist.
Then, I saw you.
At that time, I was still you.

New Gameplay
Defeat the Mistville "Residents" in the Netherrealm and journey to Mistville. Dispel the mist with Sanity and face various random events to eventually arrive at the Clock Tower. Complete Advent of Folklores in the Clock Tower to receive a Chest of Folklores that contains various rewards. After that, Hunters must welcome a new day from the bench.
Hunters will find all kinds of Food and Old Stuff while exploring Mistville. Use them well to change your exploration experience and even increase drop quantity.
The new season features brand new Season Talents. Hunters must collect Mistville Intel to gradually unlock these Talents and make exploring Mistville easier than ever.

New Development System
The new season features a batch of brand new skills called Activation Medium Skills. They are often closely linked to auto-triggering, allowing them to significantly simplify gameplay and improve your experience.
Hunters can obtain various Activation Medium Skills from Whispering Mist, and use them to create new, surprising, and powerful builds.

rows.season|season_des|1222:
Season Background
I walked through a door.
I was certain it was just that-a normal door.
Then I saw those... things. Ashen arms drifting in the air.
Deformed heads crashing to the ground.
Then a fish, its mouth gaping and closing, emitting the director's voice:
"Agent ■■■■■, I don't care what level of the Overrealm you're on, find a "Door" and get back here. Now!"
A door? Where?
I looked up. I looked down. I looked everywhere.
Turns out, it was inside the door.
But as I stepped through the door, it hit me:
My name isn't ■■■■■... and I've never met any director.

New Gameplay
You will find "Doors" within the Netherrealm. Defeating the monsters within these "Doors" grants a chance to enter the Overrealm.
Within the Overrealm, you must defeat monsters before time runs out, accumulate Containment Progress, and open doors to deeper levels. Only the best can reach the fourth and final level.
You can obtain drop bonus affixes called Bottled Shadows in the Overrealm. Stacking multiple instances of these affixes can lead to spectacular drops.
Unlocking Contained Objects in the Containment Dossier grants various practical bonuses, and also causes Contained Objects and Abnormalities that provide assistance or carry drops to appear in the Overrealm.

New Development System
Ethereal Prisms can be installed on Advanced Talent Panels within the Talent system.
An Ethereal Prism will override a single Talent Node, influencing surrounding Talents centered on that position and granting them additional effects.
An Ethereal Prism also provides bonus effects to the Core Talent on its current Advanced Talent Panel, or replaces it with a powerful new Core Talent.
With over 20 new Core Talents, you now have access to a wealth of new mechanics and attributes, providing the foundation for countless creative builds.
There's also a type of special Prism that possesses a remarkable mirroring ability. Based on the center point of the current Talent Panel, it can reflect Talent Nodes from one side to the other, with a chance to significantly enhance the effects of the mirrored Talent Nodes.
Within the Talent system, only one regular Prism and one special Prism can be installed, and the two can coexist.
Using Calibration Prism allows you to add random affixes to Ethereal Prisms, breaking free from traditional Talent constraints and customizing a Talent Panel tailored to your playstyle.

rows.season|season_des|931:
Season Background
Take a moment to silently reflect on what you seek in your heart and mind, for the divination is about to begin.
You picked The Empress, The Chariot...
But before I reveal the meaning of your reading, I must ask you one last time...
Are you truly prepared to pay the price of peering into fate?
Knowing that the very future you wish to glimpse will be shaped by every tarot card you draw from this moment forward...
Do you still want to see it?

New Gameplay
Mysterious tarot cards are scattered throughout the Netherrealm stages, each one offering a glimpse into the threads of destiny. Over a dozen tarot-themed trials await daring Hunters, including The Chariot, The Emperor, The Hermit, and The Sun.
Upon completing each Tarot Trial, you will receive a Note of Arcana, a vital key to unlocking your full potential along the Tarot Path.
Beware, though-while the Tarot Path is lined with alluring Chests of Destiny, it is also riddled with traps.
The Notes of Arcana will guide your way, helping you steer clear of traps while helping you claim the Chests of Destiny you seek.
The ultimate challenge of fate starts when you want to open your Chests of Destiny.
At that time, the Tarot Trials corresponding to the Chests of Destiny will be revealed in turn.
When starting a specific wave of battle, the additional tarot themes will be applied to the new Tarot Trial.
Thus, the power of multiple tarot cards will be applied simultaneously as the battle intensifies.
Correspondingly, Hunters' rewards will accumulate to unforeseen heights in this wonderful trial.
The price that must be paid for the gifts of destiny has been marked, and the answer you seek lies in the tarot cards.

New Upgrade System
Hunters can form pacts with up to three Drop Pactspirits and three Battle Pactspirits.
In the Arcana gameplay, Hunters will obtain a variety of Destinies, each of which has different effects. Installing them in the corresponding Battle Pactspirit Talent Nodes will replace the original effects of the Talent Nodes and change destiny.
There are two types of Destinies: Fates and Kismets, with the exceptionally rare Dual Kismets offering even greater potential.
Fates grant Hunters regular stats such as Resistances, Mana Compensation, Curse effects, etc.
Kismets, on the other hand, grant rarer and more potent effects, paving the way for unique and powerful builds that can transform your playstyle.

Command is generally not negative, but some special effects will reduce it to lower than 0.\nEvery point of Command will grant Synthetic Troop Minions +2% additional damage and increase the size of their Tracking Area. When Command is a negative value, the damage bonus will always be 0%, but the Tracking Area will be reduced accordingly.\nWhen Command is not 0, 13 points will be reduced/granted (depending on whether the current Command is positive or negative) per second until Command becomes 0 again. rows.gacha|des|39003:
In general, the base rate is applied to all Pactspirits. For Rate Up and Minimum Guarantee, the rates are subject to actual rules.
[Boon Rules]
The base rate of acquiring a Legendary Pactspirits is 1.500%. If you fail to obtain any Legendary Pactspirit after 50 Boons, the next Boon's rate of yielding a Legendary Pactspirit will be increased from 1.500% to 3.000%, and if this Boon doesn't yield a Legendary Pactspirit either, then the chance of obtaining a Legendary Pactspirit with the next Boon will be increased from 3.000% to 4.500%. This process repeats itself with a 1.500% rate increase for every Boon until the rate of acquiring a Legendary Pactspirit reaches 100.000%. Once a Legendary Pactspirit is obtained, the next Boon's chance will be reset to the base rate.

For every 10 Boons, at least 1 Pactspirit that is Rare or better is guaranteed.

rows.system_help|description|41:
Hot Streak provides the following 6 high-risk high-reward mechanics.

1. Re-roll Gear Energy
Use TOWER Tokens - Energy to re-roll the Energy of a piece of gear. If it is successful, the gear's Energy will be increased to the maximum. If it fails, the Energy will remain unchanged.

2. Re-roll All Pre-fix and Suffix Values of Non-Legendary Gear, Granting Luckier Results.
Use TOWER Tokens - Affix and Truth Fossils to re-roll all pre-fix and suffix values of a piece of non-Legendary gear. A random percentage between 0 and 100% will be selected, and all pre-fix and suffix values on the gear will be scaled by the percentage (rounded to the nearest).
For example, if the rolled percentage is 100%, all pre-fix and suffix values on the gear will be adjusted to the maximum value within the range (known as a max roll).

3. Re-roll Base Affixes of Priceless Gear
Use TOWER Tokens - Priceless to re-roll the Base affixes of a piece of Priceless gear. If it is successful, all the Base affixes of the gear will be re-rolled (The number of re-rolled Base affixes equals the current number of Base affixes). If it fails, one Base affix will be removed.

4. Re-roll Corrosion Base Affixes of Corroded Legendary Gear
Use TOWER Tokens - Corrosion to re-roll the Corrosion Base affixes of a piece of Corroded Legendary gear. If it is successful, all Corrosion Base affixes will be re-rolled. If it fails, the gear's Corrosion affixes will vanish, and the gear will become bound.

5. Re-roll Undetermined Fate
Use TOWER Tokens - Undetermined Fate to re-roll Undetermined Fates. If it is successful, the type and quantity of Destiny slots of an Undetermined Fate will be re-rolled. If it fails, the Undetermined Fate will vanish.

6. Re-roll Fluorescent Memory Quantity
Use TOWER Tokens - Fluorescent to re-roll the quantity of a Fluorescent Memory. At least 1 Fluorescent Memory must be inserted, up to half of the exchanged quantity (rounded down) of the Fluorescent Memory. Fluorescent Memories with an exchange quantity of 1 cannot be inserted. This will change the quantity of a Fluorescent Memory randomly, doubling its quantity at most, and making it all vanish at the least.

rows.collection|unlocked_text|31401: The ancient city seems to be awakening. I see innumerable shadows rising to sing praise to the sun. The features of the dragon can be seen in the shadows' remaining forms and habits. I can imagine that the Ichi's artificial sun attracted the dragon and made it fly in the sky to melt it down with dragon breath. The great heat caused a series of chain reactions, including making the volcano under the ancient Ichi city burst. So this gold-built city devoured its people and brought the dragon into the ground.\n\nUnder the abyss, the volcano cave and the dragon's remains became a natural hotbed. Its body parts, driven by their resentment, began to incubate and grow. These broken lives were born in the shadows and turned into sludge after death. They made themselves stronger and themselves by devouring their kind, and then started another life circle. Now thousands of dragon's descendants surge toward the outside of the abyss, trying to return to the world again.

In general, the base rate is applied to all Pactspirits. For Rate Up and Minimum Guarantee, the rates are subject to actual rules.
[Boon Rules]
The base rate of acquiring a Legendary Pactspirits is 1.500%. If you fail to obtain any Legendary Pactspirit after 50 Boons, the next Boon's rate of yielding a Legendary Pactspirit will be increased from 1.500% to 3.000%, and if this Boon doesn't yield a Legendary Pactspirit either, then the chance of obtaining a Legendary Pactspirit with the next Boon will be increased from 3.000% to 4.500%. This process repeats itself with a 1.500% rate increase for every Boon until the rate of acquiring a Legendary Pactspirit reaches 100.000%. Once a Legendary Pactspirit is obtained, the next Boon's chance will be reset to the base rate.

For every 10 Boons, at least 1 Pactspirit that is Rare or better is guaranteed.

[Rate Ups]
When the PYO (Pick-Your-Own) feature is enabled, you can pick a designated amount of Pactspirits in the Pactspirit List to get a 25.000% chance to obtain the Pactspirits you picked (if you picked multiple Pactspirits, they will share the chance equally). If that doesn't get you a Pactspirit you picked after getting 3 Legendary Pactspirits, the next Legendary Pactspirit you get from Boons is guaranteed to be a Pactspirit you picked. The count will be reset once a Pactspirit you picked is obtained.

[Duplicate Pactspirits]
When you receive Duplicate Pactspirits, they will be converted into a certain amount of Pactspirit Proofs. Surplus Proofs can be traded for Insight Essence at the in-game shop.

[Boon Item List]
Legendary Pactspirits Base Rate: 1.500%
Rare Pactspirits Base Rate: 12.000%. When obtaining a Rare Pactspirit, there is a 30% chance it will be Plaintive Ball of Thread - Flower
Magic Pactspirits Base Rate: 86.500%. When obtaining a Magic Pactspirit, there is a 30% chance it will be Luluri - Green Leaf.
This Boon is a Designated Pactspirit Pool. All Designated Pactspirit Pools share the rate up effects and Minimum Guarantee chances (not including the PYO feature's remaining amount of attempts) and are independent from other Boons' rate up effects and Minimum Guarantee chances. This Pactspirit is exclusive to the Designated Pactspirit Pool and will not be available in any other Boon. The exclusive Pactspirit is only available in the current pool.
The exclusive Pactspirit's effects remain valid permanently.

rows.system_help|description|36:
1. The Tarot Path unlocks after you complete enough Tarot Trials in the stage.
2. Various Cells exist in the Tarot Path, and you move along the path by using the Notes of Arcana in your hand. When you stop on a Cell, you will trigger the effect of the corresponding Cell.
3. When you stay on a Cell with a Chest of Destiny on it, you will collect it. You can only carry 7 Chests of Destiny at any one time.
4. Chests of Destiny come in 6 rarities: Green, Blue, Purple, Orange, Red, and Rainbow. The rarity of Chests of Destiny can be enhanced by using Notes of Arcana or by triggering random events on the Cells.
5. After collecting Chests of Destiny, Hunters can choose to start Fateful Contest at any time. After completing the corresponding number of Tarot Trials in Fateful Contest, Chests of Destiny can be opened to claim their rewards.
6. There are traps on some Cells in the Tarot Path. Stopping on a Cell with a trap will reduce your Life. When your Life is reduced to zero, Fateful Contest will start, and you won't be able to collect any more Chests of Destiny.
7. When you reach Stage Level 86 (Timemark 8), Chests of Destiny have a chance to drop Rare Fates, Kismets, Dual Kismets, and Star Net.
8. When you reach Stage Level 89 (Profound Timemark 8), Chests of Destiny have a chance to drop Undetermined Fates.

rows.season|season_des|1241:
Season Background
I walked through a door.
I was certain it was just that-a normal door.
Then I saw those... things. Ashen arms drifting in the air.
Deformed heads crashing to the ground.
Then a fish, its mouth gaping and closing, emitting the director's voice:
"Agent ■■■■■, I don't care what level of the Overrealm you're on, find a "Door" and get back here. Now!"
A door? Where?
I looked up. I looked down. I looked everywhere.
Turns out, it was inside the door.
But as I stepped through the door, it hit me:
My name isn't ■■■■■... and I've never met any director.

New Gameplay
You will find "Doors" within the Netherrealm. Defeating the monsters within these "Doors" grants a chance to enter the Overrealm.
Within the Overrealm, you must defeat monsters before time runs out, accumulate Containment Progress, and open doors to deeper levels. Only the best can reach the fourth and final level.
You can obtain drop bonus affixes called Bottled Shadows in the Overrealm. Stacking multiple instances of these affixes can lead to spectacular drops.
Unlocking Contained Objects in the Containment Dossier grants various practical bonuses, and also causes Contained Objects and Abnormalities that provide assistance or carry drops to appear in the Overrealm.

New Development System
Ethereal Prisms can be installed on Advanced Talent Panels within the Talent system.
An Ethereal Prism will override a single Talent Node, influencing surrounding Talents centered on that position and granting them additional effects.
An Ethereal Prism also provides bonus effects to the Core Talent on its current Advanced Talent Panel, or replaces it with a powerful new Core Talent.
With over 20 new Core Talents, you now have access to a wealth of new mechanics and attributes, providing the foundation for countless creative builds.
There's also a type of special Prism that possesses a remarkable mirroring ability. Based on the center point of the current Talent Panel, it can reflect Talent Nodes from one side to the other, with a chance to significantly enhance the effects of the mirrored Talent Nodes.
Within the Talent system, only one regular Prism and one special Prism can be installed, and the two can coexist.
Using Calibration Prism allows you to add random affixes to Ethereal Prisms, breaking free from traditional Talent constraints and customizing a Talent Panel tailored to your playstyle.

rows.system_help|description|45:
The Grafting system allows you to add affixes to Vorax Gear.

Use Normal Organs to add Basic or Advanced affixes to Vorax Gear.
Use Special Organs to add Ultimate affixes to Lv. 89 or above Vorax Gear.
Use Core Organs and Sutures to add Legendary affixes to Vorax Gear. The Core Organs of some Legendary gear can only be Grafted to high-level Vorax Gear.

During Grafting, affix options will be provided based on the number of affixes on the corresponding Legendary gear. Legendary gear with 2 affixes provides 1 affix option, while Legendary gear with more than 2 affixes provides 2 affix options.
The Legendary affixes of a Vorax Gear must come from the same Legendary gear.

Each piece of Vorax Gear can have up to 2 Advanced affixes, 2 Ultimate affixes, and 2 Legendary affixes.

Use Cutting Instruments to re-roll the values of all random affixes of Vorax Gear.

You can equip only 1 piece of Vorax Gear at a time.

rows.gacha|des|13001:
In general, the base rate is applied to all Pactspirits. For Rate Up and Minimum Guarantee, the rates are subject to actual rules.
[Boon Rules]
The base rate of acquiring a Legendary Pactspirits is 1.500%. If you fail to obtain any Legendary Pactspirit after 50 Boons, the next Boon's rate of yielding a Legendary Pactspirit will be increased from 1.500% to 3.000%, and if this Boon doesn't yield a Legendary Pactspirit either, then the chance of obtaining a Legendary Pactspirit with the next Boon will be increased from 3.000% to 4.500%. This process repeats itself with a 1.500% rate increase for every Boon until the rate of acquiring a Legendary Pactspirit reaches 100.000%. Once a Legendary Pactspirit is obtained, the next Boon's chance will be reset to the base rate.

After this Boon ends, should it return in a future season, its draw attempts will be retained. If added to the Past Memories, the draw attempts will be reset.

For every 10 Boons, at least 1 Pactspirit that is Rare or better is guaranteed.

[Rate Ups]
When the PYO (Pick-Your-Own) feature is enabled, you can pick a designated amount of Pactspirits in the Pactspirit List to get a 50.000% chance to obtain the Pactspirits you picked (if you picked multiple Pactspirits, they will share the chance equally). If that doesn't get you a Pactspirit you picked after getting 1 Legendary Pactspirit, the next Legendary Pactspirit you get from Boons is guaranteed to be a Pactspirit you picked. The count will be reset once a Pactspirit you picked is obtained.

[Duplicate Pactspirits]
When you receive Duplicate Pactspirits, they will be converted into a certain amount of Pactspirit Proofs. Surplus Proofs can be traded for Insight Essence at the in-game shop

[Boon Item List]
Legendary Pactspirits Base Rate: 1.500%
Rare Pactspirits Base Rate: 12.000%.
Magic Pactspirits Base Rate: 86.500%.
The Legendary Pactspirit Intern Shelley will only appear in this Boon and will not be available in any other Boon. The season-exclusive gameplay of the season-exclusive Pactspirit will be added to the Season Rotation Pool once the season comes to an end. And the chances of that season-exclusive gameplay appearing in the next season will be reduced. The exclusive Pactspirit is only available in the current pool.
The exclusive Pactspirit's effects remain valid permanently.

rows.season|season_des|421:
Season Background
Legend has it that in our homeland, the eternal, invincible realm. The very barren, tainted land the world called Aeterna. Boundless riches and the secret of immortality are buried beneath the ruined facade. Our people wandered among the dense mist and broken walls, awaiting eternal grace. When candlelight burns again, the city that fell a thousand times shall be rebuilt, and the people who fell a thousand times shall stand once more. And who shall venture into the eternal Aeterna? Hunters who are destined to trample the myriad ruins of the Aeterna, yet refuse to yield to eternity. I see you treading toward the innermost candlelight.

New Gameplay
Interact with the Monument of Aeterna to enter the edge of Aeterna-the Ruins of Aeterna. In the ruins, Hunters must kindle candelabra in the allotted time for prizes and obtain a Mark of the Ruins that has the condition of all candelabra recorded on it.
Hunters must obtain more Marks of the Ruins and cover the map of Aeterna to rebuild the city. Once the city is rebuilt, its roads, landscape, and rewards will change. So, it brings a whole new experience each time it's rebuilt.
The new season features a brand new Major Season Talent. Gradually unlock all talents to obtain massive buffs and bonus rewards, expand the map of the city, and ultimately unlock the Infinite City of Aeterna.
After the Infinite City of Aeterna is unlocked, every time you clear the city will push it one step closer to reaching true eternity, making it even more dangerous. As the city becomes more dangerous, there will be more rewards too, and there's no limit to the city's tier.
The Lone King of Aeterna, a new supreme boss, is featured in the new season. He waits at the end of Aeterna, stoically watching everything you do in the city. When you dare usurp Aeterna, he will slay you without mercy.

New Development System
You will get a brand new item, Soul Candle, when exploring the city. You need to equip Soul Candles in the Skill panel. And they will nourish your soul and significantly improve skill effects.
A Soul Candle usually has 1 to 3 affixes of random tiers, but you can fuse them to upgrade, evolve, or even mutate their affixes.
Soul Candle Fusion, a new development system, has been added to the season. You can acquire a special item, Tear of Aeterna, from monsters in the city. By spending Tears of Aeterna, you can fuse two Soul Candles.
When fusing Soul Candles, affixes of identical effects and tiers from the two Soul Candles will be fused into one, and the remaining affixes will be either retained or discarded randomly.
When both Soul Candles have the same T1 affixes, the fused affix has a chance of evolving into a more powerful T0 affix with one guaranteed negative affix, and any T0 affix of the fused Soul Candle has a small chance of mutating into a rare, special affix.
Mutated affixes are very powerful, however, they can also have serious negative impacts on you. Therefore, you must balance the power and the negative effects brought by Soul Candles by making the most of the positive affixes and avoiding the negative affixes, using the potent but dangerous Soul Candles to your advantage.

rows.gacha|des|8003:
In general, the base rate is applied to all Pactspirits. For Rate Up and Minimum Guarantee, the rates are subject to actual rules.
[Boon Rules]
The base rate of acquiring a Legendary Pactspirits is 1.500%. If you fail to obtain any Legendary Pactspirit after 50 Boons, the next Boon's rate of yielding a Legendary Pactspirit will be increased from 1.500% to 3.000%, and if this Boon doesn't yield a Legendary Pactspirit either, then the chance of obtaining a Legendary Pactspirit with the next Boon will be increased from 3.000% to 4.500%. This process repeats itself with a 1.500% rate increase for every Boon until the rate of acquiring a Legendary Pactspirit reaches 100.000%. Once a Legendary Pactspirit is obtained, the next Boon's chance will be reset to the base rate.

For every 10 Boons, at least 1 Pactspirit that is Rare or better is guaranteed.

[Rate Ups]
When the PYO (Pick-Your-Own) feature is enabled, you can pick a designated amount of Pactspirits in the Pactspirit List to get a 50.000% chance to obtain the Pactspirits you picked (if you picked multiple Pactspirits, they will share the chance equally). If that doesn't get you a Pactspirit you picked after getting 1 Legendary Pactspirit, the next Legendary Pactspirit you get from Boons is guaranteed to be a Pactspirit you picked. The count will be reset once a Pactspirit you picked is obtained.

[Duplicate Pactspirits]
When you receive Duplicate Pactspirits, they will be converted into a certain amount of Pactspirit Proofs. Surplus Proofs can be traded for Insight Essence at the in-game shop

[Boon Item List]
Legendary Pactspirits Base Rate: 1.500%
Rare Pactspirits Base Rate: 12.000%. When obtaining a Rare Pactspirit, there is a 30% chance it will be Plaintive Ball of Thread - Gold Leaf
Magic Pactspirits Base Rate: 86.500%. When obtaining a Magic Pactspirit, there is a 30% chance it will be Happy Chonky - Emerald
The Legendary Pactspirit Starfish Chanter will only appear in this Boon and will not be available in any other Boon. The season-exclusive gameplay of the season-exclusive Pactspirit will be added to the Season Rotation Pool once the season comes to an end. And the chances of that season-exclusive gameplay appearing in the next season will be reduced. The exclusive Pactspirit is only available in the current pool.
The exclusive Pactspirit's effects remain valid permanently

rows.season|season_des|1522:
Season Background
Usher Mortuary - Night Watcher Recruitment Letter
After the Calamity, Leptis became a sprawling graveyard. Countless tormented souls still weep in the night wind.
To keep our vow to console the departed, this mortuary hereby resumes the Rite of Vigil. Our Vigil Procession will escort the coffins carrying the gathered souls to their eternal rest in the netherworld.
However, Wraiths lurk along the path to disturb the peace of the dead-a most unbecoming conduct.
We now seek Night Watchers to guard the procession, purge the Wraiths along the way, and ensure an unimpeded passage for the vigil.
Tonight, when the Guiding Lantern kindles, we await you as promised-join us in the Vigil.
-Madam Usher

New Gameplay
Interact with the Nameless Coffins in Netherrealm stages to start the Vigil. As the Vigil Procession advances, your Guiding Lantern will attract Wraiths along the path. Defeat the ceaseless tide of Wraiths and claim generous rewards! Within the time limit, the faster you defeat Wraiths, the faster they spawn-and the greater your rewards!
You may also encounter a gameplay theme that defies convention: the Noble Coffin. The occupants of such coffins are often of extraordinary status, making the challenge more formidable-but the rewards far more bountiful.
During the vigil, Vigil Anomalies may appear at random, bringing Anomaly monsters that grant rich rewards, or altering the gameplay rules for additional rewards.
At the Usher Mortuary, you may awaken different Relics to modify gameplay and greatly improve drops.

New Development System
Install Nether King's Divinity on Divinity Slates to draw upon the might of the gods, and harness the mysterious power of Nether King.
Nether King's Divinity influences other Divinity Slates, enhancing their affix effects, projecting its own affixes onto surrounding slates, and unlocking powerful exclusive affix effects by adjusting the number of adjacent and non-adjacent slates.

rows.gacha|des|14003:
In general, the base rate is applied to all Pactspirits. For Rate Up and Minimum Guarantee, the rates are subject to actual rules.
[Boon Rules]
The base rate of acquiring a Legendary Pactspirits is 1.500%. If you fail to obtain any Legendary Pactspirit after 50 Boons, the next Boon's rate of yielding a Legendary Pactspirit will be increased from 1.500% to 3.000%, and if this Boon doesn't yield a Legendary Pactspirit either, then the chance of obtaining a Legendary Pactspirit with the next Boon will be increased from 3.000% to 4.500%. This process repeats itself with a 1.500% rate increase for every Boon until the rate of acquiring a Legendary Pactspirit reaches 100.000%. Once a Legendary Pactspirit is obtained, the next Boon's chance will be reset to the base rate.

For every 10 Boons, at least 1 Pactspirit that is Rare or better is guaranteed.

[Rate Ups]
When the PYO (Pick-Your-Own) feature is enabled, you can pick a designated amount of Pactspirits in the Pactspirit List to get a 50.000% chance to obtain the Pactspirits you picked (if you picked multiple Pactspirits, they will share the chance equally). If that doesn't get you a Pactspirit you picked after getting 1 Legendary Pactspirit, the next Legendary Pactspirit you get from Boons is guaranteed to be a Pactspirit you picked. The count will be reset once a Pactspirit you picked is obtained.

[Duplicate Pactspirits]
When you receive Duplicate Pactspirits, they will be converted into a certain amount of Pactspirit Proofs. Surplus Proofs can be traded for Insight Essence at the in-game shop

[Boon Item List]
Legendary Pactspirits Base Rate: 1.500%
Rare Pactspirits Base Rate: 12.000%
Magic Pactspirits Base Rate: 86.500%
The Legendary Pactspirit Twilight Sparks will only appear in this Boon and will not be available in any other Boon.
The exclusive Pactspirit's effects remain valid permanently.

rows.manual_rule_des|des|2002090121:
<RichText>Grafting can be performed on Vorax Gear at [Mad Doctor Shelley] in the Town to customize random affixes on gear.

Use Normal Organs to add Basic or Advanced affixes to Vorax Gear.
Use Special Organs to add Ultimate affixes to Vorax Gear.
Use Core Organs and Sutures to add Legendary affixes to Vorax Gear. The Core Organs of some Legendary gear can only be Grafted to high-level Vorax Gear.

During Grafting, affix options will be provided based on the number of affixes on the corresponding Legendary gear.
The Legendary affixes of a Vorax Gear must come from the same Legendary gear.
Legendary gear with 2 affixes provides 1 affix option, while Legendary gear with more than 2 affixes provides 2 affix options.

Each piece of Vorax Gear can have up to 2 Advanced affixes, 2 Ultimate affixes, and 2 Legendary affixes.

Use Cutting Instruments to re-roll the values of all random affixes of Vorax Gear.

When a piece of Vorax Gear already has a certain Ultimate affix, the corresponding Special Organ can't be Grafted on it again.
When Grafting with some Special Organs there is a chance for a Blemish to appear.
When a piece of Vorax Gear has 2 Legendary affixes, Core Organs can no longer be Grafted onto it.
</>

rows.season|season_des|1432:
Season Background
The story begins with a legend from a time long forgotten.
"Once, in an age beyond memory, there lived a race that called the moon their home.
They were masters of song and dance. Every part of their being resonated like a fine instrument, producing melodies of sublime beauty.
But when the moon fell from the heavens, they turned into cold stone-statues scattered to the four winds.
It is said that these statues will awaken once more when the bright moon shines again. They will join you in a symphony of the full moon, offering treasures long lost to time.
So, Traveler, strum the Lunar Strings.
Call the moon to its zenith, turn the moonlight into song, and uncover the secrets sleeping inside the stone.
Tonight-let's shine together."

New Gameplay
Step into an area teeming with Lunar Stone Statues. Place the Lunar Ring at your feet to encompass as many statues as possible and Strum the Lunar Harp to awaken them, then take them down to earn instant drop rewards. The more statues you wake in one strum, the higher your Combo count, which results in greater Drop Quantity bonuses-and greater loot.
Lunar Omen events will appear at random, bringing both challenges and generous rewards. Fortunate Hunters may even stumble upon the game-changing Rhapsody gameplay-a twist that reshapes the "rhythm" you play and delivers a bountiful run you won't forget.
Install your Lunar Harp with various Lunar Strings to customize bonus effects and select the playstyle that perfectly matches your rhythm.

New Development System
Memory Revival is a crafting method that imbues Hero Memories with special powers.
Revival grants various effects to Hero Memories, increasing the values of their base affixes, upgrading Fixed Affixes, giving them special random affixes, and even adding a powerful Revived Affix.
Revived Affixes even include 1 or more unique Hero Trait Affixes tailored to each hero.

rows.gacha|des|6001:
In general, the base rate is applied to all Pactspirits. For Rate Up and Minimum Guarantee, the rates are subject to actual rules.
[Boon Rules]
The base rate of acquiring a Legendary Pactspirits is 1.500%. If you fail to obtain any Legendary Pactspirit after 50 Boons, the next Boon's rate of yielding a Legendary Pactspirit will be increased from 1.500% to 3.000%, and if this Boon doesn't yield a Legendary Pactspirit either, then the chance of obtaining a Legendary Pactspirit with the next Boon will be increased from 3.000% to 4.500%. This process repeats itself with a 1.500% rate increase for every Boon until the rate of acquiring a Legendary Pactspirit reaches 100.000%. Once a Legendary Pactspirit is obtained, the next Boon's chance will be reset to the base rate.

For every 10 Boons, at least 1 Pactspirit that is Rare or better is guaranteed.

[Rate Ups]
When the PYO (Pick-Your-Own) feature is enabled, you can pick a designated amount of Pactspirits in the Pactspirit List to get a 50.000% chance to obtain the Pactspirits you picked (if you picked multiple Pactspirits, they will share the chance equally). If that doesn't get you a Pactspirit you picked after getting 1 Legendary Pactspirit, the next Legendary Pactspirit you get from Boons is guaranteed to be a Pactspirit you picked. The count will be reset once a Pactspirit you picked is obtained.

[Duplicate Pactspirits]
When you receive Duplicate Pactspirits, they will be converted into a certain amount of Pactspirit Proofs. Surplus Proofs can be traded for Insight Essence at the in-game shop

[Boon Item List]
Legendary Pactspirits Base Rate: 1.500%
Rare Pactspirits Base Rate: 12.000%. When obtaining a Rare Pactspirit, there is a 30% chance it will be First Mate of the Furious Sea - Silent Night
Magic Pactspirits Base Rate: 86.500%. When obtaining a Magic Pactspirit, there is a 30% chance it will be Happy Chonky - Violet
The Legendary Pactspirit Mistville Orphan will only appear in this Boon and will not be available in any other Boon. The season-exclusive gameplay of the season-exclusive Pactspirit will be added to the Season Rotation Pool once the season comes to an end. And the chances of that season-exclusive gameplay appearing in the next season will be reduced. The exclusive Pactspirit is only available in the current pool.
The exclusive Pactspirit's effects remain valid permanently.

rows.season|season_des|932:
Season Background
Take a moment to silently reflect on what you seek in your heart and mind, for the divination is about to begin.
You picked The Empress, The Chariot...
But before I reveal the meaning of your reading, I must ask you one last time...
Are you truly prepared to pay the price of peering into fate?
Knowing that the very future you wish to glimpse will be shaped by every tarot card you draw from this moment forward...
Do you still want to see it?

New Gameplay
Mysterious tarot cards are scattered throughout the Netherrealm stages, each one offering a glimpse into the threads of destiny. Over a dozen tarot-themed trials await daring Hunters, including The Chariot, The Emperor, The Hermit, and The Sun.
Upon completing each Tarot Trial, you will receive a Note of Arcana, a vital key to unlocking your full potential along the Tarot Path.
Beware, though-while the Tarot Path is lined with alluring Chests of Destiny, it is also riddled with traps.
The Notes of Arcana will guide your way, helping you steer clear of traps while helping you claim the Chests of Destiny you seek.
The ultimate challenge of fate starts when you want to open your Chests of Destiny.
At that time, the Tarot Trials corresponding to the Chests of Destiny will be revealed in turn.
When starting a specific wave of battle, the additional tarot themes will be applied to the new Tarot Trial.
Thus, the power of multiple tarot cards will be applied simultaneously as the battle intensifies.
Correspondingly, Hunters' rewards will accumulate to unforeseen heights in this wonderful trial.
The price that must be paid for the gifts of destiny has been marked, and the answer you seek lies in the tarot cards.

New Upgrade System
Hunters can form pacts with up to three Drop Pactspirits and three Battle Pactspirits.
In the Arcana gameplay, Hunters will obtain a variety of Destinies, each of which has different effects. Installing them in the corresponding Battle Pactspirit Talent Nodes will replace the original effects of the Talent Nodes and change destiny.
There are two types of Destinies: Fates and Kismets, with the exceptionally rare Dual Kismets offering even greater potential.
Fates grant Hunters regular stats such as Resistances, Mana Compensation, Curse effects, etc.
Kismets, on the other hand, grant rarer and more potent effects, paving the way for unique and powerful builds that can transform your playstyle.

rows.gacha|des|15002:
In general, the base rate is applied to all Pactspirits. For Rate Up and Minimum Guarantee, the rates are subject to actual rules.
[Boon Rules]
The base rate of acquiring a Legendary Pactspirits is 1.500%. If you fail to obtain any Legendary Pactspirit after 50 Boons, the next Boon's rate of yielding a Legendary Pactspirit will be increased from 1.500% to 3.000%, and if this Boon doesn't yield a Legendary Pactspirit either, then the chance of obtaining a Legendary Pactspirit with the next Boon will be increased from 3.000% to 4.500%. This process repeats itself with a 1.500% rate increase for every Boon until the rate of acquiring a Legendary Pactspirit reaches 100.000%. Once a Legendary Pactspirit is obtained, the next Boon's chance will be reset to the base rate.

For every 10 Boons, at least 1 Pactspirit that is Rare or better is guaranteed.

[Rate Ups]
When the PYO (Pick-Your-Own) feature is enabled, you can pick a designated amount of Pactspirits in the Pactspirit List to get a 100.000% chance to obtain the Pactspirits you picked (if you picked multiple Pactspirits, they will share the chance equally).

[Duplicate Pactspirits]
When you receive Duplicate Pactspirits, they will be converted into a certain amount of Pactspirit Proofs. Surplus Proofs can be traded for Insight Essence at the in-game shop.

[Boon Item List]
Legendary Pactspirits Base Rate: 1.500%
Rare Pactspirits Base Rate: 12.000%
Magic Pactspirits Base Rate: 86.500%
The Legendary Pactspirit Icemirror will only appear in this Boon and will not be available in any other Boon.

rows.season|season_des|1221:
Season Background
I walked through a door.
I was certain it was just that-a normal door.
Then I saw those... things. Ashen arms drifting in the air.
Deformed heads crashing to the ground.
Then a fish, its mouth gaping and closing, emitting the director's voice:
"Agent ■■■■■, I don't care what level of the Overrealm you're on, find a "Door" and get back here. Now!"
A door? Where?
I looked up. I looked down. I looked everywhere.
Turns out, it was inside the door.
But as I stepped through the door, it hit me:
My name isn't ■■■■■... and I've never met any director.

New Gameplay
You will find "Doors" within the Netherrealm. Defeating the monsters within these "Doors" grants a chance to enter the Overrealm.
Within the Overrealm, you must defeat monsters before time runs out, accumulate Containment Progress, and open doors to deeper levels. Only the best can reach the fourth and final level.
You can obtain drop bonus affixes called Bottled Shadows in the Overrealm. Stacking multiple instances of these affixes can lead to spectacular drops.
Unlocking Contained Objects in the Containment Dossier grants various practical bonuses, and also causes Contained Objects and Abnormalities that provide assistance or carry drops to appear in the Overrealm.

New Development System
Ethereal Prisms can be installed on Advanced Talent Panels within the Talent system.
An Ethereal Prism will override a single Talent Node, influencing surrounding Talents centered on that position and granting them additional effects.
An Ethereal Prism also provides bonus effects to the Core Talent on its current Advanced Talent Panel, or replaces it with a powerful new Core Talent.
With over 20 new Core Talents, you now have access to a wealth of new mechanics and attributes, providing the foundation for countless creative builds.
There's also a type of special Prism that possesses a remarkable mirroring ability. Based on the center point of the current Talent Panel, it can reflect Talent Nodes from one side to the other, with a chance to significantly enhance the effects of the mirrored Talent Nodes.
Within the Talent system, only one regular Prism and one special Prism can be installed, and the two can coexist.
Using Calibration Prism allows you to add random affixes to Ethereal Prisms, breaking free from traditional Talent constraints and customizing a Talent Panel tailored to your playstyle.

Complete Tarot Trials in the Netherrealm map to collect Notes of Arcana.

rows.season|season_des|822:
Season Background
Unfold a piece of cold Snowpaper and apply colorful Paint to the white snow.
Breathe life into everything as you fill in the snowy landscape with colors.
Eventually, the empty frozen canvas becomes a vibrant work of art.
After the last brush falls, the painter also becomes part of the painting.
What magnificent scenery awaits the one who created the world on this frozen canvas and entered it?

New Gameplay
After collecting Snowpaper Fragments in the Netherrealm, Hunters will select a difficulty and consume these fragments to unfold the canvas. After the canvas is unfolded, Hunters will need to defeat monsters in Netherrealm stages of the corresponding difficulty to collect various colors and types of Paint.
Hunters will need to place the corresponding Paints in the appropriate areas according to the Coloring Paint instructions, upgrade the Paints, and obtain new Coloring Paints until the canvas is completed.
After the painting is completed, Hunters can enter the frozen canvas of their painting to challenge monsters created from paint and the gameplay to get Splendor Eggs containing various rewards.

New Development System
Several Exclusive Support Skills have been added for most Active Skills, increasing the damage dealt by these skills and changing their form, giving them many unexpected amazing effects that will enrich Hunters' combat experience.
Collect Exclusive Support Skills and Inspiration Essences that are used to upgrade skills from the Frozen Canvas gameplay to create more powerful, more diverse, and more creative new builds.

rows.season|season_des|651:
Season Background
"The world of Torchlight is essentially an isolated island in a vast void, and countless terrifying and unknown creatures are lurking around us."
"Around us? More like they are lurking in our deepest and most secret dreams."
The wonderful thing about dreams is that you could be in a deep good dream or the claws of a nightmare...

New Gameplay
Hunters have a chance to enter a sweet dream when they interact with the Dream Lotus on the map.
After completing a Sweet Dream, Hunters will receive Dream Bubbles that contain rewards. Hunters will need to search for more lotuses to explore deeper levels of Sweet Dreams. Whenever a Sweet Dream level is completed, Hunters will inherit the rewards from the previous level and get the chance to further upgrade or increase these rewards.
At the same time, Hunters need to be vigilant as their chance of entering a Nightmare increases with each level of a Sweet Dream they complete. Hunters should be familiar with the Nightmares they encounter as they will receive the Nightmare Omens corresponding to the rewards they select on each level of a Sweet Dream, and these omens will come true in a Nightmare that can come for Hunters at any time. In other words, the higher the level of the Sweet Dream, the more dangers Hunters will face in Nightmares.
No matter how beautiful the rewards are in a dream, it could just be a bubble that can pop at any time. These bubbles will only come true after Hunters escape from the Nightmare.

New Development System
When exploring a dream, Hunters will get a new season item called Dream Talking. Whenever Hunters perform Dream Talking Interpretation, they will obtain a dream base, which includes a Sweet Dream affix and a Nightmare affix. The original base affixes on a piece of gear will be replaced when the dream base is recorded onto the gear. Sweet Dream base affixes grant powerful buffs, such as allowing Hunters to gain Legendary affixes that have only appeared on Legendary gear when crafting gear. Nightmare base affixes, on the other hand, grant negative affixes that may weaken the gear. Therefore, Hunters will need to choose the right time to perform Dream Talking Interpretation. While trying to get the Sweet Dream affixes they seek, Hunters will also need to take care to avoid the negative impact of Nightmare affixes.

The Queen of Eternal Sun, a new supreme boss, is featured in the new season. On a long night filled with chaotic dreams, she opens her eyes again and waits for warriors to sacrifice themselves for her.

rows.collection|unlocked_text|31001:
I found a letter:

"Dear Sir Balbinus: I don't know how to reply. What answer are you expecting? Shall we sit around the pool and listen to my childhood stories, dreams, and misfortunes? Or do you want me to call you "father" after you have left my mother and me for a decade? I once thought about what I would do when I got enough strength... Then I was defeated again and again. Then I'd think about what I would do after revenge... Now I have a chance to enter the Sun Arena and make a name for myself.

The sun shines on the inner city. The air is dry. It's a new day. I'm still excited about the last victory. I picked up my sword as usual and made up my mind to start a new life. I'll soon be summoned by the Queen, and I won't be just a bastard for the rest of my life."

(But we all know a disaster froze his dreams eternally at that moment of failure)

rows.season|season_des|811:
Season Background
Unfold a piece of cold Snowpaper and apply colorful Paint to the white snow.
Breathe life into everything as you fill in the snowy landscape with colors.
Eventually, the empty frozen canvas becomes a vibrant work of art.
After the last brush falls, the painter also becomes part of the painting.
What magnificent scenery awaits the one who created the world on this frozen canvas and entered it?

New Gameplay
After collecting Snowpaper Fragments in the Netherrealm, Hunters will select a difficulty and consume these fragments to unfold the canvas. After the canvas is unfolded, Hunters will need to defeat monsters in Netherrealm stages of the corresponding difficulty to collect various colors and types of Paint.
Hunters will need to place the corresponding Paints in the appropriate areas according to the Coloring Paint instructions, upgrade the Paints, and obtain new Coloring Paints until the canvas is completed.
After the painting is completed, Hunters can enter the frozen canvas of their painting to challenge monsters created from paint and the gameplay to get Splendor Eggs containing various rewards.

New Development System
Several Exclusive Support Skills have been added for most Active Skills, increasing the damage dealt by these skills and changing their form, giving them many unexpected amazing effects that will enrich Hunters' combat experience.
Collect Exclusive Support Skills and Inspiration Essences that are used to upgrade skills from the Frozen Canvas gameplay to create more powerful, more diverse, and more creative new builds.

rows.gacha|des|5002:
In general, the base rate is applied to all Pactspirits. For Rate Up and Minimum Guarantee, the rates are subject to actual rules.
[Boon Rules]
The base rate of acquiring a Legendary Pactspirits is 1.500%. If you fail to obtain any Legendary Pactspirit after 50 Boons, the next Boon's rate of yielding a Legendary Pactspirit will be increased from 1.500% to 3.000%, and if this Boon doesn't yield a Legendary Pactspirit either, then the chance of obtaining a Legendary Pactspirit with the next Boon will be increased from 3.000% to 4.500%. This process repeats itself with a 1.500% rate increase for every Boon until the rate of acquiring a Legendary Pactspirit reaches 100.000%. Once a Legendary Pactspirit is obtained, the next Boon's chance will be reset to the base rate.

For every 10 Boons, at least 1 Pactspirit that is Rare or better is guaranteed.

[Rate Ups]
When the PYO (Pick-Your-Own) feature is enabled, you can pick a designated amount of Pactspirits in the Pactspirit List to get a 50.000% chance to obtain the Pactspirits you picked (if you picked multiple Pactspirits, they will share the chance equally). If that doesn't get you a Pactspirit you picked after getting 1 Legendary Pactspirit, the next Legendary Pactspirit you get from Boons is guaranteed to be a Pactspirit you picked. The count will be reset once a Pactspirit you picked is obtained.

[Duplicate Pactspirits]
When you receive Duplicate Pactspirits, they will be converted into a certain amount of Pactspirit Proofs. Surplus Proofs can be traded for Insight Essence at the in-game shop

[Boon Item List]
Legendary Pactspirits Base Rate: 1.500%
Rare Pactspirits Base Rate: 12.000%, Letice - Withered Leaf and Hell Cavalry - Twilight's base rates are double the base rate of other Rare Pactspirits
Magic Pactspirits Base Rate: 86.500%, Shocket - Green Leaf and Awooawoo - Blue Sky's base rates are double the base rate of other Magic Pactspirits
The Legendary Pactspirits Raging Sands of Eternal Night / Witch Antelope of Lust will only appear in this Boon and will not be available in any other Boon.

rows.gacha|des|4001:
In general, the base rate is applied to all Pactspirits. For Rate Up and Minimum Guarantee, the rates are subject to actual rules.
[Boon Rules]
The base rate of acquiring a Legendary Pactspirits is 1.500%. If you fail to obtain any Legendary Pactspirit after 50 Boons, the next Boon's rate of yielding a Legendary Pactspirit will be increased from 1.500% to 3.000%, and if this Boon doesn't yield a Legendary Pactspirit either, then the chance of obtaining a Legendary Pactspirit with the next Boon will be increased from 3.000% to 4.500%. This process repeats itself with a 1.500% rate increase for every Boon until the rate of acquiring a Legendary Pactspirit reaches 100.000%. Once a Legendary Pactspirit is obtained, the next Boon's chance will be reset to the base rate.

For every 10 Boons, at least 1 Pactspirit that is Rare or better is guaranteed.

[Rate Ups]
When the PYO (Pick-Your-Own) feature is enabled, you can pick a designated amount of Pactspirits in the Pactspirit List to get a 25.000% chance to obtain the Pactspirits you picked (if you picked multiple Pactspirits, they will share the chance equally). If that doesn't get you a Pactspirit you picked after getting 3 Legendary Pactspirits, the next Legendary Pactspirit you get from Boons is guaranteed to be a Pactspirit you picked. The count will be reset once a Pactspirit you picked is obtained.

[Duplicate Pactspirits]
When you receive Duplicate Pactspirits, they will be converted into a certain amount of Pactspirit Proofs. Surplus Proofs can be traded for Insight Essence at the in-game shop

[Boon Item List]
Legendary Pactspirits Base Rate: 1.500%
Rare Pactspirits Base Rate: 12.000%. When obtaining a Rare Pactspirit, there is a 30% chance it will be Letice
Magic Pactspirits Base Rate: 86.500%. When obtaining a Magic Pactspirit, there is a 30% chance it will be Shocket
The Legendary Pactspirit Monument Knight will only appear in this Boon and will not be available in any other Boon. The season-exclusive gameplay of the season-exclusive Pactspirit will be added to the Season Rotation Pool once the season comes to an end. And the chances of that season-exclusive gameplay appearing in the next season will be reduced. The exclusive Pactspirit is only available in the current pool.
The exclusive Pactspirit's effects remain valid permanently.

rows.season|season_des|201:
Background of the Season
: All worlds end in ashes... there is no exception. Beyond all the worlds exist the Sea of Void, a place filled with countless Aemberons who devour one another. They are... the last remnants of the old worlds.
But there are also those who kept on fighting the Aemberons even after the whole world had been Aemberized... until the very end. They did not give up their free will until their world was shattered and fell into the void. They were reduced to wandering souls in the Sea of Void, and their last will is to return to the "world of the living".
And in the endless void, there is an existence watching for its chance to enslave souls that wish to return-the Lord of Void Sea. He binds every soul that edges toward its original world with soul chains. And being pulled by hundreds of millions of souls, the Blacksail of the Void Sea sails along the Dark Surge toward those worlds that are yet to be broken.

New Gameplay
When Hunters defeat monsters in the Netherrealm map, they can earn drops with special affixes: Void Sea Night Flame.
Upon defeating the boss at the end of a stage, an interactive device will appear on the map: Void Sea Seal. You can break the seal with any Void Sea Night Flame to unlock a random Seal Whisper based on the affix of the Void Sea Night Flame.
After breaking six seals, Hunters can go to the Void Sea End Port to challenge the Bride of Void Sea. After completing the challenge, you can open the Bride's treasure. The content of the treasure will be affected by the "Seal Whispers" obtained when breaking the seal: Precious "Seal Whispers" can be combined to bring extremely rich rewards.
After being defeated, the Bride of Void Sea might drop a ticket: Void Sea Invitation. After collecting all Void Sea Invitations, you will be able to challenge the final boss of the season, Lord of Void Sea, who will drop several unique Legendary Items.

New Development System
During the adventure, hunters will have access to two new hero items: Hero Relics and Hero Memories.
Each Hunter can equip one Hero Relic, and each Hero Relic can have up to 3 engrams. Each engram can carry one Hero Memory.
Hero Relics and Hero Memories are generally specialization-limited and can provide powerful affixes that are closely related to the hero's specialization.

When certain skills are equipped (mostly Aura Skills and Triggered Skills), Mana will not be deducted when players use these skills. Instead, a portion of their Mana will enter an unusable state as the cost of using these skills. This is referred to as Sealed Mana. Similarly, Sealed Life is the process of sealing Life.

The sealing process does not change the Max Mana or Max Life.

A fixed amount of proportion of Mana and Life can be sealed. The amount of Mana or Life sealed is also affected by other skills and affixes.

rows.season|season_des|1441:
Season Background
The story begins with a legend from a time long forgotten.
"Once, in an age beyond memory, there lived a race that called the moon their home.
They were masters of song and dance. Every part of their being resonated like a fine instrument, producing melodies of sublime beauty.
But when the moon fell from the heavens, they turned into cold stone-statues scattered to the four winds.
It is said that these statues will awaken once more when the bright moon shines again. They will join you in a symphony of the full moon, offering treasures long lost to time.
So, Traveler, strum the Lunar Strings.
Call the moon to its zenith, turn the moonlight into song, and uncover the secrets sleeping inside the stone.
Tonight-let's shine together."

New Gameplay
Step into an area teeming with Lunar Stone Statues. Place the Lunar Ring at your feet to encompass as many statues as possible and Strum the Lunar Harp to awaken them, then take them down to earn instant drop rewards. The more statues you wake in one strum, the higher your Combo count, which results in greater Drop Quantity bonuses-and greater loot.
Lunar Omen events will appear at random, bringing both challenges and generous rewards. Fortunate Hunters may even stumble upon the game-changing Rhapsody gameplay-a twist that reshapes the "rhythm" you play and delivers a bountiful run you won't forget.
Install your Lunar Harp with various Lunar Strings to customize bonus effects and select the playstyle that perfectly matches your rhythm.

New Development System
Memory Revival is a crafting method that imbues Hero Memories with special powers.
Revival grants various effects to Hero Memories, increasing the values of their base affixes, upgrading Fixed Affixes, giving them special random affixes, and even adding a powerful Revived Affix.
Revived Affixes even include 1 or more unique Hero Trait Affixes tailored to each hero.

Install your Lunar Harp with various Lunar Strings to customize bonus effects and select the playstyle that perfectly matches your rhythm.

New Development System
Memory Revival is a crafting method that imbues Hero Memories with special powers.
Revival grants various effects to Hero Memories, increasing the values of their base affixes, upgrading Fixed Affixes, giving them special random affixes, and even adding a powerful Revived Affix.
Revived Affixes even include 1 or more unique Hero Trait Affixes tailored to each hero.

<RichText Id="3103">Collect Marks of the Ruins</><RichText>

The Fortune's Renewal event consists of 6 parts: Compass Pactspirit Card Pool, Memories Discount Event, Shop Direct Purchase Updates, Spring Festival Check In, Drop Event, and Exchange Shop.

[Compass Pactspirit Card Pool: More the Merrier]

[New Shop Direct Purchase: Spring Festival Special Appearance]
A new direct purchase pack is available in the Shop. Don't miss out!
Purchase to get Spring Festival exclusive teleport effects and drop effects.

[Spring Festival Check In: Spring Festival Treasure]
During the event, check in to get Pactspirit Crystal - Battle, up to 10 draws.

[Drop Event: Lucky Encounter]
During the event, a type of special monsters [Lucky Goblins] will appear in stages. They have a chance to drop Lucky rewards and Fortune's Pouches when defeated.
Collect a certain number of Fortune's Pouches to unlock amazing rewards.

[Exchange Shop: Lucky Boutique]
Use the collected items to get great rewards from the Exchange Shop.
The shop closes after the event ends, so please exchange them in time to avoid missing out on rewards.

rows.handbook|description|10550:
Spell Burst: Automatically casts a Spell Skill a certain number of times.
When Spell Burst is fully charged, casting Spell Skill will activate Spell Burst, which will consume all stacks of Spell Burst charged and automatically cast the Spell Skill the same number of times as the number of stacks consumed.
Skills that are cast by Spell Burst, skills that have a cooldown, as well as Summon, Sentry, and Channeled Skills cannot trigger Spell Burst.
The Spell Skill that activates the Spell Burst is considered a skill cast by Spell Burst.
Spell Burst Charge cannot go beyond Spell Burst's upper limit.
Spell Burst can only be cast when Max Spell Burst is no lower than 1.
Spell Burst will be fully charged within 2s. Spell Burst Charge Speed will increase the restoration speed of Spell Burst Charge.

Season Background
I walked through a door.
I was certain it was just that-a normal door.
Then I saw those... things. Ashen arms drifting in the air.
Deformed heads crashing to the ground.
Then a fish, its mouth gaping and closing, emitting the director's voice:
"Agent ■■■■■, I don't care what level of the Overrealm you're on, find a "Door" and get back here. Now!"
A door? Where?
I looked up. I looked down. I looked everywhere.
Turns out, it was inside the door.
But as I stepped through the door, it hit me:
My name isn't ■■■■■... and I've never met any director.

New Gameplay
You will find "Doors" within the Netherrealm. Defeating the monsters within these "Doors" grants a chance to enter the Overrealm.
Within the Overrealm, you must defeat monsters before time runs out, accumulate Containment Progress, and open doors to deeper levels. Only the best can reach the fourth and final level.
You can obtain drop bonus affixes called Bottled Shadows in the Overrealm. Stacking multiple instances of these affixes can lead to spectacular drops.
Unlocking Contained Objects in the Containment Dossier grants various practical bonuses, and also causes Contained Objects and Abnormalities that provide assistance or carry drops to appear in the Overrealm.

New Development System
Ethereal Prisms can be installed on Advanced Talent Panels within the Talent system.
An Ethereal Prism will override a single Talent Node, influencing surrounding Talents centered on that position and granting them additional effects.
An Ethereal Prism also provides bonus effects to the Core Talent on its current Advanced Talent Panel, or replaces it with a powerful new Core Talent.
With over 20 new Core Talents, you now have access to a wealth of new mechanics and attributes, providing the foundation for countless creative builds.
There's also a type of special Prism that possesses a remarkable mirroring ability. Based on the center point of the current Talent Panel, it can reflect Talent Nodes from one side to the other, with a chance to significantly enhance the effects of the mirrored Talent Nodes.
Within the Talent system, only one regular Prism and one special Prism can be installed, and the two can coexist.
Using Calibration Prism allows you to add random affixes to Ethereal Prisms, breaking free from traditional Talent constraints and customizing a Talent Panel tailored to your playstyle.
