rows.season|season_des|911:
Season Background
Take a moment to silently reflect on what you seek in your heart and mind, for the divination is about to begin.
You picked The Empress, The Chariot...
But before I reveal the meaning of your reading, I must ask you one last time...
Are you truly prepared to pay the price of peering into fate?
Knowing that the very future you wish to glimpse will be shaped by every tarot card you draw from this moment forward...
Do you still want to see it?

New Gameplay
Mysterious tarot cards are scattered throughout the Netherrealm stages, each one offering a glimpse into the threads of destiny. Over a dozen tarot-themed trials await daring Hunters, including The Chariot, The Emperor, The Hermit, and The Sun.
Upon completing each Tarot Trial, you will receive a Note of Arcana, a vital key to unlocking your full potential along the Tarot Path.
Beware, though-while the Tarot Path is lined with alluring Chests of Destiny, it is also riddled with traps.
The Notes of Arcana will guide your way, helping you steer clear of traps while helping you claim the Chests of Destiny you seek.
The ultimate challenge of fate starts when you want to open your Chests of Destiny.
At that time, the Tarot Trials corresponding to the Chests of Destiny will be revealed in turn.
When starting a specific wave of battle, the additional tarot themes will be applied to the new Tarot Trial.
Thus, the power of multiple tarot cards will be applied simultaneously as the battle intensifies.
Correspondingly, Hunters' rewards will accumulate to unforeseen heights in this wonderful trial.
The price that must be paid for the gifts of destiny has been marked, and the answer you seek lies in the tarot cards.

New Upgrade System
Hunters can form pacts with up to three Drop Pactspirits and three Battle Pactspirits.
In the Arcana gameplay, Hunters will obtain a variety of Destinies, each of which has different effects. Installing them in the corresponding Battle Pactspirit Talent Nodes will replace the original effects of the Talent Nodes and change destiny.
There are two types of Destinies: Fates and Kismets, with the exceptionally rare Dual Kismets offering even greater potential.
Fates grant Hunters regular stats such as Resistances, Mana Compensation, Curse effects, etc.
Kismets, on the other hand, grant rarer and more potent effects, paving the way for unique and powerful builds that can transform your playstyle.

rows.season|season_des|431:
Season Background
Legend has it that in our homeland, the eternal, invincible realm. The very barren, tainted land the world called Aeterna. Boundless riches and the secret of immortality are buried beneath the ruined facade. Our people wandered among the dense mist and broken walls, awaiting eternal grace. When candlelight burns again, the city that fell a thousand times shall be rebuilt, and the people who fell a thousand times shall stand once more. And who shall venture into the eternal Aeterna? Hunters who are destined to trample the myriad ruins of the Aeterna, yet refuse to yield to eternity. I see you treading toward the innermost candlelight.

New Gameplay
Interact with the Monument of Aeterna to enter the edge of Aeterna-the Ruins of Aeterna. In the ruins, Hunters must kindle candelabra in the allotted time for prizes and obtain a Mark of the Ruins that has the condition of all candelabra recorded on it.
Hunters must obtain more Marks of the Ruins and cover the map of Aeterna to rebuild the city. Once the city is rebuilt, its roads, landscape, and rewards will change. So, it brings a whole new experience each time it's rebuilt.
The new season features a brand new Major Season Talent. Gradually unlock all talents to obtain massive buffs and bonus rewards, expand the map of the city, and ultimately unlock the Infinite City of Aeterna.
After the Infinite City of Aeterna is unlocked, every time you clear the city will push it one step closer to reaching true eternity, making it even more dangerous. As the city becomes more dangerous, there will be more rewards too, and there's no limit to the city's tier.
The Lone King of Aeterna, a new supreme boss, is featured in the new season. He waits at the end of Aeterna, stoically watching everything you do in the city. When you dare usurp Aeterna, he will slay you without mercy.

New Development System
You will get a brand new item, Soul Candle, when exploring the city. You need to equip Soul Candles in the Skill panel. And they will nourish your soul and significantly improve skill effects.
A Soul Candle usually has 1 to 3 affixes of random tiers, but you can fuse them to upgrade, evolve, or even mutate their affixes.
Soul Candle Fusion, a new development system, has been added to the season. You can acquire a special item, Tear of Aeterna, from monsters in the city. By spending Tears of Aeterna, you can fuse two Soul Candles.
When fusing Soul Candles, affixes of identical effects and tiers from the two Soul Candles will be fused into one, and the remaining affixes will be either retained or discarded randomly.
When both Soul Candles have the same T1 affixes, the fused affix has a chance of evolving into a more powerful T0 affix with one guaranteed negative affix, and any T0 affix of the fused Soul Candle has a small chance of mutating into a rare, special affix.
Mutated affixes are very powerful, however, they can also have serious negative impacts on you. Therefore, you must balance the power and the negative effects brought by Soul Candles by making the most of the positive affixes and avoiding the negative affixes, using the potent but dangerous Soul Candles to your advantage.

rows.collection|unlocked_text|21004:
<RichText>Contract No.: QL-110227-113

To maintain public order in Lost City and practice the policy of General Dodge toward Alley of Wolves, the following terms are formulated after repeated consideration and careful arrangement:

1. Duties and Responsibilities
The parties agree to let </><RichText Id="1067">Lenny</><RichText> join the Wolf Gang and perform corresponding duties.

2. Term
One shall become a member of the Wolf Gang upon signing the contract. The Wolf Gang has the right to dismiss members who fail to perform their responsibilities. No member shall voluntarily leave the Wolf Gang for any reason.

3. Working Days and Hours
3.1 Regular rotating day-offs.
3.2 Be on call on duty days.
3.3 3.2 is prior than 3.1 in practice.

4. Wages
The Wolf Gang provide members with protection, weapons, meals, and lodging. There's no basic pay. Members get their dividends at the end of every month as their incomes. Members' dividend proportions are decided by the amount of protection fee they collected that month.

5. Deductions
5.1 Rental fees of weapons and gear. During the lease period, members shall maintain their weapons at their own expense. If the weapons are damaged, members shall pay for them at the original prices, and the renewal fees will be increased by 50%.
5.2 Members shall pay the membership fee on time every month. Those who miss the date shall pay an additional 50% of the membership fee as an overdue penalty. Members who are late to pay their membership fees 3 times in total will have all their personal assets confiscated and lose their memberships.

6. Termination
See the 2nd term.

Attention: Signing the contract means you have fully understood the meaning and corresponding consequences of all the terms, and that you have agreed to enter this contract in paper form with the other party and accept to be bound by this contract. The final explanation right is reserved by General Dodge.

Place of contract signing and performance: Alley of Wolves

Party A: Personnel Department of Alley of Wolves

Party B: Lenny</>

rows.season|season_des|742:
Season Background
During the distant Epoch of War, a warrior known as Ralph wielded his blade against thousands of formidable foes in the Eternal Coliseum of gold, and he reigned undefeated. Now, the Epoch of War is but a distant memory, yet his brave and fearless spirit still lives on and shines brilliantly like gold, even to this day. O' warrior, defeat the countless enemies roaming the Netherrealm, advance to the Eternal Coliseum's center, and win the unparalleled rewards of the Invincible Champion!

Combat Frenzy
Blessed by the God of War, the rare monsters in the stage have a chance to be upgraded into Gladiator monsters of various tiers. Defeat them to enlarge your physique, or upgrade your Life and Energy Shield to achieve the same effect.
As your Physique grows, your Skill Area increases, and your Minions deal more damage. Rush into a frenzy and grow endlessly stronger!

Precious Drops
All exclusive items' drop rates are tripled during the preseason. Enjoy the feeling of being surrounded by Precious drops!
In addition, Gladiator monsters drop precious Proofs of Champion. Use the Proofs of Champion to enter the Eternal Coliseum, defeat the countless enemies that await there, and claim the almighty commendations of the God of War!

rows.manual_rule_des|des|1000000820:
<RichText Id="3103">Conversion of the Type of Damage Dealt</><RichText>
The type of damage dealt can be converted. For example, "Converts 50% of Physical Damage to Fire Damage".
Only Hit Damage can be converted.
From low to high, the priority of damage types is as follows: Physical, Lightning, Cold, Fire, Erosion. Upon inflicting damage, the damage type can only be converted from a lower-priority damage type to a higher-priority damage type.
If the sum of the conversion percentages of multiple damage types from the same source exceeds 100%, such as when "Converts 60% of Physical Damage to Fire Damage" and "Converts 60% of Physical Damage to Cold Damage" take effect at the same time, the final converted damage will not exceed 100%, and the damage will be redistributed according to their weighted percentages.
Converted damage benefits from the bonuses of the original damage type and the bonuses of the post-conversion damage type. Non-additional bonuses can be stacked.
Frostfire Gemma - Ice-Fire Fusion's damage bonus conversion is a special bonus, and only one bonus can be generated in each damage calculation even if multiple damage types are converted.</>

rows.season|season_des|521:
Season Background
"The world of Torchlight is essentially an isolated island in a vast void, and countless terrifying and unknown creatures are lurking around us."
"Around us? More like they are lurking in our deepest and most secret dreams."
The wonderful thing about dreams is that you could be in a deep good dream or the claws of a nightmare...

New Gameplay
Hunters have a chance to enter a sweet dream when they interact with the Dream Lotus on the map.
After completing a Sweet Dream, Hunters will receive Dream Bubbles that contain rewards. Hunters will need to search for more lotuses to explore deeper levels of Sweet Dreams. Whenever a Sweet Dream level is completed, Hunters will inherit the rewards from the previous level and get the chance to further upgrade or increase these rewards.
At the same time, Hunters need to be vigilant as their chance of entering a Nightmare increases with each level of a Sweet Dream they complete. Hunters should be familiar with the Nightmares they encounter as they will receive the Nightmare Omens corresponding to the rewards they select on each level of a Sweet Dream, and these omens will come true in a Nightmare that can come for Hunters at any time. In other words, the higher the level of the Sweet Dream, the more dangers Hunters will face in Nightmares.
No matter how beautiful the rewards are in a dream, it could just be a bubble that can pop at any time. These bubbles will only come true after Hunters escape from the Nightmare.

New Development System
When exploring a dream, Hunters will get a new season item called Dream Talking. Whenever Hunters perform Dream Talking Interpretation, they will obtain a dream base, which includes a Sweet Dream affix and a Nightmare affix. The original base affixes on a piece of gear will be replaced when the dream base is recorded onto the gear. Sweet Dream base affixes grant powerful buffs, such as allowing Hunters to gain Legendary affixes that have only appeared on Legendary gear when crafting gear. Nightmare base affixes, on the other hand, grant negative affixes that may weaken the gear. Therefore, Hunters will need to choose the right time to perform Dream Talking Interpretation. While trying to get the Sweet Dream affixes they seek, Hunters will also need to take care to avoid the negative impact of Nightmare affixes.

The Queen of Eternal Sun, a new supreme boss, is featured in the new season. On a long night filled with chaotic dreams, she opens her eyes again and waits for warriors to sacrifice themselves for her.

rows.season|season_des|1021:
Season Background
Have you ever looked up at the sky and imagined thriving cities hidden among the islands floating in the clouds?
Loaded with supplies, Airships sail in the Desert Sea, shuttling between islands to trade treasures and wealth.
Yet beneath the seemingly calm quicksand lies a world of conflicts and raids.
Are you ready?
A Sand Bandit from your past has extended an invitation for you to become the master of Cloud Oasis.
Build, explore, and conquer this floating Oasis.
And become the most legendary Sandlord in the Desert Sea!


New Gameplay
Hunters can defeat Sand Pirates in the Netherrealm to gather resources for the Cloud Oasis-or even recruit them as laborers. In the Cloud Oasis, you can build and upgrade buildings, deploy laborers to produce resources, and send airships to trade resources for abundant rewards. Feeling bold? You can also deploy laborers on Gliders to raid Sand Pirates' Treasure Stashes to get rewards at no cost. The Cloud Oasis can operate on its own as long as it has enough resources. So sit back and watch your wealth grow!

New Upgrade System
In the Sandlord gameplay, you can trade to obtain precious Aromatic Materials and blend them according to recipes to grant a Belt unique Blending Affixes.
Blending Affixes can give you powerful bonuses, such as Medium Talents, Core Talents, and even Hero Trait Node of other Heroes.

rows.collection|unlocked_text|21101:
To my stupid fatass ex-leader Osen,

Thanks to you, I'm feeling fantastic.

I was really depressed when you forced me to go undercover in Silver Flames. But when I actually came here, I realized this was nothing but a wonderland!

For the first time in my life, I didn't have to act tough dealing with others. I didn't have to do all things to please people more senior than myself. I had hot food, instead of cold canned ones. For the first time, I helped an old man repair his roof, and he looked so happy and even gave me two fresh carrots.

I was scared of many things back in Wolf Packs. I was afraid of the night, afraid of missions. I was worried that the debtors didn't pay, and you could blame me. But now I'm not afraid of anything.

Well, of course you won't remember who I am. After all, I was only one of the dozens of undercover guys you sent here.

But I still want to tell you that my body and soul no longer have anything to do with your filthy Wolf Packs! To me, you are nothing but a dirty-minded pig swimming in dog poo with your fawning clowns!

F kin-good-bye, Wolf Packs!

An anonymous Silver Flames member who sincerely wishes you can f k yourselves

rows.season|season_des|1032:
Season Background
Have you ever looked up at the sky and imagined thriving cities hidden among the islands floating in the clouds?
Loaded with supplies, Airships sail in the Desert Sea, shuttling between islands to trade treasures and wealth.
Yet beneath the seemingly calm quicksand lies a world of conflicts and raids.
Are you ready?
A Sand Bandit from your past has extended an invitation for you to become the master of Cloud Oasis.
Build, explore, and conquer this floating Oasis.
And become the most legendary Sandlord in the Desert Sea!


New Gameplay
Hunters can defeat Sand Pirates in the Netherrealm to gather resources for the Cloud Oasis-or even recruit them as laborers. In the Cloud Oasis, you can build and upgrade buildings, deploy laborers to produce resources, and send airships to trade resources for abundant rewards. Feeling bold? You can also deploy laborers on Gliders to raid Sand Pirates' Treasure Stashes to get rewards at no cost. The Cloud Oasis can operate on its own as long as it has enough resources. So sit back and watch your wealth grow!

New Upgrade System
In the Sandlord gameplay, you can trade to obtain precious Aromatic Materials and blend them according to recipes to grant a Belt unique Blending Affixes.
Blending Affixes can give you powerful bonuses, such as Medium Talents, Core Talents, and even Hero Trait Node of other Heroes.

rows.season|season_des|1121:
Season Background
TOWER Co. is a megacorporation entrenched in Leptis. Originally founded as an arms factory of the old empire, it has managed to evolve into today's colossal conglomerate through Synthetic Troop technology.
In recent years, TOWER Co. has monopolized key resources, technologies, and basic infrastructure, as well as built a powerful private army for itself.
Under its oppression, righteous outlaws have risen up and become the vanguard against TOWER Co.
Outlaws, listen up! How'd you like to pull off a real robbery?

New Gameplay
TOWER Co.'s Transport Vehicles sit vulnerable in the Netherrealm-loaded with vault-bound riches.
In Carjack, the escort bodyguards will flee in waves with TOWER Supply Caches. You will need to chase them down and defeat their reinforcements within the time limit.
The more escort bodyguards you take down, the bigger your payout.
But don't take too long, because the Transport Vehicles and all security personnel might flee the scene if you do.
Before a Carjack, there's a chance that the Fixer from the Black Market will issue a Bounty Order. You can pay the required amount of TOWER Coins to accept the bounty and complete it to earn additional bounty rewards.
If hijacking convoys is too easy for you, it's time to hit TOWER Co. itself!
TOWER Co. Central Vault is the ultimate endgame challenge of the Outlaw season. Inside this heavily fortified complex, you'll find multiple secure strongrooms-raid as many as you can handle before time runs out, take down the vault's guardian boss, and claim the ultimate strongroom's legendary rewards.

New Upgrade System
R&D can be performed on non-Legendary weapons in the TOWER Sequence system to obtain powerful TOWER Sequences.
To perform R&D, Hunters must spend a set number of Mods. During R&D, Hunters can choose from several chips of random colors in each round. If the colors of the chips you chose match the target sequence (in any order) after all selections have been made, you'll obtain the effects of the target sequence.
There are 2 types of R&D: Basic R&D and In-Depth R&D.
Basic R&D only yields Basic sequences and Intermediate sequences. Advanced sequences can only be obtained from In-Depth R&D. Each weapon can only have 1 sequence, but Hunters can perform R&D repeatedly until the desired target sequence is obtained.
TOWER sequences grant Hunters regular stats and provide core mechanics that can inspire many fantastic builds.

New Gameplay
Hijack TOWER Transport Vehicles in the Netherrealm and chase down the escort bodyguards who are fleeing with the payload and take down their reinforcements within a limited time.
Break into the heavily guarded TOWER Co. and blast open vaults to loot as much treasure as you can!

New Upgrade System
Craft a TOWER Sequence for non-Legendary weapons and shields. During the crafting process, you'll get to choose from several chips of random colors in each round. rows.collection|unlocked_text|10001:
The black crystals that can be found all over the world with sharp spikes are called Aember.

In a sense, Aember is alive. It is strongly erosive with the ability to parasitize and assimilate almost everything, eventually turning it into a new Aember.

Creatures infected by Aember tend to gain inhuman strength in a very time. Aember changes their body and keeps eroding their consciousness, making them empty unthinking shells gradually.

Finally, new Aember grows out of their rotten bodies, starting a new cycle on such filthy hotbeds.

The 21 boss stages in Supreme Showdown represent the ultimate challenge in Torchlight: Infinite.
Each of these 21 stages has a unique boss and enticing rewards, but the difficulty increases with each stage.
In addition to getting basic rewards for clearing the stages, you will also get Star Rating rewards for clearing the stages within the specified time. The quicker you clear higher levels with top star ratings, the better your chances of climbing the rankings.
Supreme Showdown is updated once every season, bringing new rewards and new combat mechanics.
If the character is defeated in Supreme Showdown while playing in Hardcore Mode or Solo Self Found Hardcore Mode, the character will still remain available for the current season.
Rewards for this gameplay can only be claimed in Normal Mode on seasonal servers.

rows.gacha|des|8002:
In general, the base rate is applied to all Pactspirits. For Rate Up and Minimum Guarantee, the rates are subject to actual rules.
[Boon Rules]
The base rate of acquiring a Legendary Pactspirits is 1.500%. If you fail to obtain any Legendary Pactspirit after 50 Boons, the next Boon's rate of yielding a Legendary Pactspirit will be increased from 1.500% to 3.000%, and if this Boon doesn't yield a Legendary Pactspirit either, then the chance of obtaining a Legendary Pactspirit with the next Boon will be increased from 3.000% to 4.500%. This process repeats itself with a 1.500% rate increase for every Boon until the rate of acquiring a Legendary Pactspirit reaches 100.000%. Once a Legendary Pactspirit is obtained, the next Boon's chance will be reset to the base rate.

For every 10 Boons, at least 1 Pactspirit that is Rare or better is guaranteed.

[Rate Ups]
When the PYO (Pick-Your-Own) feature is enabled, you can pick a designated amount of Pactspirits in the Pactspirit List to get a 50.000% chance to obtain the Pactspirits you picked (if you picked multiple Pactspirits, they will share the chance equally). If that doesn't get you a Pactspirit you picked after getting 1 Legendary Pactspirit, the next Legendary Pactspirit you get from Boons is guaranteed to be a Pactspirit you picked. The count will be reset once a Pactspirit you picked is obtained.

[Duplicate Pactspirits]
When you receive Duplicate Pactspirits, they will be converted into a certain amount of Pactspirit Proofs. Surplus Proofs can be traded for Insight Essence at the in-game shop.

[Boon Item List]
Legendary Pactspirits Base Rate: 1.500%
Rare Pactspirits Base Rate: 12.000%, Dragon Plant - Kale's base rate is double the base rate of other Rare Pactspirits
Magic Pactspirits Base Rate: 86.500%, Feasting Samurai - Orange's base rate is double the base rate of other Magic Pactspirits
The Legendary Pactspirit Swaying Bonnie will only appear in this Boon and will not be available in any other Boon.

rows.system_help|description|24:
1. A Trait Deck can consist of up to 10 Trait Cards from the Trait Card Library.
2. Whenever you open a Netherrealm stage in a plane, all affix effects of all cards in the Trait Deck will be applied to that stage. The exceptions are stages with the Plane Watcher, Traveler, and Great Void in them.
3. At the end of each round of Chaos Invasion, players can choose to add a new Trait Card to the Card Library or upgrade 1 existing Trait Card.
4. While accumulating Confusion Cards, there are also opportunities to select additional Trait Cards.
5. Some Trait Cards can only be obtained at a higher Timemark.

rows.collection|unlocked_text|20901:
After spending three days on the Church walls, I finally understand how their Light Magic Traps work.

There are many different traps, but most can be classified into three types: Attack, Block, and Portal. In other words, the "touch-it-and-it-hits-you", the "annoying roadblock", and the "calling-for-help". In all the historical text I have collected, light magic has always been focusing on healing, cleansing, and protection. The Church surely has done an excellent job "developing" it.

But right now I have a bigger problem to solve. Just after I finally contained my acrophobia and was about to leave the walls using my "Compact Ember Floating Device", a trap on the wall was suddenly activated and shot a light magic round at me! The last thing I remember is my strong and powerful body slamming hard on the wall...

rows.season|season_des|642:
Season Background
During the distant Epoch of War, a warrior known as Ralph wielded his blade against thousands of formidable foes in the Eternal Coliseum of gold, and he reigned undefeated. Now, the Epoch of War is but a distant memory, yet his brave and fearless spirit still lives on and shines brilliantly like gold, even to this day. O' warrior, defeat the countless enemies roaming the Netherrealm, advance to the Eternal Coliseum's center, and win the unparalleled rewards of the Invincible Champion!

Combat Frenzy
Blessed by the God of War, the rare monsters in the stage have a chance to be upgraded into Gladiator monsters of various tiers. Defeat them to enlarge your physique, or upgrade your Life and Energy Shield to achieve the same effect.
As your Physique grows, your Skill Area increases, and your Minions deal more damage. Rush into a frenzy and grow endlessly stronger!

Precious Drops
All exclusive items' drop rates are tripled during the preseason. Enjoy the feeling of being surrounded by Precious drops!
In addition, Gladiator monsters drop precious Proofs of Champion. Use the Proofs of Champion to enter the Eternal Coliseum, defeat the countless enemies that await there, and claim the almighty commendations of the God of War!

rows.gacha|des|3003:
In general, the base rate is applied to all Pactspirits. For Rate Up and Minimum Guarantee, the rates are subject to actual rules.
[Boon Rules]
The base rate of acquiring a Legendary Pactspirits is 1.500%. If you fail to obtain any Legendary Pactspirit after 10 Boons, the next Boon's rate of yielding a Legendary Pactspirit will be increased from 1.500% to 3.000%, and if this Boon doesn't yield a Legendary Pactspirit either, then the chance of obtaining a Legendary Pactspirit with the next Boon will be increased from 3.000% to 4.500%. This process repeats itself with a 1.500% rate increase for every Boon until the rate of acquiring a Legendary Pactspirit reaches 100.000%. Once a Legendary Pactspirit is obtained, the next Boon's chance will be reset to the base rate.

For every 10 Boons, at least 1 Pactspirit that is Rare or better is guaranteed.

[Rate Ups]
When the PYO (Pick-Your-Own) feature is enabled, you can pick a designated amount of Pactspirits in the Pactspirit List to get a 75.000% chance to obtain the Pactspirits you picked (if you picked multiple Pactspirits, they will share the chance equally). If that doesn't get you a Pactspirit you picked after getting a Legendary Pactspirit, the next Legendary Pactspirit you get from Boons is guaranteed to be a Pactspirit you picked. The count will be reset once a Pactspirit you picked is obtained. The overall drop rate for Exclusive Legendary Pactspirits is 4.670%.

[Duplicate Pactspirits]
When you receive Duplicate Pactspirits, they will be converted into a certain amount of Pactspirit Proofs. Surplus Proofs can be traded for Insight Essence at the in-game shop

[Boon Item List]
Legendary Pactspirits Base Rate: 1.500%
Rare Pactspirits Base Rate: 12.000%
Magic Pactspirits Base Rate: 86.500%
Hunter's Odyssey will not be part of the regular gameplay, but it may return in future Preseasons
After the event concludes, there will be no other methods to acquire Corgi Fighter No.32, and after obtaining 6 Corgi Fighter No.32s, this Boon will automatically end.

rows.system_help|description|50:
1. The Lunar Harp is a key item for activating Lunar Stone Statues and can be upgraded by leveling it up or equipping Lunar Strings.

2. Level up the Lunar Harp by defeating Lunari monsters at a corresponding difficulty to gain XP. The Lunar Harp automatically levels up when it reaches the required XP (max Lv. 5). Leveling up the Lunar Harp further increases the Drop Quantity Bonus granted by the Combo count and unlocks new Lunar String slots.

3. Lunar Strings are a special item that amplifies the abilities of the Lunar Harp (cannot be traded or replicated when dropped). Each unique Lunar String carries a unique special effect and 2 random affixes. Picked up Lunar Strings are placed in your Lunar String Inventory and must be equipped in a Lunar String slot to be activated.

4. When entering a low-level stage with a high-level Lunar Harp equipped, the Lunar Harp's level may be temporarily reduced (which causes parts that require a corresponding level to unlock to become ineffective).

rows.season|season_des|1411:
Season Background
The story begins with a legend from a time long forgotten.
"Once, in an age beyond memory, there lived a race that called the moon their home.
They were masters of song and dance. Every part of their being resonated like a fine instrument, producing melodies of sublime beauty.
But when the moon fell from the heavens, they turned into cold stone-statues scattered to the four winds.
It is said that these statues will awaken once more when the bright moon shines again. They will join you in a symphony of the full moon, offering treasures long lost to time.
So, Traveler, strum the Lunar Strings.
Call the moon to its zenith, turn the moonlight into song, and uncover the secrets sleeping inside the stone.
Tonight-let's shine together."

New Gameplay
Step into an area teeming with Lunar Stone Statues. Place the Lunar Ring at your feet to encompass as many statues as possible and Strum the Lunar Harp to awaken them, then take them down to earn instant drop rewards. The more statues you wake in one strum, the higher your Combo count, which results in greater Drop Quantity bonuses-and greater loot.
Lunar Omen events will appear at random, bringing both challenges and generous rewards. Fortunate Hunters may even stumble upon the game-changing Rhapsody gameplay-a twist that reshapes the "rhythm" you play and delivers a bountiful run you won't forget.
Install your Lunar Harp with various Lunar Strings to customize bonus effects and select the playstyle that perfectly matches your rhythm.

New Development System
Memory Revival is a crafting method that imbues Hero Memories with special powers.
Revival grants various effects to Hero Memories, increasing the values of their base affixes, upgrading Fixed Affixes, giving them special random affixes, and even adding a powerful Revived Affix.
Revived Affixes even include 1 or more unique Hero Trait Affixes tailored to each hero.

rows.system_help|description|28:
1. The Dream Cloud Atlas has many nodes, which can unlock or change features of the Twinightmare gameplay, or increase the rewards of this mode.

2. There are 2 types of nodes: inner nodes and outer nodes. For each point you allocate to inner nodes, you must allocate 2 points to outer nodes before you can allocate more points to inner nodes, and vice versa. The 2 initial points for inner nodes and the last 10 points for outer nodes are not subject to this restriction.

3. Each node has a corresponding Lotus Seed activation cost. Every time you pass a Sweet Dream's trial, the Lotus Seed Progress will be increased by 1. The progress will be displayed right below your current number of Lotus Seeds on the screen. When the progress is full, you will gain 1 Lotus Seed. Lotus Seed Progress will no longer be increased or displayed after you have gained enough Lotus Seeds to activate all the nodes.

4. Nodes can be reset at any time, as many times as you like. All Lotus Seeds will be returned to you when you reset the nodes.

5. You can enter the Cloud Atlas and adjust the nodes at any time through the Twinightmare screen or by talking to Daydreamer - Patty in the Town. Adjustments made to nodes will take effect after the next Dream reset.

rows.system_help|description|52:
Rules:
1. This is a limited-time mode with a base global countdown of 3 minutes.
2. Continuously push through maps within the time limit, accumulate Challenge Progress, and defeat the final boss to unlock higher tiers based on your performance.
3. The faster you clear and the fewer deaths you suffer, the larger the difficulty tier jump you can unlock when settling. Higher levels cleared in less time also give better leaderboard weight.

Gameplay Flow:
1. In each map, the Challenger must defeat enemies to build Challenge Progress. Once progress is full, the final boss spawns. Defeat it to complete the challenge.
2. Maps have a chance to spawn random challenges. Completing them grants large amounts of Challenge Progress or combat buffs.

If the character is defeated in this gameplay while playing in Hardcore Mode or Solo Self Found Hardcore Mode, the character will still remain available for the current season.
Rewards for this gameplay can only be claimed in Normal Mode on seasonal servers.

rows.gacha|des|311001:
In general, the base rate is applied to all Pactspirits. For Rate Up and Minimum Guarantee, the rates are subject to actual rules.
[Boon Rules]
The base rate of acquiring a Legendary Pactspirits is 1.500%. If you fail to obtain any Legendary Pactspirit after 50 Boons, the next Boon's rate of yielding a Legendary Pactspirit will be increased from 1.500% to 3.000%, and if this Boon doesn't yield a Legendary Pactspirit either, then the chance of obtaining a Legendary Pactspirit with the next Boon will be increased from 3.000% to 4.500%. This process repeats itself with a 1.500% rate increase for every Boon until the rate of acquiring a Legendary Pactspirit reaches 100.000%. Once a Legendary Pactspirit is obtained, the next Boon's chance will be reset to the base rate.

After this Boon ends, should it return in a future season, its draw attempts will be retained. If added to the Past Memories, the draw attempts will be reset.

For every 10 Boons, at least 1 Pactspirit that is Rare or better is guaranteed.

[Rate Ups]
When the PYO (Pick-Your-Own) feature is enabled, you can pick a designated amount of Pactspirits in the Pactspirit List to get a 50.000% chance to obtain the Pactspirits you picked (if you picked multiple Pactspirits, they will share the chance equally). If that doesn't get you a Pactspirit you picked after getting 1 Legendary Pactspirit, the next Legendary Pactspirit you get from Boons is guaranteed to be a Pactspirit you picked. The count will be reset once a Pactspirit you picked is obtained.

[Duplicate Pactspirits]
When you receive Duplicate Pactspirits, they will be converted into a certain amount of Pactspirit Proofs. Surplus Proofs can be traded for Insight Essence at the in-game shop

[Boon Item List]
Legendary Pactspirits Base Rate: 1.500%
Rare Pactspirits Base Rate: 12.000%.
Magic Pactspirits Base Rate: 86.500%.
The Legendary Pactspirit Prof. SOURCE will only appear in this Boon and will not be available in any other Boon. The season-exclusive gameplay of the season-exclusive Pactspirit will be added to the Season Rotation Pool once the season comes to an end. And the chances of that season-exclusive gameplay appearing in the next season will be reduced. The exclusive Pactspirit is only available in the current pool.
The exclusive Pactspirit's effects remain valid permanently.

rows.collection|unlocked_text|10801:
I sneaked into the group that was going to meet the Dwarf King, just to see that young king reveling in the attention of being surrounded by thousands.

But he is blind. I mean, he has been blinded by the glory of the ancient dwarves and the flames of desire ignited by the Spark, and thus he cannot see what is occurring right by his side. He speaks of the Dwarven Kingdom's future, yet he exhausts its present.

I think it's time to put an end to my journey. After reading through what my ancestors left to the world, I have fully understood the history of the Epoch of Might. Maybe I will write it all down in the near future.

I have translated my ancestors' words into the common tongue of this land. I may have altered the style a little, but the content has remained mostly unchanged. I hope one day someone will find out those words from my journal. The sacrifice of heroes must be remembered by the world.

rows.season|season_des|1342:
Season Background
A strange disease called Vorax has infected the monsters of Leptis!
Once infected, they turn crimson and enter a state of extreme hyperactivity and frenzy. They even devour each other, absorbing the endlessly multiplying diseased tissue within their bodies to evolve into more powerful and grotesque monstrosities.
As the crisis looms, Mad Doctor Shelley's underground clinic officially opens for business!

New Gameplay
This clinic is home to the best Vorax specialist in all of Leptis!
The first stage of treatment is to find suitable patients. Defeat Vorax Elites in Netherrealm stages to collect the Vorax Substance on them. Obtaining sufficiently potent doses of Vorax Substances is the foundation of treatment.
The second stage of treatment is to visit Mad Doctor Shelley's underground clinic to start the Surgical Preparation phase.
Here, Hunters will perform surgeries on Vorax-infected monsters in preparation for further surgeries in different directions based on monsters' diverse racial talents.
During this stage, Hunters can choose freely from dozens of Surgical Instruments and Potions, combining them in various ways to gradually cultivate the ultimate Vorax host.
Each race has extremely rare Special Potions. These Special Potions provide a set of special medications, which increase in potency with each round, until a miraculous Potion with super high Ultimate Activity is created.
The surgery officially begins in the third stage of treatment!
Hunters will now have to dispose of the powerful monsters they just created.
Defeat them to recover precious Vorax antidotes from their bodies and exchange them for corresponding rewards.
Antidote Vials in the Operating Theater will fill up as more monsters are defeated, and the rewards earned by exchanging them become increasingly better as their potency increases.

New Development System
Grafting lets Hunters craft Vorax Gear-unrestricted by Strength, Intelligence, or Dexterity, with a shared affix pool across different parts, and even capable of holding Legendary affixes.
Use Normal Organs to add Basic or Advanced affixes to Vorax Gear. Use Special Organs to add Ultimate affixes to Vorax Gear. Use Core Organs and Sutures to add Legendary affixes to Vorax Gear.
Vorax Corrosion increases the tier of Vorax Gear affixes, potentially increasing all pre-fixes and suffixes by 1 - 2 tiers.

rows.season|season_des|942:
Season Background
Take a moment to silently reflect on what you seek in your heart and mind, for the divination is about to begin.
You picked The Empress, The Chariot...
But before I reveal the meaning of your reading, I must ask you one last time...
Are you truly prepared to pay the price of peering into fate?
Knowing that the very future you wish to glimpse will be shaped by every tarot card you draw from this moment forward...
Do you still want to see it?

New Gameplay
Mysterious tarot cards are scattered throughout the Netherrealm stages, each one offering a glimpse into the threads of destiny. Over a dozen tarot-themed trials await daring Hunters, including The Chariot, The Emperor, The Hermit, and The Sun.
Upon completing each Tarot Trial, you will receive a Note of Arcana, a vital key to unlocking your full potential along the Tarot Path.
Beware, though-while the Tarot Path is lined with alluring Chests of Destiny, it is also riddled with traps.
The Notes of Arcana will guide your way, helping you steer clear of traps while helping you claim the Chests of Destiny you seek.
The ultimate challenge of fate starts when you want to open your Chests of Destiny.
At that time, the Tarot Trials corresponding to the Chests of Destiny will be revealed in turn.
When starting a specific wave of battle, the additional tarot themes will be applied to the new Tarot Trial.
Thus, the power of multiple tarot cards will be applied simultaneously as the battle intensifies.
Correspondingly, Hunters' rewards will accumulate to unforeseen heights in this wonderful trial.
The price that must be paid for the gifts of destiny has been marked, and the answer you seek lies in the tarot cards.

New Upgrade System
Hunters can form pacts with up to three Drop Pactspirits and three Battle Pactspirits.
In the Arcana gameplay, Hunters will obtain a variety of Destinies, each of which has different effects. Installing them in the corresponding Battle Pactspirit Talent Nodes will replace the original effects of the Talent Nodes and change destiny.
There are two types of Destinies: Fates and Kismets, with the exceptionally rare Dual Kismets offering even greater potential.
Fates grant Hunters regular stats such as Resistances, Mana Compensation, Curse effects, etc.
Kismets, on the other hand, grant rarer and more potent effects, paving the way for unique and powerful builds that can transform your playstyle.

rows.season|season_des|732:
Season Background
During the distant Epoch of War, a warrior known as Ralph wielded his blade against thousands of formidable foes in the Eternal Coliseum of gold, and he reigned undefeated. Now, the Epoch of War is but a distant memory, yet his brave and fearless spirit still lives on and shines brilliantly like gold, even to this day. O' warrior, defeat the countless enemies roaming the Netherrealm, advance to the Eternal Coliseum's center, and win the unparalleled rewards of the Invincible Champion!

Combat Frenzy
Blessed by the God of War, the rare monsters in the stage have a chance to be upgraded into Gladiator monsters of various tiers. Defeat them to enlarge your physique, or upgrade your Life and Energy Shield to achieve the same effect.
As your Physique grows, your Skill Area increases, and your Minions deal more damage. Rush into a frenzy and grow endlessly stronger!

Precious Drops
All exclusive items' drop rates are tripled during the preseason. Enjoy the feeling of being surrounded by Precious drops!
In addition, Gladiator monsters drop precious Proofs of Champion. Use the Proofs of Champion to enter the Eternal Coliseum, defeat the countless enemies that await there, and claim the almighty commendations of the God of War!

rows.season|season_des|842:
Season Background
Unfold a piece of cold Snowpaper and apply colorful Paint to the white snow.
Breathe life into everything as you fill in the snowy landscape with colors.
Eventually, the empty frozen canvas becomes a vibrant work of art.
After the last brush falls, the painter also becomes part of the painting.
What magnificent scenery awaits the one who created the world on this frozen canvas and entered it?

New Gameplay
After collecting Snowpaper Fragments in the Netherrealm, Hunters will select a difficulty and consume these fragments to unfold the canvas. After the canvas is unfolded, Hunters will need to defeat monsters in Netherrealm stages of the corresponding difficulty to collect various colors and types of Paint.
Hunters will need to place the corresponding Paints in the appropriate areas according to the Coloring Paint instructions, upgrade the Paints, and obtain new Coloring Paints until the canvas is completed.
After the painting is completed, Hunters can enter the frozen canvas of their painting to challenge monsters created from paint and the gameplay to get Splendor Eggs containing various rewards.

New Development System
Several Exclusive Support Skills have been added for most Active Skills, increasing the damage dealt by these skills and changing their form, giving them many unexpected amazing effects that will enrich Hunters' combat experience.
Collect Exclusive Support Skills and Inspiration Essences that are used to upgrade skills from the Frozen Canvas gameplay to create more powerful, more diverse, and more creative new builds.
rows.manual_rule_des|des|600001152:
<RichText>The Drop Quantity bonus affects the quantity of base items dropped.
The Drop Quantity bonus and additional Drop Quantity bonus do not apply to all items dropped. Refer to the corresponding gameplay for details on which items are not affected by these bonuses (such as items obtained from Cubes of Rapacity, Dream Bubbles, Chests of Folklores, Splendor Eggs, etc.)

Calculation
Final expected Drop Quantity = Original expected Drop Quantity x (1 + Drop Quantity bonus 1 + Drop Quantity bonus 2 + Drop Quantity bonus 3 +...) x (1 + additional Drop Quantity bonus 1) x (1 + additional Drop Quantity bonus 2) x (1 + additional Drop Quantity bonus 3) x...
Note: The Drop Quantity does not affect the weight distribution of each item in the drop library.

The following are examples of drops in different situations:
Example 1: If a drop has a 100% chance to drop 1 item, and the item has a 100% chance to be a Flame Elementium, then with "+100% Drop Quantity," there is a 100% chance to drop 2 Flame Elementium.
Example 2: If a drop has a 100% chance to drop 1 item, and the item has a 100% chance to be a Flame Elementium, then with "+100% Drop Quantity" and "+100% additional Drop Quantity," there is a 100% chance to drop 4 Flame Elementium.
Example 3: If a drop has a 50% chance to drop 1 item, and the item has a 100% chance to be a Flame Elementium, then with "+100% Drop Quantity," there is a 25% chance to drop no items, 50% chance to drop 1 Flame Elementium, and 25% to drop 2 Flame Elementium.
Example 4: If a drop has a 50% chance to drop 1 item, and the item has a 50% chance to be a Flame Elementium and a 50% chance to be a Flame Sand, then with "+100% Drop Quantity," there is a 25% chance to drop no items, 25% chance to drop 1 Flame Elementium, 25% chance to drop 1 Flame Sand, 6.25% chance to drop 2 Flame Elementium, 6.25% to drop 2 Flame Sand, and 12.5% chance to drop 1 Flame Elementium and 1 Flame Sand.
Example 5: If a drop has a 100% chance to drop 1 item, and the item has a 100% chance to be a Flame Elementium, then with "-50% Drop Quantity," there is a 50% chance to drop no items and a 50% chance to drop 1 Flame Elementium.</>

rows.season|season_des|601:
Season Background
I am lost within the mist.
I cannot find my way back.
Who extinguished my lantern? Who's calling out my name?
I break the hands of the Clock Tower and tear open the mist.
Then, I saw you.
At that time, I was still you.

New Gameplay
Defeat the Mistville "Residents" in the Netherrealm and journey to Mistville. Dispel the mist with Sanity and face various random events to eventually arrive at the Clock Tower. Complete Advent of Folklores in the Clock Tower to receive a Chest of Folklores that contains various rewards. After that, Hunters must welcome a new day from the bench.
Hunters will find all kinds of Food and Old Stuff while exploring Mistville. Use them well to change your exploration experience and even increase drop quantity.
The new season features brand new Season Talents. Hunters must collect Mistville Intel to gradually unlock these Talents and make exploring Mistville easier than ever.

New Development System
The new season features a batch of brand new skills called Activation Medium Skills. They are often closely linked to auto-triggering, allowing them to significantly simplify gameplay and improve your experience.
Hunters can obtain various Activation Medium Skills from Whispering Mist, and use them to create new, surprising, and powerful builds.

rows.season|season_des|1011:
Season Background
Have you ever looked up at the sky and imagined thriving cities hidden among the islands floating in the clouds?
Loaded with supplies, Airships sail in the Desert Sea, shuttling between islands to trade treasures and wealth.
Yet beneath the seemingly calm quicksand lies a world of conflicts and raids.
Are you ready?
A Sand Bandit from your past has extended an invitation for you to become the master of Cloud Oasis.
Build, explore, and conquer this floating Oasis.
And become the most legendary Sandlord in the Desert Sea!


New Gameplay
Hunters can defeat Sand Pirates in the Netherrealm to gather resources for the Cloud Oasis-or even recruit them as laborers. In the Cloud Oasis, you can build and upgrade buildings, deploy laborers to produce resources, and send airships to trade resources for abundant rewards. Feeling bold? You can also deploy laborers on Gliders to raid Sand Pirates' Treasure Stashes to get rewards at no cost. The Cloud Oasis can operate on its own as long as it has enough resources. So sit back and watch your wealth grow!

New Upgrade System
In the Sandlord gameplay, you can trade to obtain precious Aromatic Materials and blend them according to recipes to grant a Belt unique Blending Affixes.
Blending Affixes can give you powerful bonuses, such as Medium Talents, Core Talents, and even Hero Trait Node of other Heroes.

rows.gacha|des|102:
In general, the base rate is applied to all Pactspirits. For Rate Up and Minimum Guarantee, the rates are subject to actual rules.
[Boon Rules]
The base rate of acquiring a Legendary Pactspirits is 1.500%. If you fail to obtain any Legendary Pactspirit after 50 Boons, the next Boon's rate of yielding a Legendary Pactspirit will be increased from 1.500% to 3.000%, and if this Boon doesn't yield a Legendary Pactspirit either, then the chance of obtaining a Legendary Pactspirit with the next Boon will be increased from 3.000% to 4.500%. This process repeats itself with a 1.500% rate increase for every Boon until the rate of acquiring a Legendary Pactspirit reaches 100.000%. Once a Legendary Pactspirit is obtained, the next Boon's chance will be reset to the base rate.

For every 10 Boons, at least 1 Pactspirit that is Rare or better is guaranteed.

[Rate Ups]
When the PYO (Pick-Your-Own) feature is enabled, you can pick a designated amount of Pactspirits in the Pactspirit List to get a 25.000% chance to obtain the Pactspirits you picked (if you picked multiple Pactspirits, they will share the chance equally). If that doesn't get you a Pactspirit you picked after getting 3 Legendary Pactspirits, the next Legendary Pactspirit you get from Boons is guaranteed to be a Pactspirit you picked. The count will be reset once a Pactspirit you picked is obtained.

[Duplicate Pactspirits]
When you receive Duplicate Pactspirits, they will be converted into a certain amount of Pactspirit Proofs. Surplus Proofs can be traded for Insight Essence at the in-game shop.
[Boon Item List]
Legendary Pactspirits Base Rate: 1.500%
Rare Pactspirits Base Rate: 12.000%. When obtaining a Rare Pactspirit, there is a 30% chance it will be Plaintive Ball of Thread - Flower
Magic Pactspirits Base Rate: 86.500%. When obtaining a Magic Pactspirit, there is a 30% chance it will be Luluri - Green Leaf.
This Boon is a Designated Pactspirit Pool. All Designated Pactspirit Pools share the rate up effects and Minimum Guarantee chances (not including the PYO feature's remaining amount of attempts) and are independent from other Boons' rate up effects and Minimum Guarantee chances. Season Pactspirits are exclusive to the Designated Pactspirit Pool and will not be available in any other Boon. Season Pactspirit will be added to the Season Rotation Pool once the corresponding season-exclusive gameplay comes to an end. And the chances of that season-exclusive gameplay appearing in the next season will be reduced. The exclusive Pactspirit is only available in the current pool.
The exclusive Pactspirit's effects remain valid permanently.

rows.collection|unlocked_text|20302:
The beginning of the Church could be traced all the way back to the Epoch of Knowledge.

When the great flood destroyed the world, all land creatures were facing imminent extinction. The descendants of the ancient gods built a floating island with Ember to keep them alive. 

The descendants saw themselves as the creators, and later created giants and sirens who could better adapt to the flood, as well as another species with no particular strength, the humans.

Humans had inherited the qualities of all races in the world, both good and bad. But they were too weak to survive the flood alone and must rely on the descendants to live on the floating island.

The descendants, on the other hand, were too arrogant to care about anything else other than their research and creations.

Eventually, this utopia in the clouds ended in riots and conflicts.

After the floating island crashed, humans and other creatures returned to the land and continued to live on small land blocks formed by dead giants.

A great scholar and his followers protected some descendant books during the crash as they believed these would be invaluable wisdom.

He started to interpret oracles from the books and study light magic. With the support of his followers, he formed his own organization, the St. Duran Church. 

The theory of light magic relied on building connections between the spirit and all the objects, and its power mostly came from the faith and devotion of believers.

The Church inherited the descendants' legacy and continued to dispel beasts and monsters, and heal the wounded with their light magic. As more believers started to follow the Church, its power started to rise. At one time, it was almost as powerful as the king.

Kingdoms rose and fell, but the Church had always played a vital role in the human history until humans realized they could live a decent life without prayers, thanks to the development of Ember Tech.

The Church was in decline, but the gods eventually punished the disbelievers. As the First Flame shattered, the Empire collapsed in the outbreak of Aember, and the Church regained its power.

Arcbishop Derrick found one remaining Spark after a long struggle, and built the Holy Capital, a divine city of absolute peace and order that was immune to Aember.

St. Duran now resembles the perfect floating island in the Epoch of Knowledge, but the Church will not allow history to repeat itself.

It must seek a way to change the world.

Perhaps the merciful light will return to this land once again in the near future.

rows.collection|unlocked_text|30503:
...The rocks here were obviously deliberately arranged to withstand the wild wind in the area at certain times. The pore structure of these rocks, their hard texture, as well as heat and weather Resistance all indicate that they are volcanic rocks formed when hot magma was expelled from the crater and condensed on the surface.

They remind me of the volcanic glass at Star's Fall. These volcanic rocks couldn't come out of nowhere to simply block the wind, Maybe... I can't help but wonder if these ancient stones were here before the desert formed.

Could it be that the gravel buried a volcano instead of the rocks somehow ended up in the desert? Now that I think about it, the wind here does seem to have some of the volcanic mineral mixed with the gravel.

Hot, mineral-rich craters are indeed more like dragon habitats than deserts…

rows.TextTable_GameFunc|value|Func_Login_Righ:
1. This game is a dark dungeon action role-playing mobile game, suitable for users aged 12 and above. It is recommended that minors use the game product under the supervision of their parents. 

2. The game tells that after the original fire was shattered, the world was eroded by evil embers. The player plays a hero belonging to the Torchlight organization. A story of dangerous monsters, unraveling the plot of an evil organization, and gradually revealing a deeper truth. 

3. There is a user real-name authentication system in this game. Users without real names are not allowed to enter the game. Users who are authenticated as minors will be subject to the following management:
 Some gameplay and props in the game require payment. Users under the age of 8 cannot pay; for minor users over the age of 8 but under the age of 16, the single recharge amount shall not exceed RMB 50, and the cumulative monthly recharge amount shall not exceed RMB 200; minor users over the age of 16 For users, the single recharge amount shall not exceed RMB 100, and the accumulated monthly recharge amount shall not exceed RMB 400. 
Underage users can only play games from 20:00 to 21:00 every day on Friday, Saturday, Sunday and legal holidays, and are not allowed to use it at other times. 

4. The gameplay is a dark dungeon action role-playing mobile game. The game contains a clear mission line. Players must continue to talk to NPCs, find objects, and fight in the game to advance the development of the plot, explore multiple scenes of the game, and then enter the next chapter. The story of the characters in the game is three-dimensional, with a strong sense of substitution. Through challenging tasks and levels, players are gradually guided to complete the plot content, and enter the game experience of constantly exploring new skill combinations and improving their own skills.

rows.gacha|des|37001:
In general, the base rate is applied to all Pactspirits. For Rate Up and Minimum Guarantee, the rates are subject to actual rules.
[Boon Rules]
The base rate of acquiring a Legendary Pactspirits is 1.500%. If you fail to obtain any Legendary Pactspirit after 50 Boons, the next Boon's rate of yielding a Legendary Pactspirit will be increased from 1.500% to 3.000%, and if this Boon doesn't yield a Legendary Pactspirit either, then the chance of obtaining a Legendary Pactspirit with the next Boon will be increased from 3.000% to 4.500%. This process repeats itself with a 1.500% rate increase for every Boon until the rate of acquiring a Legendary Pactspirit reaches 100.000%. Once a Legendary Pactspirit is obtained, the next Boon's chance will be reset to the base rate.

For every 10 Boons, at least 1 Pactspirit that is Rare or better is guaranteed.

[Rate Ups]
When the PYO (Pick-Your-Own) feature is enabled, you can pick a designated amount of Pactspirits in the Pactspirit List to get a 50.000% chance to obtain the Pactspirits you picked when you obtain a Legendary Pactspirit (if you picked multiple Pactspirits, they will share the chance equally). If that doesn't get you a Pactspirit you picked after getting 1 Legendary Pactspirit, the next Legendary Pactspirit you get from Boons is guaranteed to be a Pactspirit you picked. The count will be reset once a Pactspirit you picked is obtained.

[Duplicate Pactspirits]
When you receive Duplicate Pactspirits, they will be converted into a certain amount of Pactspirit Proofs. Surplus Proofs can be traded for Insight Essence at the in-game shop

[Boon Item List]
Legendary Pactspirits Base Rate: 1.500%
Rare Pactspirits Base Rate: 12.000%. When obtaining a Rare Pactspirit, there is a 30% chance it will be Dragon Plant
Magic Pactspirits Base Rate: 86.500%. When obtaining a Magic Pactspirit, there is a 30% chance it will be Feasting Samurai
The Legendary Pactspirit Alice 1 will only appear in this Boon and will not be available in any other Boon. The season-exclusive gameplay of the season-exclusive Pactspirit will be added to the Season Rotation Pool once the season comes to an end. And the chances of that season-exclusive gameplay appearing in the next season will be reduced. The exclusive Pactspirit is only available in the current pool.
The exclusive Pactspirit's effects remain valid permanently.
rows.main_story|describe|900500: Following the fall of the mighty Hermann Empire, a multitude of treasure troves were scattered across Leptis. These remnants of a bygone era not only embody the Hermann Empire's past grandeur and glory but also conceal untold perils and riches.

rows.season|season_des|731:
Season Background
I am lost within the mist.
I cannot find my way back.
Who extinguished my lantern? Who's calling out my name?
I break the hands of the Clock Tower and tear open the mist.
Then, I saw you.
At that time, I was still you.

New Gameplay
Defeat the Mistville "Residents" in the Netherrealm and journey to Mistville. Dispel the mist with Sanity and face various random events to eventually arrive at the Clock Tower. Complete Advent of Folklores in the Clock Tower to receive a Chest of Folklores that contains various rewards. After that, Hunters must welcome a new day from the bench.
Hunters will find all kinds of Food and Old Stuff while exploring Mistville. Use them well to change your exploration experience and even increase drop quantity.
The new season features brand new Season Talents. Hunters must collect Mistville Intel to gradually unlock these Talents and make exploring Mistville easier than ever.

New Development System
The new season features a batch of brand new skills called Activation Medium Skills. They are often closely linked to auto-triggering, allowing them to significantly simplify gameplay and improve your experience.
Hunters can obtain various Activation Medium Skills from Whispering Mist, and use them to create new, surprising, and powerful builds.

rows.handbook|description|10510:
Frostbite reduces the target's Attack Speed, Cast Speed, and Movement Speed by 10% with an initial duration of 1.5s.
When the target is inflicted with Frostbite, an attack inflicts 2 points of Frostbite Rating for every 0.2% of the sum of the enemy's Max Life and Max Energy Shield reduced by the Cold Damage dealt by this hit.
When a unit has more than 100 points of Frostbite Rating, the unit will be frozen for 0.2s and cannot take action while frozen.
The Frostbite effect and Freeze duration are increased by 1% for every 1 Frostbite Rating a unit has.
In general, legendary bosses are immune to Freeze but can be inflicted with a certain amount of Frostbite Rating up to an upper limit. Once this upper limit is reached, the Frostbite Rating will not continue to increase.

rows.season|season_des|1242:
Season Background
I walked through a door.
I was certain it was just that-a normal door.
Then I saw those... things. Ashen arms drifting in the air.
Deformed heads crashing to the ground.
Then a fish, its mouth gaping and closing, emitting the director's voice:
"Agent ■■■■■, I don't care what level of the Overrealm you're on, find a "Door" and get back here. Now!"
A door? Where?
I looked up. I looked down. I looked everywhere.
Turns out, it was inside the door.
But as I stepped through the door, it hit me:
My name isn't ■■■■■... and I've never met any director.

New Gameplay
You will find "Doors" within the Netherrealm. Defeating the monsters within these "Doors" grants a chance to enter the Overrealm.
Within the Overrealm, you must defeat monsters before time runs out, accumulate Containment Progress, and open doors to deeper levels. Only the best can reach the fourth and final level.
You can obtain drop bonus affixes called Bottled Shadows in the Overrealm. Stacking multiple instances of these affixes can lead to spectacular drops.
Unlocking Contained Objects in the Containment Dossier grants various practical bonuses, and also causes Contained Objects and Abnormalities that provide assistance or carry drops to appear in the Overrealm.

New Development System
Ethereal Prisms can be installed on Advanced Talent Panels within the Talent system.
An Ethereal Prism will override a single Talent Node, influencing surrounding Talents centered on that position and granting them additional effects.
An Ethereal Prism also provides bonus effects to the Core Talent on its current Advanced Talent Panel, or replaces it with a powerful new Core Talent.
With over 20 new Core Talents, you now have access to a wealth of new mechanics and attributes, providing the foundation for countless creative builds.
There's also a type of special Prism that possesses a remarkable mirroring ability. Based on the center point of the current Talent Panel, it can reflect Talent Nodes from one side to the other, with a chance to significantly enhance the effects of the mirrored Talent Nodes.
Within the Talent system, only one regular Prism and one special Prism can be installed, and the two can coexist.
Using Calibration Prism allows you to add random affixes to Ethereal Prisms, breaking free from traditional Talent constraints and customizing a Talent Panel tailored to your playstyle.

rows.season|season_des|501:
Season Background
"The world of Torchlight is essentially an isolated island in a vast void, and countless terrifying and unknown creatures are lurking around us."
"Around us? More like they are lurking in our deepest and most secret dreams."
The wonderful thing about dreams is that you could be in a deep good dream or the claws of a nightmare...

New Gameplay
Hunters have a chance to enter a sweet dream when they interact with the Dream Lotus on the map.
After completing a Sweet Dream, Hunters will receive Dream Bubbles that contain rewards. Hunters will need to search for more lotuses to explore deeper levels of Sweet Dreams. Whenever a Sweet Dream level is completed, Hunters will inherit the rewards from the previous level and get the chance to further upgrade or increase these rewards.
At the same time, Hunters need to be vigilant as their chance of entering a Nightmare increases with each level of a Sweet Dream they complete. Hunters should be familiar with the Nightmares they encounter as they will receive the Nightmare Omens corresponding to the rewards they select on each level of a Sweet Dream, and these omens will come true in a Nightmare that can come for Hunters at any time. In other words, the higher the level of the Sweet Dream, the more dangers Hunters will face in Nightmares.
No matter how beautiful the rewards are in a dream, it could just be a bubble that can pop at any time. These bubbles will only come true after Hunters escape from the Nightmare.

New Development System
When exploring a dream, Hunters will get a new season item called Dream Talking. Whenever Hunters perform Dream Talking Interpretation, they will obtain a dream base, which includes a Sweet Dream affix and a Nightmare affix. The original base affixes on a piece of gear will be replaced when the dream base is recorded onto the gear. Sweet Dream base affixes grant powerful buffs, such as allowing Hunters to gain Legendary affixes that have only appeared on Legendary gear when crafting gear. Nightmare base affixes, on the other hand, grant negative affixes that may weaken the gear. Therefore, Hunters will need to choose the right time to perform Dream Talking Interpretation. While trying to get the Sweet Dream affixes they seek, Hunters will also need to take care to avoid the negative impact of Nightmare affixes.

The Queen of Eternal Sun, a new supreme boss, is featured in the new season. On a long night filled with chaotic dreams, she opens her eyes again and waits for warriors to sacrifice themselves for her.

rows.season|season_des|1311:
Season Background
A strange disease called Vorax has infected the monsters of Leptis!
Once infected, they turn crimson and enter a state of extreme hyperactivity and frenzy. They even devour each other, absorbing the endlessly multiplying diseased tissue within their bodies to evolve into more powerful and grotesque monstrosities.
As the crisis looms, Mad Doctor Shelley's underground clinic officially opens for business!

New Gameplay
This clinic is home to the best Vorax specialist in all of Leptis!
The first stage of treatment is to find suitable patients. Defeat Vorax Elites in Netherrealm stages to collect the Vorax Substance on them. Obtaining sufficiently potent doses of Vorax Substances is the foundation of treatment.
The second stage of treatment is to visit Mad Doctor Shelley's underground clinic to start the Surgical Preparation phase.
Here, Hunters will perform surgeries on Vorax-infected monsters in preparation for further surgeries in different directions based on monsters' diverse racial talents.
During this stage, Hunters can choose freely from dozens of Surgical Instruments and Potions, combining them in various ways to gradually cultivate the ultimate Vorax host.
Each race has extremely rare Special Potions. These Special Potions provide a set of special medications, which increase in potency with each round, until a miraculous Potion with super high Ultimate Activity is created.
The surgery officially begins in the third stage of treatment!
Hunters will now have to dispose of the powerful monsters they just created.
Defeat them to recover precious Vorax antidotes from their bodies and exchange them for corresponding rewards.
Antidote Vials in the Operating Theater will fill up as more monsters are defeated, and the rewards earned by exchanging them become increasingly better as their potency increases.

New Development System
Grafting lets Hunters craft Vorax Gear-unrestricted by Strength, Intelligence, or Dexterity, with a shared affix pool across different parts, and even capable of holding Legendary affixes.
Use Normal Organs to add Basic or Advanced affixes to Vorax Gear. Use Special Organs to add Ultimate affixes to Vorax Gear. Use Core Organs and Sutures to add Legendary affixes to Vorax Gear.
Vorax Corrosion increases the tier of Vorax Gear affixes, potentially increasing all pre-fixes and suffixes by 1 - 2 tiers.

rows.season|season_des|1022:
Season Background
Have you ever looked up at the sky and imagined thriving cities hidden among the islands floating in the clouds?
Loaded with supplies, Airships sail in the Desert Sea, shuttling between islands to trade treasures and wealth.
Yet beneath the seemingly calm quicksand lies a world of conflicts and raids.
Are you ready?
A Sand Bandit from your past has extended an invitation for you to become the master of Cloud Oasis.
Build, explore, and conquer this floating Oasis.
And become the most legendary Sandlord in the Desert Sea!


New Gameplay
Hunters can defeat Sand Pirates in the Netherrealm to gather resources for the Cloud Oasis-or even recruit them as laborers. In the Cloud Oasis, you can build and upgrade buildings, deploy laborers to produce resources, and send airships to trade resources for abundant rewards. Feeling bold? You can also deploy laborers on Gliders to raid Sand Pirates' Treasure Stashes to get rewards at no cost. The Cloud Oasis can operate on its own as long as it has enough resources. So sit back and watch your wealth grow!

New Upgrade System
In the Sandlord gameplay, you can trade to obtain precious Aromatic Materials and blend them according to recipes to grant a Belt unique Blending Affixes.
Blending Affixes can give you powerful bonuses, such as Medium Talents, Core Talents, and even Hero Trait Node of other Heroes.

rows.season|season_des|451:
Season Background
When the First Flame shone brightly, gods walked among all creatures, bringing prosperity and faith to the world. As the First Flame extinguished, the gods left the mortal realm, and the earth was sprawling with aembers. Now, the Goddess of Hunting returns from the stars, once again patrolling the vast land shrouded in evil starlight. Warriors should follow the footsteps of the gods, hunt down the Stars of Calamity falling from the sky, and eradicate the flourishing shadows of evil. Offer the gods the hunted game symbolizing courage, and receive the supreme reward of radiance.

Exciting Gameplay
Upon entering a stage, Hunters will automatically unleash their Main Skill when traveling a certain distance. Additionally, increasing Movement Speed will also increase the Main Skill's damage.
Each map not only contains multiple Treasure Chests but also 1-3 menacing Netherrealm bosses.

Accelerated Progression
During the Preseason, due to the increased quantity of bosses and Treasure Chests in the stages, the character progression rate will be increased by an additional 130%, allowing all Hunters to make progress more swiftly. Furthermore, there are three new pieces of Exclusive Legendary Gear waiting to be acquired.

rows.manual_rule_des|des|600001172:
<RichText>This type of attributes refers to things like "+X% additional Fluorescent Memory Drop Quantity," "+X% additional Flame Fuel Drop Quantity," etc.
This type of drop bonus only affects items of the corresponding type. For example, +X% additional Fluorescent Memory Drop Quantity only affects the Drop Quantity of Fluorescent Memories.

Calculation (using Fuel as an example)
Final expected Fuel Drop Quantity = Original expected Fuel Drop Quantity x (1 + Drop Quantity bonus 1 + Drop Quantity bonus 2 + Drop Quantity bonus 3 +...) x (1 + additional Drop Quantity bonus 1) x (1 + additional Drop Quantity bonus 2) x (1 + additional Drop Quantity bonus 3) x... x (1+ Fuel Drop Quantity bonus 1 + Fuel Drop Quantity bonus 2 + Fuel Drop Quantity bonus 3 +...)
Note: Similarly, the Fuel Drop Quantity does not affect the weight distribution of different types of Fuel.

Example 1: If a drop has a 100% chance to drop 1 item, and the item has a 100% chance to be a Flame Elementium, then with "+100% Fuel Drop Quantity," there is a 100% chance to drop 2 Flame Elementium.
Example 2: If a drop has a 100% chance to drop 1 item, and the item has a 100% chance to be a Flame Elementium, then with "+50% Fuel Drop Quantity" and "+25% Fuel Drop Quantity," there is a 25% chance to drop 1 Flame Elementium and a 75% chance to drop 2 Flame Elementium.
Example 3: If a drop has a 50% chance to drop 1 Fuel, and the Fuel has a 50% chance to be a Flame Elementium and a 50% chance to be a Flame Sand, then with "+100% Fuel Drop Quantity," there is a 50% chance to drop no items, 12.5% chance to drop 2 Flame Elementium, 12.5% chance to drop 2 Flame Sand, and a 25% chance to drop 1 Flame Sand and 1 Flame Elementium</>

rows.collection|unlocked_text|20402:
Throughout many years of traveling on this land, I have never stopped studying the First Flame and the Spark.

Traces of the First Flame could be found in every era in the history. It was like a lighthouse guiding humans, but the evil gods from other worlds shattered it into four pieces of Spark, scattering all over the world.

The power of the Spark was greatly reduced, but it could still expel Aember within a region. The Church relied on the Spark to secure their dominance and harvest wealth from the believers. Whenever I think of their arrogant faces, my beard would shake in anger. What a bunch of lowly cowards! Clowns!

Apart from the Church, a new organization called "Torchlight" is also secretly protecting a Spark. Most of their members are Disqualified, but they are still fighting in their own way. Honestly, I admire them a lot. At least they have the guts to fight against the aemberon!

Every time I think of the Church clowns worshipping their Spark, I really wish the Torchlight can one day take it away from them!

2. Place Void Sea Flames into the Void Sea Seal to lure over Void Sea Souls from the void. Defeat 3 waves of Void Sea Souls to reveal 3 Seal Whispers.
3. Different Void Sea Flames have different effects. Some make Void Sea Souls give additional drops, while others affect the type of Seal Whisper that is revealed after defeating Void Sea Souls.
4. If there are unselected Seal Whispers when a Void Sea Flame is placed into the Void Sea Seal or the Void Sea Terminal is already open, the additional Void Sea Flame effects will not take effect, and the drop results of Void Sea Flames in the stage at this Timemark will not change.

rows.season|season_des|301:
Season Background 
Whoever created the Cube must have become a part of it too... According to the legends, this strange Cube has been drifting through worlds, devouring everything it touches and converting them into something else. Some worship it because it grants all their wishes. Those who make a sacrifice to it will definitely receive something in return. But some also fear it because they know someone, such as their siblings, parents, or friends, who have never returned after approaching the Cube. It has now come to the Aember-ravaged Leptis. Here, it is absorbing Aember and transforming it into horrific Aember monsters never seen before. This has become a new problem for Torchlight... Of course, it is a problem that can be exploited. 
New Gameplay 
Defeat the new monster Malice Incarnation summoned here by the Cube of Rapacity to get Desire Crystals and spend a certain amount of Desire Crystals to draw amazing rewards from the Cube of Rapacity. However, you will lose all the rewards you got if you get too greedy and anger the Cube. 
The Cube of Rapacity will summon powerful special monsters. Each stage has a unique and powerful boss that significantly changes the dull stage-clearing experience. 
The new Season Talent feature has been introduced to the new season. Hunters can change the Talent Nodes for different experiences at little cost. 
The Law Bearer is a new supreme boss who will be introduced in the new season. As the supreme judge of the High Court of Desire, he is more than happy to erase the existence of those who violate the old laws. This supreme boss will be even more challenging than ever. 

New Development System 
Hunters will able to get their hands on a new item called Divinity Slate during their adventure. Each Divinity Slate is related to a god and can carry up to 2 Talent Affixes of the god. 
A new talent panel, Statue of The New God, will be added in the new season. Hunters can combine and place multiple Divinity Slates on the Statue of The New God to gain powerful buffs. This means that Hunters can harness the power of the Six Gods free of the restraint of different gods. 
Hunters can enhance Divinity Slates at a cost, increasing the Talent Affixes allowed to be equipped on them and the strength of affixes. When enhancing a Divinity Slate, there is also a chance to obtain the exclusive Talent Affixes of the new god, granting the power to control order and chaos. However, enhanced Divinity Slates will have a "brand" and become untradeable. 
The new god's Legendary Divinity Slate comes with more special abilities, which have better order-and-chaos effects and allow Hunters to devour the power of the Six Gods for even powerful buffs.

rows.season|season_des|411:
Exciting Gameplay
Upon entering a stage, Hunters will automatically unleash their Main Skill when traveling a certain distance. Additionally, increasing Movement Speed will also increase the Main Skill's damage.
Each map not only contains multiple Treasure Chests but also 2 menacing Netherrealm bosses.

Accelerated Progression
During the Preseason, due to the increased quantity of bosses and Treasure Chests in the stages, the total number of items dropped will be increased to 300% of what it was before, allowing all Hunters to make progress more swiftly. Furthermore, there are three new pieces of Exclusive Legendary Gear waiting to be acquired.

Season Background
When the First Flame shone brightly, gods walked among all creatures, bringing prosperity and faith to the world. As the First Flame extinguished, the gods left the mortal realm, and the earth was sprawling with aembers. Now, the Goddess of Hunting returns from the stars, once again patrolling the vast land shrouded in evil starlight. Warriors should follow the footsteps of the gods, hunt down the Stars of Calamity falling from the sky, and eradicate the flourishing shadows of evil. Offer the gods the hunted game symbolizing courage, and receive the supreme reward of radiance.
