rows.manual_rule_des|des|1000000920:
<RichText>As a stat that counteracts Resistance, Resistance Penetration acts on the defender's effective Resistance in the damage calculation process.
Upon inflicting damage, if the attacker has Resistance Penetration of a certain type, the defender's Resistance will be reduced accordingly by the value of the Resistance Penetration when calculating the damage.
Resistance Penetration does not change the actual value of the defender's Resistance.
Resistance Penetration takes effect on all forms of damage (Hit, DoT, Secondary, Reflect).</>

rows.gacha|des|12001:
In general, the base rate is applied to all Pactspirits. For Rate Up and Minimum Guarantee, the rates are subject to actual rules.
[Boon Rules]
The base rate of acquiring a Legendary Pactspirits is 1.500%. If you fail to obtain any Legendary Pactspirit after 50 Boons, the next Boon's rate of yielding a Legendary Pactspirit will be increased from 1.500% to 3.000%, and if this Boon doesn't yield a Legendary Pactspirit either, then the chance of obtaining a Legendary Pactspirit with the next Boon will be increased from 3.000% to 4.500%. This process repeats itself with a 1.500% rate increase for every Boon until the rate of acquiring a Legendary Pactspirit reaches 100.000%. Once a Legendary Pactspirit is obtained, the next Boon's chance will be reset to the base rate.

After this Boon ends, should it return in a future season, its draw attempts will be retained. If added to the Past Memories, the draw attempts will be reset.

For every 10 Boons, at least 1 Pactspirit that is Rare or better is guaranteed.

[Rate Ups]
When the PYO (Pick-Your-Own) feature is enabled, you can pick a designated amount of Pactspirits in the Pactspirit List to get a 50.000% chance to obtain the Pactspirits you picked (if you picked multiple Pactspirits, they will share the chance equally). If that doesn't get you a Pactspirit you picked after getting 1 Legendary Pactspirit, the next Legendary Pactspirit you get from Boons is guaranteed to be a Pactspirit you picked. The count will be reset once a Pactspirit you picked is obtained.

[Duplicate Pactspirits]
When you receive Duplicate Pactspirits, they will be converted into a certain amount of Pactspirit Proofs. Surplus Proofs can be traded for Insight Essence at the in-game shop

[Boon Item List]
Legendary Pactspirits Base Rate: 1.500%
Rare Pactspirits Base Rate: 12.000%.
Magic Pactspirits Base Rate: 86.500%.
The Legendary Pactspirit Overrealm Arrow will only appear in this Boon and will not be available in any other Boon. The season-exclusive gameplay of the season-exclusive Pactspirit will be added to the Season Rotation Pool once the season comes to an end. And the chances of that season-exclusive gameplay appearing in the next season will be reduced. The exclusive Pactspirit is only available in the current pool.
The exclusive Pactspirit's effects remain valid permanently.

rows.season|season_des|1451:
Season Background
The story begins with a legend from a time long forgotten.
"Once, in an age beyond memory, there lived a race that called the moon their home.
They were masters of song and dance. Every part of their being resonated like a fine instrument, producing melodies of sublime beauty.
But when the moon fell from the heavens, they turned into cold stone-statues scattered to the four winds.
It is said that these statues will awaken once more when the bright moon shines again. They will join you in a symphony of the full moon, offering treasures long lost to time.
So, Traveler, strum the Lunar Strings.
Call the moon to its zenith, turn the moonlight into song, and uncover the secrets sleeping inside the stone.
Tonight-let's shine together."

New Gameplay
Step into an area teeming with Lunar Stone Statues. Place the Lunar Ring at your feet to encompass as many statues as possible and Strum the Lunar Harp to awaken them, then take them down to earn instant drop rewards. The more statues you wake in one strum, the higher your Combo count, which results in greater Drop Quantity bonuses-and greater loot.
Lunar Omen events will appear at random, bringing both challenges and generous rewards. Fortunate Hunters may even stumble upon the game-changing Rhapsody gameplay-a twist that reshapes the "rhythm" you play and delivers a bountiful run you won't forget.
Install your Lunar Harp with various Lunar Strings to customize bonus effects and select the playstyle that perfectly matches your rhythm.

New Development System
Memory Revival is a crafting method that imbues Hero Memories with special powers.
Revival grants various effects to Hero Memories, increasing the values of their base affixes, upgrading Fixed Affixes, giving them special random affixes, and even adding a powerful Revived Affix.
Revived Affixes even include 1 or more unique Hero Trait Affixes tailored to each hero.

rows.season|season_des|921:
Season Background
Take a moment to silently reflect on what you seek in your heart and mind, for the divination is about to begin.
You picked The Empress, The Chariot...
But before I reveal the meaning of your reading, I must ask you one last time...
Are you truly prepared to pay the price of peering into fate?
Knowing that the very future you wish to glimpse will be shaped by every tarot card you draw from this moment forward...
Do you still want to see it?

New Gameplay
Mysterious tarot cards are scattered throughout the Netherrealm stages, each one offering a glimpse into the threads of destiny. Over a dozen tarot-themed trials await daring Hunters, including The Chariot, The Emperor, The Hermit, and The Sun.
Upon completing each Tarot Trial, you will receive a Note of Arcana, a vital key to unlocking your full potential along the Tarot Path.
Beware, though-while the Tarot Path is lined with alluring Chests of Destiny, it is also riddled with traps.
The Notes of Arcana will guide your way, helping you steer clear of traps while helping you claim the Chests of Destiny you seek.
The ultimate challenge of fate starts when you want to open your Chests of Destiny.
At that time, the Tarot Trials corresponding to the Chests of Destiny will be revealed in turn.
When starting a specific wave of battle, the additional tarot themes will be applied to the new Tarot Trial.
Thus, the power of multiple tarot cards will be applied simultaneously as the battle intensifies.
Correspondingly, Hunters' rewards will accumulate to unforeseen heights in this wonderful trial.
The price that must be paid for the gifts of destiny has been marked, and the answer you seek lies in the tarot cards.

New Upgrade System
Hunters can form pacts with up to three Drop Pactspirits and three Battle Pactspirits.
In the Arcana gameplay, Hunters will obtain a variety of Destinies, each of which has different effects. Installing them in the corresponding Battle Pactspirit Talent Nodes will replace the original effects of the Talent Nodes and change destiny.
There are two types of Destinies: Fates and Kismets, with the exceptionally rare Dual Kismets offering even greater potential.
Fates grant Hunters regular stats such as Resistances, Mana Compensation, Curse effects, etc.
Kismets, on the other hand, grant rarer and more potent effects, paving the way for unique and powerful builds that can transform your playstyle.

rows.manual_rule_des|des|4002010221:
<RichText Id="3103">Collect Void Sea Flames</><RichText>
Monsters with Void Sea Flames will appear when the stage is "marked by a Plane Anchor". Defeat these monsters to get Void Sea Flames. Void Sea Flames come with various effects, such as granting extra drops or changing subsequent Seal Whispers.
</><RichText Id="3103">Reveal Void Sea Seals</><RichText>
After you defeat a stage boss, a Plane Anchor will appear. You can interact with the Plane Anchor and defeat the Void Pirate to reveal a Void Sea Seal and get a Seal Whisper. Seal Whispers include Whisper of Armament, Whisper of Wealth, and Whisper of Wonder. These Whispers will greatly affect the final rewards.
</><RichText Id="3103">Go to the Void Sea Terminal</><RichText>
With 6 Seal Whispers, you can go to the Void Sea Terminal to defeat the Void Sea Bride and get the rewards in the Treasure Chest.</>

rows.season|season_window2|1132:
New Gameplay
Hijack TOWER Transport Vehicles in the Netherrealm and chase down the escort bodyguards who are fleeing with the payload and take down their reinforcements within a limited time.
Break into the heavily guarded TOWER Co. and blast open vaults to loot as much treasure as you can!

New Upgrade System
Craft a TOWER Sequence for non-Legendary weapons and shields. During the crafting process, you'll get to choose from several chips of random colors in each round. If the colors of the chips you chose match the target sequence (in any order) after all selections have been made, you'll obtain the effects of the target sequence.

New Gameplay
Encompass as many statues as possible in the Lunar Ring, then Strum the Lunar Harp to awaken and defeat them to get instant drop rewards. The more statues activated, the greater the drop bonus.
The gameplay includes surprise events like Lunar Omen and the special themed Rhapsody, which changes the entire experience.

New Development System
Memory Revival adds several different powerful effects to Hero Memories, including 1 or more unique Hero Trait Affixes tailored to each hero.

rows.system_help|description|8:
About Beacons:
1. Beacons are required to start a Netherrealm stage. Each Netherrealm stage can only be started with a specified Beacon.
2. The best way to obtain Beacons is to defeat monsters in the Netherrealm.
3. Typically, the rank of the dropped Beacon matches the Timemark of its respective plane, but it will not be higher than the level of the stage where the Beacon is dropped.

About Plane Watcher:
1. You'll earn Starshards for completing each Netherrealm stage. Once you've collected enough Starshards, you can challenge the Plane Watcher of that Timemark. 2. Defeating the Plane Watcher unlocks a series of more challenging Netherrealm content, including new planes, new Timemarks, and endgame bosses.

About Netherrealm:
1. Netherrealm is divided into four phases, and you must defeat the Traveler of each phase to advance to the next phase. Both the difficulty and rewards increase with each phase.

Others:
1. Progress in the Netherrealm is shared across the same account and season. In other words, all characters on the same account share the same Netherrealm during a season.

rows.season|season_des|711:
Season Background
During the distant Epoch of War, a warrior known as Ralph wielded his blade against thousands of formidable foes in the Eternal Coliseum of gold, and he reigned undefeated. Now, the Epoch of War is but a distant memory, yet his brave and fearless spirit still lives on and shines brilliantly like gold, even to this day. O' warrior, defeat the countless enemies roaming the Netherrealm, advance to the Eternal Coliseum's center, and win the unparalleled rewards of the Invincible Champion!

Combat Frenzy
Blessed by the God of War, the rare monsters in the stage have a chance to be upgraded into Gladiator monsters of various tiers. Defeat them to enlarge your physique, or upgrade your Life and Energy Shield to achieve the same effect.
As your Physique grows, your Skill Area increases, and your Minions deal more damage. Rush into a frenzy and grow endlessly stronger!

Precious Drops
All exclusive items' drop rates are tripled during the preseason. Enjoy the feeling of being surrounded by Precious drops!
In addition, Gladiator monsters drop precious Proofs of Champion. Use the Proofs of Champion to enter the Eternal Coliseum, defeat the countless enemies that await there, and claim the almighty commendations of the God of War!

rows.season|season_des|511:
Season Background
During the distant Epoch of War, a warrior known as Ralph wielded his blade against thousands of formidable foes in the Eternal Coliseum of gold, and he reigned undefeated. Now, the Epoch of War is but a distant memory, yet his brave and fearless spirit still lives on and shines brilliantly like gold, even to this day. O' warrior, defeat the countless enemies roaming the Netherrealm, advance to the Eternal Coliseum's center, and win the unparalleled rewards of the Invincible Champion!

Combat Frenzy
Blessed by the God of War, the rare monsters in the stage have a chance to be upgraded into Gladiator monsters of various tiers. Defeat them to enlarge your physique, or upgrade your Life and Energy Shield to achieve the same effect.
As your Physique grows, your Skill Area increases, and your Minions deal more damage. Rush into a frenzy and grow endlessly stronger!

Precious Drops
All exclusive items' drop rates are tripled during the preseason. Enjoy the feeling of being surrounded by Precious drops!
In addition, Gladiator monsters drop precious Proofs of Champion. Use the Proofs of Champion to enter the Eternal Coliseum, defeat the countless enemies that await there, and claim the almighty commendations of the God of War!

rows.system_help|description|1:
Prototype Crafting:
1. Hunters can re-roll the affixes of their gear via Prototype Crafting.
2. During Prototype Crafting, Hunters can choose to lock a number of affixes of the gear (up to 2). The number of affixes that can be locked increases with the item level of the gear. Locked affixes will not change during the re-rolling process.
3. During Prototype Crafting, re-rolling the gear with 0/1/2 affixes locked will yield a Prototype gear with 3/4/5 affixes.
4. During Prototype Crafting, locking 2 affixes will consume the gear's Plasticity.

Affix Upgrading:
1. Upgrading designated affixes on a piece of gear will consume Flame Elementium and the gear's Plasticity.
2. Upgrading a T2 affix or below will consume the gear's Plasticity. Gear can no longer be upgraded when it has insufficient Plasticity.
3. Upgrading a T1 affix will fully remove the gear's remaining Plasticity and randomly remove 1 affix not obtained from non-targeted processing. Gear that has a Plasticity of 0 can still be upgraded from T1 to T0.
4. Affixes added through Targeted Processing cannot be upgraded.

Targeted Processing:
1. Targeted Processing adds specified affixes of a random tier to a piece of gear.
2. There is a chance that some affixes may not be added successfully. When this happens, the gear will have a Blemish, which occupies an affix slot.
3. Reforge can be used to remove affixes added through Targeted Processing, including Blemishes.

rows.collection|unlocked_text|10304:
The first time I laid eyes on the anti-dragon weapons that stood atop that huge wall, I was amazed by how huge and heavy they were. And when I tried to draw it, I couldn't help but doubt the recorded height of the dwarves during the Epoch of Might.

But just a moment later, a giant automaton buried deep beneath the sand and gravel caught my attention.

At that moment, it was like I could see my ancestors controlling their automatons in battle against the dragons. The flames of war filled the sky as clangs of weapons reverberated through the air, and with ever-lasting roars, the dragons descended like meteors.

I continued forward and stopped before a Bulwark Cannon.

These cannons with barrels pointed straight at the sky were forged with the sole task of striking down the dragons circling in the skies. Now, even if they have been slumbering for millennia, the years have done nothing to their ingenious mechanical structure.

If Ragnarok was the end of the Epoch of Might, then the Anti-Dragon Bulwark is the greatest and most brilliant epitome of that era.

rows.gacha|des|101:
In general, the base rate is applied to all Pactspirits. For Rate Up and Minimum Guarantee, the rates are subject to actual rules.
[Boon Rules]
The base rate of acquiring a Legendary Pactspirits is 1.500%. If you fail to obtain any Legendary Pactspirit after 50 Boons, the next Boon's rate of yielding a Legendary Pactspirit will be increased from 1.500% to 3.000%, and if this Boon doesn't yield a Legendary Pactspirit either, then the chance of obtaining a Legendary Pactspirit with the next Boon will be increased from 3.000% to 4.500%. This process repeats itself with a 1.500% rate increase per Boon until the rate of acquiring a Legendary Pactspirit reaches 100.000%. Once a Legendary Pactspirit is obtained, the next Boon's chance will be reset to the base rate.

For every 10 Boons, at least 1 Pactspirit that is Rare or better is guaranteed.

[Rate Ups]
When the PYO (Pick-Your-Own) feature is enabled, you can pick a designated amount of Pactspirits in the Pactspirit List to get a 50.000% chance to obtain the Pactspirits you picked (if you picked multiple Pactspirits, they will share the chance equally). If that doesn't get you a Pactspirit you picked, the next Legendary Pactspirit you get from Boons is guaranteed to be a Pactspirit you picked.

[Duplicate Pactspirits]
When you receive Duplicate Pactspirits, they will be converted into a certain amount of Pactspirit Proofs. Surplus Proofs can be traded for Insight Essence at the in-game shop

[Boon Item List]
Legendary Pactspirits Base Rate: 1.500%
Rare Pactspirits Base Rate: 12.000%
Magic Pactspirits Base Rate: 86.500%
The Boons here belong to Featured Pactspirit Pools. All Featured Pactspirit Pools share the rate up effects and Minimum Guarantee chances (not including the PYO feature's remaining amount of attempts) and are independent from other Boons' rate up effects and Minimum Guarantee chances.

rows.season|season_des|751:
Season Background
"The world of Torchlight is essentially an isolated island in a vast void, and countless terrifying and unknown creatures are lurking around us."
"Around us? More like they are lurking in our deepest and most secret dreams."
The wonderful thing about dreams is that you could be in a deep good dream or the claws of a nightmare...

New Gameplay
Hunters have a chance to enter a sweet dream when they interact with the Dream Lotus on the map.
After completing a Sweet Dream, Hunters will receive Dream Bubbles that contain rewards. Hunters will need to search for more lotuses to explore deeper levels of Sweet Dreams. Whenever a Sweet Dream level is completed, Hunters will inherit the rewards from the previous level and get the chance to further upgrade or increase these rewards.
At the same time, Hunters need to be vigilant as their chance of entering a Nightmare increases with each level of a Sweet Dream they complete. Hunters should be familiar with the Nightmares they encounter as they will receive the Nightmare Omens corresponding to the rewards they select on each level of a Sweet Dream, and these omens will come true in a Nightmare that can come for Hunters at any time. In other words, the higher the level of the Sweet Dream, the more dangers Hunters will face in Nightmares.
No matter how beautiful the rewards are in a dream, it could just be a bubble that can pop at any time. These bubbles will only come true after Hunters escape from the Nightmare.

New Development System
When exploring a dream, Hunters will get a new season item called Dream Talking. Whenever Hunters perform Dream Talking Interpretation, they will obtain a dream base, which includes a Sweet Dream affix and a Nightmare affix. The original base affixes on a piece of gear will be replaced when the dream base is recorded onto the gear. Sweet Dream base affixes grant powerful buffs, such as allowing Hunters to gain Legendary affixes that have only appeared on Legendary gear when crafting gear. Nightmare base affixes, on the other hand, grant negative affixes that may weaken the gear. Therefore, Hunters will need to choose the right time to perform Dream Talking Interpretation. While trying to get the Sweet Dream affixes they seek, Hunters will also need to take care to avoid the negative impact of Nightmare affixes.

The Queen of Eternal Sun, a new supreme boss, is featured in the new season. On a long night filled with chaotic dreams, she opens her eyes again and waits for warriors to sacrifice themselves for her.

rows.season|season_des|1421:
Season Background
The story begins with a legend from a time long forgotten.
"Once, in an age beyond memory, there lived a race that called the moon their home.
They were masters of song and dance. Every part of their being resonated like a fine instrument, producing melodies of sublime beauty.
But when the moon fell from the heavens, they turned into cold stone-statues scattered to the four winds.
It is said that these statues will awaken once more when the bright moon shines again. They will join you in a symphony of the full moon, offering treasures long lost to time.
So, Traveler, strum the Lunar Strings.
Call the moon to its zenith, turn the moonlight into song, and uncover the secrets sleeping inside the stone.
Tonight-let's shine together."

New Gameplay
Step into an area teeming with Lunar Stone Statues. Place the Lunar Ring at your feet to encompass as many statues as possible and Strum the Lunar Harp to awaken them, then take them down to earn instant drop rewards. The more statues you wake in one strum, the higher your Combo count, which results in greater Drop Quantity bonuses-and greater loot.
Lunar Omen events will appear at random, bringing both challenges and generous rewards. Fortunate Hunters may even stumble upon the game-changing Rhapsody gameplay-a twist that reshapes the "rhythm" you play and delivers a bountiful run you won't forget.
Install your Lunar Harp with various Lunar Strings to customize bonus effects and select the playstyle that perfectly matches your rhythm.

New Development System
Memory Revival is a crafting method that imbues Hero Memories with special powers.
Revival grants various effects to Hero Memories, increasing the values of their base affixes, upgrading Fixed Affixes, giving them special random affixes, and even adding a powerful Revived Affix.
Revived Affixes even include 1 or more unique Hero Trait Affixes tailored to each hero.

rows.collection|unlocked_text|21001:
I have never been so angry.

My teacher once said that we were only recorders of history. We discover history, witness it, and record it on a medium in our way so it does not disappear over time. But we must forever remain silent, and cannot forge or interfere with things that are about to become history in any ways.

But I can never become like him, remaining neutral to every single thing or person.

Before coming to the Lost City outside the wall, I already knew they were a bunch of poor people who could not afford the donations. All they could do was to gather inside desolate alleys, hoping for redemption.

But when I finally stepped there, I found out other than the poor civilians, there was also another large, evil gang hanging around - the Wolf Packs. Most of them were decently armed ex-imperial soldiers, but they chose to point their guns toward innocent civilians.

I thought asking for protection rackets was bad enough, but what I saw next completely blew my mind.

One night, I was hiding behind a building when two Wolf Packs members took dozens of civilians across an alley before disappearing inside a hidden door under the wall. I could still recall the looks on the civilians' faces. They were pious, thankful, excited, as if redemption was already close.

I didn't know what Wolf Packs promised them, but it must be a complete lie, because I saw their invoice. 500 Tremissis per civilian.

I wanted to stop them, to save them, but I ended up doing nothing.

I must go back to St. Duran. Something must be hidden inside that empty monastery.

rows.manual_rule_des|des|1000020920:
<RichText Id="3103">Lucky & Unlucky</><RichText>
Certain random results in combat (such as damage rolls, Critical Strikes, Blocking, Evading and more) are affected by Lucky and Unlucky. They take effect by changing the number of rolls for the result:
Lucky: The result is rolled twice, and the more favorable one is kept.
Very Lucky: The result is rolled three times, and the most favorable one is kept.
Unlucky: The result is rolled twice, and the less favorable one is kept.

rows.season|season_des|821:
Season Background
Unfold a piece of cold Snowpaper and apply colorful Paint to the white snow.
Breathe life into everything as you fill in the snowy landscape with colors.
Eventually, the empty frozen canvas becomes a vibrant work of art.
After the last brush falls, the painter also becomes part of the painting.
What magnificent scenery awaits the one who created the world on this frozen canvas and entered it?

New Gameplay
After collecting Snowpaper Fragments in the Netherrealm, Hunters will select a difficulty and consume these fragments to unfold the canvas. After the canvas is unfolded, Hunters will need to defeat monsters in Netherrealm stages of the corresponding difficulty to collect various colors and types of Paint.
Hunters will need to place the corresponding Paints in the appropriate areas according to the Coloring Paint instructions, upgrade the Paints, and obtain new Coloring Paints until the canvas is completed.
After the painting is completed, Hunters can enter the frozen canvas of their painting to challenge monsters created from paint and the gameplay to get Splendor Eggs containing various rewards.

New Development System
Several Exclusive Support Skills have been added for most Active Skills, increasing the damage dealt by these skills and changing their form, giving them many unexpected amazing effects that will enrich Hunters' combat experience.
Collect Exclusive Support Skills and Inspiration Essences that are used to upgrade skills from the Frozen Canvas gameplay to create more powerful, more diverse, and more creative new builds.

rows.season|season_des|1501:
Season Background
Usher Mortuary - Night Watcher Recruitment Letter
After the Calamity, Leptis became a sprawling graveyard. Countless tormented souls still weep in the night wind.
To keep our vow to console the departed, this mortuary hereby resumes the Rite of Vigil. Our Vigil Procession will escort the coffins carrying the gathered souls to their eternal rest in the netherworld.
However, Wraiths lurk along the path to disturb the peace of the dead-a most unbecoming conduct.
We now seek Night Watchers to guard the procession, purge the Wraiths along the way, and ensure an unimpeded passage for the vigil.
Tonight, when the Guiding Lantern kindles, we await you as promised-join us in the Vigil.
-Madam Usher

New Gameplay
Interact with the Nameless Coffins in Netherrealm stages to start the Vigil. As the Vigil Procession advances, your Guiding Lantern will attract Wraiths along the path. Defeat the ceaseless tide of Wraiths and claim generous rewards! Within the time limit, the faster you defeat Wraiths, the faster they spawn-and the greater your rewards!
You may also encounter a gameplay theme that defies convention: the Noble Coffin. The occupants of such coffins are often of extraordinary status, making the challenge more formidable-but the rewards far more bountiful.
During the vigil, Vigil Anomalies may appear at random, bringing Anomaly monsters that grant rich rewards, or altering the gameplay rules for additional rewards.
At the Usher Mortuary, you may awaken different Relics to modify gameplay and greatly improve drops.

New Development System
Install Nether King's Divinity on Divinity Slates to draw upon the might of the gods, and harness the mysterious power of Nether King.
Nether King's Divinity influences other Divinity Slates, enhancing their affix effects, projecting its own affixes onto surrounding slates, and unlocking powerful exclusive affix effects by adjusting the number of adjacent and non-adjacent slates.

rows.collection|unlocked_text|21103:
I sold the last pieces of furniture yesterday but the money is still not enough for the donation Millie and Elsa are gonna pay next month.

In the past few months, the increasing donation pressed me so hard. The properties my father left have long been sold by me. Now there's even nothing left for me to remember him.

I need money, a lot of money.

With money, my family can reunite in St. Duran. We will be bathed in the Holy Light, away from those disgusting Aembers.

Three days ago, Dodge, the leader of the Wolf Packs, came to me and asked if I'd like to make a big deal.

He offered me a one-time payment of half a million Tremissis for helping him get twenty civilians into the church.

Honestly, I didn't want to deal with Dodge. But he seemed to see through my concerns, and let someone open the trunk in front of me. There were so many shining gold coins that my eyes hurt.

As a husband and father, I suppose I have to get started.

rows.manual_rule_des|des|1002000420:
<RichText Id="3103">Frostbite</><RichText>
By default, all Cold Damage has a 0% chance of inflicting Frostbite.
Frostbite reduces the Attack, Cast, and Movement Speed of the target by 10%, and deals additional Cold Damage to them based on their Frostbite Rating.
</><RichText Id="3103">Frostbite Rating</><RichText>
Frostbitten enemies have 10 points of Frostbite Rating by default. The Max Frostbite Rating is 100.
Units only have Frostbite Rating when they are Frostbitten.
</><RichText Id="3103">Freeze</><RichText>
When a unit has more than 100 Frostbite Rating, the unit will be Frozen.
Freeze ends when Frostbite ends.
Frozen non-Boss enemies will be Frost-Sealed periodically. Frost-Sealed enemies cannot act. The base duration of Frost-Seal is 1s, and the Frost-Sealed Interval is 3s for the same enemy.</>

After sacrificing shovel 21, 22, and 23, I finally reached the top of this legendary bulwark.



As I stood upon this wall of steel, the shock and pride that sunk deep into my soul far surpassed what I felt when I gazed at it from below.



Our ancestors bore deep into the mountain to merge our dwarven pride and joy, a reinforced steel skeleton, into the mountain, to fight against the savage dragons that was as strong as a God.



As I stand at the edge of the bulwark and gaze upon the distant mist-covered mountains of Andalin, the rumbling of machines, the clanging of weapons, and the roars of dragons echo in my ears.



I've decided to stay a few more days and record these scenes into history with as much detail as possible.



I'm also considering investing some of my budget into the purchase of Ember Tech climbing gear.

rows.season|season_des|801:
Season Background
Unfold a piece of cold Snowpaper and apply colorful Paint to the white snow.
Breathe life into everything as you fill in the snowy landscape with colors.
Eventually, the empty frozen canvas becomes a vibrant work of art.
After the last brush falls, the painter also becomes part of the painting.
What magnificent scenery awaits the one who created the world on this frozen canvas and entered it?

New Gameplay
After collecting Snowpaper Fragments in the Netherrealm, Hunters will select a difficulty and consume these fragments to unfold the canvas. After the canvas is unfolded, Hunters will need to defeat monsters in Netherrealm stages of the corresponding difficulty to collect various colors and types of Paint.
Hunters will need to place the corresponding Paints in the appropriate areas according to the Coloring Paint instructions, upgrade the Paints, and obtain new Coloring Paints until the canvas is completed.
After the painting is completed, Hunters can enter the frozen canvas of their painting to challenge monsters created from paint and the gameplay to get Splendor Eggs containing various rewards.

New Development System
Several Exclusive Support Skills have been added for most Active Skills, increasing the damage dealt by these skills and changing their form, giving them many unexpected amazing effects that will enrich Hunters' combat experience.
Collect Exclusive Support Skills and Inspiration Essences that are used to upgrade skills from the Frozen Canvas gameplay to create more powerful, more diverse, and more creative new builds.

rows.gacha|des|5003:
In general, the base rate is applied to all Pactspirits. For Rate Up and Minimum Guarantee, the rates are subject to actual rules.
[Boon Rules]
The base rate of acquiring a Legendary Pactspirits is 1.500%. If you fail to obtain any Legendary Pactspirit after 10 Boons, the next Boon's rate of yielding a Legendary Pactspirit will be increased from 1.500% to 3.000%, and if this Boon doesn't yield a Legendary Pactspirit either, then the chance of obtaining a Legendary Pactspirit with the next Boon will be increased from 3.000% to 4.500%. This process repeats itself with a 1.500% rate increase for every Boon until the rate of acquiring a Legendary Pactspirit reaches 100.000%. Once a Legendary Pactspirit is obtained, the next Boon's chance will be reset to the base rate.

For every 10 Boons, at least 1 Pactspirit that is Rare or better is guaranteed.

[Rate Ups]
When the PYO (Pick-Your-Own) feature is enabled, you can pick a designated amount of Pactspirits in the Pactspirit List to get a 75.000% chance to obtain the Pactspirits you picked (if you picked multiple Pactspirits, they will share the chance equally). If that doesn't get you a Pactspirit you picked after getting a Legendary Pactspirit, the next Legendary Pactspirit you get from Boons is guaranteed to be a Pactspirit you picked. The count will be reset once a Pactspirit you picked is obtained. The overall drop rate for Exclusive Legendary Pactspirits is 4.670%.

[Duplicate Pactspirits]
When you receive Duplicate Pactspirits, they will be converted into a certain amount of Pactspirit Proofs. Surplus Proofs can be traded for Insight Essence at the in-game shop.

[Boon Item List]
Legendary Pactspirits Base Rate: 1.500%
Rare Pactspirits Base Rate: 12.000%
Magic Pactspirits Base Rate: 86.500%
Invincible Champion will not be part of the regular gameplay, but it may return in future Preseasons.
After the event concludes, there will be no other methods to acquire Fluffhead Hare, and after obtaining 6 Fluffhead Hares, this Boon will automatically end.

rows.collection|unlocked_text|30701:
King Lionheart Maynic is the new leader of the Ichi Tribe. This young king once found some ancient records in the desert and was obsessed with retrieving this land's brightness. He believed that the Ancient Ichi had a way to build an artificial sun written in the records. He tried to dig out more things from the desert and prove their ancestors really did put the artificial sun in the sky, giving the Ancient Ichi a period of radiant, sumptuous, seemingly endless daytime.

...People born in the Eternal Night found it hard to believe the new king's hollow dream, but when the young king sunk himself into the challenge of being the most contributive king of all kings, the era began.

...

A massive amount of gold was transported to the central continent in exchange for their emperor's promised "Ember Machine". Everything was invested into the construction of Desert Lamp to ensure the land's future. Everyone was thrilled for the light and had heard the saying, "King Lionheart's name will never perish in the desert. His name will be with you for life."

...

King Lionheart's ambition started to grow, and the brightness that Desert Lamp brought wasn't enough for him. "The trifling light is nothing if you can get the sun." The mysterious woman said to him. She claimed to be the Child of Prophecy in the legend, telling King Lionheart that the calamity would come soon to convince him that she could bring the sun back.

King Lionheart said that mortals never had the strength to reject the sun, and everything mentioned in the prophecy came true long ago. Then he recruited soldiers frequently, sealed the Ichi Tribe off, tore The Golden Treaty, and dismantled the Desert Lamp... to stop the internal conflicts and external dangers mentioned in the prophecy from happening-- but they came true, one by one. As a humble historiographer, I can't help but think-- Would the prophecy still come true if no mouthpieces had sown the tales?

... The king's people who once hailed for him were leaving him. The name Mad King gradually replaced the name King Lionheart. He sometimes froze looking into a mirror, like he could see something in it, something that he had forgotten. He crashed the mirror on the day the princess left.

rows.season|season_des|531:
Season Background
"The world of Torchlight is essentially an isolated island in a vast void, and countless terrifying and unknown creatures are lurking around us."
"Around us? More like they are lurking in our deepest and most secret dreams."
The wonderful thing about dreams is that you could be in a deep good dream or the claws of a nightmare...

New Gameplay
Hunters have a chance to enter a sweet dream when they interact with the Dream Lotus on the map.
After completing a Sweet Dream, Hunters will receive Dream Bubbles that contain rewards. Hunters will need to search for more lotuses to explore deeper levels of Sweet Dreams. Whenever a Sweet Dream level is completed, Hunters will inherit the rewards from the previous level and get the chance to further upgrade or increase these rewards.
At the same time, Hunters need to be vigilant as their chance of entering a Nightmare increases with each level of a Sweet Dream they complete. Hunters should be familiar with the Nightmares they encounter as they will receive the Nightmare Omens corresponding to the rewards they select on each level of a Sweet Dream, and these omens will come true in a Nightmare that can come for Hunters at any time. In other words, the higher the level of the Sweet Dream, the more dangers Hunters will face in Nightmares.
No matter how beautiful the rewards are in a dream, it could just be a bubble that can pop at any time. These bubbles will only come true after Hunters escape from the Nightmare.

New Development System
When exploring a dream, Hunters will get a new season item called Dream Talking. Whenever Hunters perform Dream Talking Interpretation, they will obtain a dream base, which includes a Sweet Dream affix and a Nightmare affix. The original base affixes on a piece of gear will be replaced when the dream base is recorded onto the gear. Sweet Dream base affixes grant powerful buffs, such as allowing Hunters to gain Legendary affixes that have only appeared on Legendary gear when crafting gear. Nightmare base affixes, on the other hand, grant negative affixes that may weaken the gear. Therefore, Hunters will need to choose the right time to perform Dream Talking Interpretation. While trying to get the Sweet Dream affixes they seek, Hunters will also need to take care to avoid the negative impact of Nightmare affixes.

The Queen of Eternal Sun, a new supreme boss, is featured in the new season. On a long night filled with chaotic dreams, she opens her eyes again and waits for warriors to sacrifice themselves for her.

<RichText>The base value of Attack Speed depends on the Weapon Attack Speed.
The Weapon Attack Speed is determined by the base speed of the weapon and the affixes of the weapon that affect its Attack Speed.
When Dual Wielding, the Weapon Attack Speed is the average Attack Speed of the 2 weapons.
In most cases, the character's final Attack Speed = Weapon Attack Speed x (100 + all non-additional bonuses)% x (100 + additional bonus 1)% x (100 + additional bonus 2)%...
The Attack Speed of certain skills (such as attack-type mobility skills) will be corrected, and the actual speed will be lower than the result settled according to the above equation when the bonus received is quite high.
</><RichText Id="1433">Attack Speed is capped at 30 attacks per second</><RichText>.</>

rows.collection|unlocked_text|30601:
Through the stone wind barrier, I finally found the Ichi Tribe. I saw weapons everywhere on the street, which is consistent with their warrior culture as dictated in the legends. After all, it was not easy to make a living in the desert.

But as I went deeper into the streets, many cages appeared, and I suspected that the Ichi people had inherited an ancient tradition of exposing their captives to the public. Then, I realized that there captives are actually Ichi, who seem to be cursing the king.

It appeared that there was some civil strife here. But I, the Adventurer Elbert, came to find the last dragon, not to take sides and join camps. The difference between a brave adventurer and a brave warrior that adventures is: the former isn't willing to get involved in disputes during the journey.

rows.season|season_des|1001:
Season Background
Have you ever looked up at the sky and imagined thriving cities hidden among the islands floating in the clouds?
Loaded with supplies, Airships sail in the Desert Sea, shuttling between islands to trade treasures and wealth.
Yet beneath the seemingly calm quicksand lies a world of conflicts and raids.
Are you ready?
A Sand Bandit from your past has extended an invitation for you to become the master of Cloud Oasis.
Build, explore, and conquer this floating Oasis.
And become the most legendary Sandlord in the Desert Sea!


New Gameplay
Hunters can defeat Sand Pirates in the Netherrealm to gather resources for the Cloud Oasis-or even recruit them as laborers. In the Cloud Oasis, you can build and upgrade buildings, deploy laborers to produce resources, and send airships to trade resources for abundant rewards. Feeling bold? You can also deploy laborers on Gliders to raid Sand Pirates' Treasure Stashes to get rewards at no cost. The Cloud Oasis can operate on its own as long as it has enough resources. So sit back and watch your wealth grow!

New Upgrade System
In the Sandlord gameplay, you can trade to obtain precious Aromatic Materials and blend them according to recipes to grant a Belt unique Blending Affixes.
Blending Affixes can give you powerful bonuses, such as Medium Talents, Core Talents, and even Hero Trait Node of other Heroes.

rows.season|season_des|551:
Season Background
"The world of Torchlight is essentially an isolated island in a vast void, and countless terrifying and unknown creatures are lurking around us."
"Around us? More like they are lurking in our deepest and most secret dreams."
The wonderful thing about dreams is that you could be in a deep good dream or the claws of a nightmare...

New Gameplay
Hunters have a chance to enter a sweet dream when they interact with the Dream Lotus on the map.
After completing a Sweet Dream, Hunters will receive Dream Bubbles that contain rewards. Hunters will need to search for more lotuses to explore deeper levels of Sweet Dreams. Whenever a Sweet Dream level is completed, Hunters will inherit the rewards from the previous level and get the chance to further upgrade or increase these rewards.
At the same time, Hunters need to be vigilant as their chance of entering a Nightmare increases with each level of a Sweet Dream they complete. Hunters should be familiar with the Nightmares they encounter as they will receive the Nightmare Omens corresponding to the rewards they select on each level of a Sweet Dream, and these omens will come true in a Nightmare that can come for Hunters at any time. In other words, the higher the level of the Sweet Dream, the more dangers Hunters will face in Nightmares.
No matter how beautiful the rewards are in a dream, it could just be a bubble that can pop at any time. These bubbles will only come true after Hunters escape from the Nightmare.

New Development System
When exploring a dream, Hunters will get a new season item called Dream Talking. Whenever Hunters perform Dream Talking Interpretation, they will obtain a dream base, which includes a Sweet Dream affix and a Nightmare affix. The original base affixes on a piece of gear will be replaced when the dream base is recorded onto the gear. Sweet Dream base affixes grant powerful buffs, such as allowing Hunters to gain Legendary affixes that have only appeared on Legendary gear when crafting gear. Nightmare base affixes, on the other hand, grant negative affixes that may weaken the gear. Therefore, Hunters will need to choose the right time to perform Dream Talking Interpretation. While trying to get the Sweet Dream affixes they seek, Hunters will also need to take care to avoid the negative impact of Nightmare affixes.

The Queen of Eternal Sun, a new supreme boss, is featured in the new season. On a long night filled with chaotic dreams, she opens her eyes again and waits for warriors to sacrifice themselves for her.

rows.season|season_des|542:
Season Background
During the distant Epoch of War, a warrior known as Ralph wielded his blade against thousands of formidable foes in the Eternal Coliseum of gold, and he reigned undefeated. Now, the Epoch of War is but a distant memory, yet his brave and fearless spirit still lives on and shines brilliantly like gold, even to this day. O' warrior, defeat the countless enemies roaming the Netherrealm, advance to the Eternal Coliseum's center, and win the unparalleled rewards of the Invincible Champion!

Combat Frenzy
Blessed by the God of War, the rare monsters in the stage have a chance to be upgraded into Gladiator monsters of various tiers. Defeat them to enlarge your physique, or upgrade your Life and Energy Shield to achieve the same effect.
As your Physique grows, your Skill Area increases, and your Minions deal more damage. Rush into a frenzy and grow endlessly stronger!

Precious Drops
All exclusive items' drop rates are tripled during the preseason. Enjoy the feeling of being surrounded by Precious drops!
In addition, Gladiator monsters drop precious Proofs of Champion. Use the Proofs of Champion to enter the Eternal Coliseum, defeat the countless enemies that await there, and claim the almighty commendations of the God of War!

rows.gacha|des|35001:
In general, the base rate is applied to all Pactspirits. For Rate Up and Minimum Guarantee, the rates are subject to actual rules.
[Boon Rules]
The base rate of acquiring a Legendary Pactspirits is 1.500%. If you fail to obtain any Legendary Pactspirit after 50 Boons, the next Boon's rate of yielding a Legendary Pactspirit will be increased from 1.500% to 3.000%, and if this Boon doesn't yield a Legendary Pactspirit either, then the chance of obtaining a Legendary Pactspirit with the next Boon will be increased from 3.000% to 4.500%. This process repeats itself with a 1.500% rate increase for every Boon until the rate of acquiring a Legendary Pactspirit reaches 100.000%. Once a Legendary Pactspirit is obtained, the next Boon's chance will be reset to the base rate.

For every 10 Boons, at least 1 Pactspirit that is Rare or better is guaranteed.

[Rate Ups]
When the PYO (Pick-Your-Own) feature is enabled, you can pick a designated amount of Pactspirits in the Pactspirit List to get a 50.000% chance to obtain the Pactspirits you picked (if you picked multiple Pactspirits, they will share the chance equally). If that doesn't get you a Pactspirit you picked after getting 1 Legendary Pactspirit, the next Legendary Pactspirit you get from Boons is guaranteed to be a Pactspirit you picked. The count will be reset once a Pactspirit you picked is obtained.

[Duplicate Pactspirits]
When you receive Duplicate Pactspirits, they will be converted into a certain amount of Pactspirit Proofs. Surplus Proofs can be traded for Insight Essence at the in-game shop

[Boon Item List]
Legendary Pactspirits Base Rate: 1.500%
Rare Pactspirits Base Rate: 12.000%. When obtaining a Rare Pactspirit, there is a 30% chance it will be Letice - Frost
Magic Pactspirits Base Rate: 86.500%. When obtaining a Magic Pactspirit, there is a 30% chance it will be Shocket - Dark Night
The Legendary Pactspirit Shepherd will only appear in this Boon and will not be available in any other Boon. The season-exclusive gameplay of the season-exclusive Pactspirit will be added to the Season Rotation Pool once the season comes to an end. And the chances of that season-exclusive gameplay appearing in the next season will be reduced.

rows.manual_rule_des|des|1000001220:
<RichText Id="3103">Lucky & Unlucky</><RichText>
Certain random results in combat (such as damage rolls, Critical Strikes, Blocking, Evading and more) are affected by Lucky and Unlucky. They take effect by changing the number of rolls for the result:
Lucky: The result is rolled twice, and the more favorable one is kept.
Very Lucky: The result is rolled three times, and the most favorable one is kept.
Unlucky: The result is rolled twice, and the less favorable one is kept.
When Lucky and Unlucky are both present, they cancel each other out. When Very Lucky and Unlucky are both present, they cancel into Lucky.</>

1. This event contains 5 event stages, which can be accessed through the event screen of [Blacksail Rises Again].

3. Complete challenges to unlock stages in the order of Void Sea Terminal - Cleave the Waves, Void Sea Terminal - Break the Mast, Void Sea Terminal - Sever the Sea, Void Sea Terminal - Sing the Song, and Void Sea Terminal - Appease the Void Sea.
4. In Void Sea Terminal - Appease the Void Sea, Lord of the Void Sea's skills can deal massive damage to the Hunters, so please proceed with caution.
5. After completing the challenges, Hunters will need to return to the event screen to claim rewards.
6. After the event ends, Hunters will no longer be able to complete challenges or claim unclaimed rewards, so please complete the challenges and claim your rewards in time.

rows.manual_rule_des|des|1000000121:
<RichText Id="3103">Damage Over Time (DoT)</><RichText>
Damage Over Time effects deal damage to their targets continuously for a period of time.
The following mechanics</><RichText Id="3100"> can </><RichText>affect Damage Over Time:
</><RichText Id="3160" Udl="1" HyperLinkType="0" EventId="JumpTo:164001:10000006"> Affliction</><RichText>, </><RichText Id="3160" Udl="1" HyperLinkType="0" EventId="JumpTo:164001:10000007">Reaping</><RichText>, </><RichText Id="3160" Udl="1" HyperLinkType="0" EventId="JumpTo:164001:10000008">conversion of the type of damage taken</><RichText>.
The following mechanics</><RichText Id="3100"> will not </><RichText>affect Damage Over Time: Accuracy and Evasion, Armor, Critical Strike, conversion or addition of the type of damage dealt, Double Damage, Injury Transfer, Injury Buffer, Block, Damage Avoidance, Severe Injury.</>

rows.season|season_des|1042:
Season Background
Have you ever looked up at the sky and imagined thriving cities hidden among the islands floating in the clouds?
Loaded with supplies, Airships sail in the Desert Sea, shuttling between islands to trade treasures and wealth.
Yet beneath the seemingly calm quicksand lies a world of conflicts and raids.
Are you ready?
A Sand Bandit from your past has extended an invitation for you to become the master of Cloud Oasis.
Build, explore, and conquer this floating Oasis.
And become the most legendary Sandlord in the Desert Sea!


New Gameplay
Hunters can defeat Sand Pirates in the Netherrealm to gather resources for the Cloud Oasis-or even recruit them as laborers. In the Cloud Oasis, you can build and upgrade buildings, deploy laborers to produce resources, and send airships to trade resources for abundant rewards. Feeling bold? You can also deploy laborers on Gliders to raid Sand Pirates' Treasure Stashes to get rewards at no cost. The Cloud Oasis can operate on its own as long as it has enough resources. So sit back and watch your wealth grow!

New Upgrade System
In the Sandlord gameplay, you can trade to obtain precious Aromatic Materials and blend them according to recipes to grant a Belt unique Blending Affixes.
Blending Affixes can give you powerful bonuses, such as Medium Talents, Core Talents, and even Hero Trait Node of other Heroes.

rows.system_help|description|3:
About Skill Slots:
1. Skill slots require energy to unlock, including active and passive unlocking.
2. The first slot of each skill tab passively unlocks when energy reaches the cap.
3. Players need to allocate energy to unlock other skill slots.
4. Energy can be gained by leveling up characters and equipping gear (excluding trinkets).

About Skills:
1. Skills are divided into Active Skills, Support Skills, Passive Skills and Triggered Skills.
2. Active and Passive Skills can be linked to Support Skills.
3. Triggered Skills can be linked to Active and Support Skills.
4. Available Support Skills that can be linked are identified by their skill tags.
5. Only one skill will be active when identical skills are equipped.
6. The availability of Active Skills depends on the weapons equipped by characters.

rows.gacha|des|3001:
In general, the base rate is applied to all Pactspirits. For Rate Up and Minimum Guarantee, the rates are subject to actual rules.
[Boon Rules]
The base rate of acquiring a Legendary Pactspirits is 1.500%. If you fail to obtain any Legendary Pactspirit after 50 Boons, the next Boon's rate of yielding a Legendary Pactspirit will be increased from 1.500% to 3.000%, and if this Boon doesn't yield a Legendary Pactspirit either, then the chance of obtaining a Legendary Pactspirit with the next Boon will be increased from 3.000% to 4.500%. This process repeats itself with a 1.500% rate increase for every Boon until the rate of acquiring a Legendary Pactspirit reaches 100.000%. Once a Legendary Pactspirit is obtained, the next Boon's chance will be reset to the base rate.

For every 10 Boons, at least 1 Pactspirit that is Rare or better is guaranteed.

[Rate Ups]
When the PYO (Pick-Your-Own) feature is enabled, you can pick a designated amount of Pactspirits in the Pactspirit List to get a 25.000% chance to obtain the Pactspirits you picked (if you picked multiple Pactspirits, they will share the chance equally). If that doesn't get you a Pactspirit you picked after getting 3 Legendary Pactspirits, the next Legendary Pactspirit you get from Boons is guaranteed to be a Pactspirit you picked. The count will be reset once a Pactspirit you picked is obtained.

[Duplicate Pactspirits]
When you receive Duplicate Pactspirits, they will be converted into a certain amount of Pactspirit Proofs. Surplus Proofs can be traded for Insight Essence at the in-game shop

[Boon Item List]
Legendary Pactspirits Base Rate: 1.500%
Rare Pactspirits Base Rate: 12.000%. When obtaining a Rare Pactspirit, there is a 30% chance it will be Hell Cavalry - Sea
Magic Pactspirits Base Rate: 86.500%. When obtaining a Magic Pactspirit, there is a 30% chance it will be Spiny Snail - Cloud
The Legendary Pactspirit Prisoner of Desire will only appear in this Boon and will not be available in any other Boon. The season-exclusive gameplay of the season-exclusive Pactspirit will be added to the Season Rotation Pool once the season comes to an end. And the chances of that season-exclusive gameplay appearing in the next season will be reduced. The exclusive Pactspirit is only available in the current pool.
The exclusive Pactspirit's effects remain valid permanently.

rows.system_help|description|4:
About Pactspirits:
1. Pactspirits come in two main types: Battle Pactspirits and Drop Pactspirits, and 3 of each type can be installed.
2. Installed Battle Pactspirits have their own exclusive Pact Pages.
3. Installed Rare Pactspirits can unlock Pact Points in advance.
4. No allocations are required for Drop Pactspirits as all their Talent Node effects are activated upon installation.
5. Any Pactspirit, installed or not, can be selected to follow you and automatically pick up some loot.

About Destinies:
1. Destinies can be installed in Talent Nodes where you've already allocated points in the Pact Page to replace the original effects of the Talent Nodes.
2. Installing a Destiny doesn't cost anything. When removing a Destiny, it is possible to select 2 different types of materials, each yielding a different outcome.
3. Destinies are divided into Micro and Medium Destinies, and each type of Destiny has a separate installation quantity limit, which is gradually unlocked by completing specific quests. Refer to [Installation Limit] on the right side of the Pact Page for details.
4. Undetermined Fates are installed in Undetermined Fate Slots, granting a number of additional Destiny Slots that do not count toward the installation limit of Destinies. Undetermined Fates do not count toward the total number of installed Destinies.

rows.season|season_des|1132:
Season Background
TOWER Co. is a megacorporation entrenched in Leptis. Originally founded as an arms factory of the old empire, it has managed to evolve into today's colossal conglomerate through Synthetic Troop technology.
In recent years, TOWER Co. has monopolized key resources, technologies, and basic infrastructure, as well as built a powerful private army for itself.
Under its oppression, righteous outlaws have risen up and become the vanguard against TOWER Co.
Outlaws, listen up! How'd you like to pull off a real robbery?

New Gameplay
TOWER Co.'s Transport Vehicles sit vulnerable in the Netherrealm-loaded with vault-bound riches.
In Carjack, the escort bodyguards will flee in waves with TOWER Supply Caches. You will need to chase them down and defeat their reinforcements within the time limit.
The more escort bodyguards you take down, the bigger your payout.
But don't take too long, because the Transport Vehicles and all security personnel might flee the scene if you do.
Before a Carjack, there's a chance that the Fixer from the Black Market will issue a Bounty Order. You can pay the required amount of TOWER Coins to accept the bounty and complete it to earn additional bounty rewards.
If hijacking convoys is too easy for you, it's time to hit TOWER Co. itself!
TOWER Co. Central Vault is the ultimate endgame challenge of the Outlaw season. Inside this heavily fortified complex, you'll find multiple secure strongrooms-raid as many as you can handle before time runs out, take down the vault's guardian boss, and claim the ultimate strongroom's legendary rewards.

New Upgrade System
R&D can be performed on non-Legendary weapons in the TOWER Sequence system to obtain powerful TOWER Sequences.
To perform R&D, Hunters must spend a set number of Mods. During R&D, Hunters can choose from several chips of random colors in each round. If the colors of the chips you chose match the target sequence (in any order) after all selections have been made, you'll obtain the effects of the target sequence.
There are 2 types of R&D: Basic R&D and In-Depth R&D.
Basic R&D only yields Basic sequences and Intermediate sequences. Advanced sequences can only be obtained from In-Depth R&D. Each weapon can only have 1 sequence, but Hunters can perform R&D repeatedly until the desired target sequence is obtained.
TOWER sequences grant Hunters regular stats and provide core mechanics that can inspire many fantastic builds.

Project Name: Lakhouma Desert Lamp Project

Tenderer: Sherlock

1. Letter of Tender:

Now that I've become a legal citizen of Ichi through investment, why not let me do even more for my kingdom? According to the regulations in the project tender document, we have studied the project site, tender document, and other relative files and are willing to obey the contract terms, engineering construction standard, and bill of quantities. We request to contract with the above-mentioned construction and completion and be responsible for any quality defects.

If we win this bidding, we promise to complete and deliver the whole project within five years as the Instruction to Tenderer requires.

2. Construction Organization Design:

The Desert Lamp project can reach as far as the Borderlands, and I believe it's beyond any company's given scope. To protect ecologists' fragile feelings and the conservatives' obsessions toward the mother river, we plan not to plant any lamp posts or cables in the Partatar River area to avoid citizens mistaking our actions for undermining the proof of King Lionheart's great decisions. After thorough research, we'll announce that the construction is unable to be carried out because of the complicated underground drainage and quicksand soil of the Partatar River area.

rows.handbook|description|10140:
As a stat that counteracts Resistance, Resistance Penetration acts on the defender's effective Resistance in the damage calculation process.
When dealing damage, if the attacker has Resistance Penetration of a certain type, the defender's Resistance will be reduced accordingly by the value of the Resistance Penetration when calculating the damage.
Resistance Penetration does not change the value of the defender's Resistance.
Resistance Penetration takes effect on all forms of damage (Hit, DoT, Secondary, Reflect).

<RichText>The base Max Stacks of Ill Omen is 10 stacks. Inflicts 1 stack of Ill Omen whenever the cumulative Damage Over Time dealt to a monster reaches the trigger threshold.
Non-Elite enemies: Single-stack trigger threshold = 8% of the Max Life of non-Elite enemies.
Elite enemies: Single-stack trigger threshold = 5% of the Max Life of Elite enemies.
Ill Omen is triggered upon reaching max stacks, consuming all Ill Omen stacks to instantly eliminate non-Elite enemies and deal True Damage equal to 20% of Max Life to Elite enemies.
Supreme bosses will only trigger Ill Omen once.</>

New Gameplay
Encompass as many statues as possible in the Lunar Ring, then Strum the Lunar Harp to awaken and defeat them to get instant drop rewards. The more statues activated, the greater the drop bonus.
The gameplay includes surprise events like Lunar Omen and the special themed Rhapsody, which changes the entire experience.
Install Lunar Strings in the Lunar Harp to customize the gameplay to suit your own pace.

New Development System
Memory Revival adds several different powerful effects to Hero Memories, including 1 or more unique Hero Trait Affixes tailored to each hero.

rows.season|season_des|951:
Season Background
Take a moment to silently reflect on what you seek in your heart and mind, for the divination is about to begin.
You picked The Empress, The Chariot...
But before I reveal the meaning of your reading, I must ask you one last time...
Are you truly prepared to pay the price of peering into fate?
Knowing that the very future you wish to glimpse will be shaped by every tarot card you draw from this moment forward...
Do you still want to see it?

New Gameplay
Mysterious tarot cards are scattered throughout the Netherrealm stages, each one offering a glimpse into the threads of destiny. Over a dozen tarot-themed trials await daring Hunters, including The Chariot, The Emperor, The Hermit, and The Sun.
Upon completing each Tarot Trial, you will receive a Note of Arcana, a vital key to unlocking your full potential along the Tarot Path.
Beware, though-while the Tarot Path is lined with alluring Chests of Destiny, it is also riddled with traps.
The Notes of Arcana will guide your way, helping you steer clear of traps while helping you claim the Chests of Destiny you seek.
The ultimate challenge of fate starts when you want to open your Chests of Destiny.
At that time, the Tarot Trials corresponding to the Chests of Destiny will be revealed in turn.
When starting a specific wave of battle, the additional tarot themes will be applied to the new Tarot Trial.
Thus, the power of multiple tarot cards will be applied simultaneously as the battle intensifies.
Correspondingly, Hunters' rewards will accumulate to unforeseen heights in this wonderful trial.
The price that must be paid for the gifts of destiny has been marked, and the answer you seek lies in the tarot cards.

New Upgrade System
Hunters can form pacts with up to three Drop Pactspirits and three Battle Pactspirits.
In the Arcana gameplay, Hunters will obtain a variety of Destinies, each of which has different effects. Installing them in the corresponding Battle Pactspirit Talent Nodes will replace the original effects of the Talent Nodes and change destiny.
There are two types of Destinies: Fates and Kismets, with the exceptionally rare Dual Kismets offering even greater potential.
Fates grant Hunters regular stats such as Resistances, Mana Compensation, Curse effects, etc.
Kismets, on the other hand, grant rarer and more potent effects, paving the way for unique and powerful builds that can transform your playstyle.

rows.season|season_des|611:
Season Background
During the distant Epoch of War, a warrior known as Ralph wielded his blade against thousands of formidable foes in the Eternal Coliseum of gold, and he reigned undefeated. Now, the Epoch of War is but a distant memory, yet his brave and fearless spirit still lives on and shines brilliantly like gold, even to this day. O' warrior, defeat the countless enemies roaming the Netherrealm, advance to the Eternal Coliseum's center, and win the unparalleled rewards of the Invincible Champion!

Combat Frenzy
Blessed by the God of War, the rare monsters in the stage have a chance to be upgraded into Gladiator monsters of various tiers. Defeat them to enlarge your physique, or upgrade your Life and Energy Shield to achieve the same effect.
As your Physique grows, your Skill Area increases, and your Minions deal more damage. Rush into a frenzy and grow endlessly stronger!

Precious Drops
All exclusive items' drop rates are tripled during the preseason. Enjoy the feeling of being surrounded by Precious drops!
In addition, Gladiator monsters drop precious Proofs of Champion. Use the Proofs of Champion to enter the Eternal Coliseum, defeat the countless enemies that await there, and claim the almighty commendations of the God of War!

rows.season|season_des|1341:
Season Background
A strange disease called Vorax has infected the monsters of Leptis!
Once infected, they turn crimson and enter a state of extreme hyperactivity and frenzy. They even devour each other, absorbing the endlessly multiplying diseased tissue within their bodies to evolve into more powerful and grotesque monstrosities.
As the crisis looms, Mad Doctor Shelley's underground clinic officially opens for business!

New Gameplay
This clinic is home to the best Vorax specialist in all of Leptis!
The first stage of treatment is to find suitable patients. Defeat Vorax Elites in Netherrealm stages to collect the Vorax Substance on them. Obtaining sufficiently potent doses of Vorax Substances is the foundation of treatment.
The second stage of treatment is to visit Mad Doctor Shelley's underground clinic to start the Surgical Preparation phase.
Here, Hunters will perform surgeries on Vorax-infected monsters in preparation for further surgeries in different directions based on monsters' diverse racial talents.
During this stage, Hunters can choose freely from dozens of Surgical Instruments and Potions, combining them in various ways to gradually cultivate the ultimate Vorax host.
Each race has extremely rare Special Potions. These Special Potions provide a set of special medications, which increase in potency with each round, until a miraculous Potion with super high Ultimate Activity is created.
The surgery officially begins in the third stage of treatment!
Hunters will now have to dispose of the powerful monsters they just created.
Defeat them to recover precious Vorax antidotes from their bodies and exchange them for corresponding rewards.
Antidote Vials in the Operating Theater will fill up as more monsters are defeated, and the rewards earned by exchanging them become increasingly better as their potency increases.

New Development System
Grafting lets Hunters craft Vorax Gear-unrestricted by Strength, Intelligence, or Dexterity, with a shared affix pool across different parts, and even capable of holding Legendary affixes.
Use Normal Organs to add Basic or Advanced affixes to Vorax Gear. Use Special Organs to add Ultimate affixes to Vorax Gear. Use Core Organs and Sutures to add Legendary affixes to Vorax Gear.
Vorax Corrosion increases the tier of Vorax Gear affixes, potentially increasing all pre-fixes and suffixes by 1 - 2 tiers.

rows.season|season_des|1141:
Season Background
TOWER Co. is a megacorporation entrenched in Leptis. Originally founded as an arms factory of the old empire, it has managed to evolve into today's colossal conglomerate through Synthetic Troop technology.
In recent years, TOWER Co. has monopolized key resources, technologies, and basic infrastructure, as well as built a powerful private army for itself.
Under its oppression, righteous outlaws have risen up and become the vanguard against TOWER Co.
Outlaws, listen up! How'd you like to pull off a real robbery?

New Gameplay
TOWER Co.'s Transport Vehicles sit vulnerable in the Netherrealm-loaded with vault-bound riches.
In Carjack, the escort bodyguards will flee in waves with TOWER Supply Caches. You will need to chase them down and defeat their reinforcements within the time limit.
The more escort bodyguards you take down, the bigger your payout.
But don't take too long, because the Transport Vehicles and all security personnel might flee the scene if you do.
Before a Carjack, there's a chance that the Fixer from the Black Market will issue a Bounty Order. You can pay the required amount of TOWER Coins to accept the bounty and complete it to earn additional bounty rewards.
If hijacking convoys is too easy for you, it's time to hit TOWER Co. itself!
TOWER Co. Central Vault is the ultimate endgame challenge of the Outlaw season. Inside this heavily fortified complex, you'll find multiple secure strongrooms-raid as many as you can handle before time runs out, take down the vault's guardian boss, and claim the ultimate strongroom's legendary rewards.

New Upgrade System
R&D can be performed on non-Legendary weapons in the TOWER Sequence system to obtain powerful TOWER Sequences.
To perform R&D, Hunters must spend a set number of Mods. During R&D, Hunters can choose from several chips of random colors in each round. If the colors of the chips you chose match the target sequence (in any order) after all selections have been made, you'll obtain the effects of the target sequence.
There are 2 types of R&D: Basic R&D and In-Depth R&D.
Basic R&D only yields Basic sequences and Intermediate sequences. Advanced sequences can only be obtained from In-Depth R&D. Each weapon can only have 1 sequence, but Hunters can perform R&D repeatedly until the desired target sequence is obtained.
TOWER sequences grant Hunters regular stats and provide core mechanics that can inspire many fantastic builds.

rows.season|season_des|1321:
Season Background
A strange disease called Vorax has infected the monsters of Leptis!
Once infected, they turn crimson and enter a state of extreme hyperactivity and frenzy. They even devour each other, absorbing the endlessly multiplying diseased tissue within their bodies to evolve into more powerful and grotesque monstrosities.
As the crisis looms, Mad Doctor Shelley's underground clinic officially opens for business!

New Gameplay
This clinic is home to the best Vorax specialist in all of Leptis!
The first stage of treatment is to find suitable patients. Defeat Vorax Elites in Netherrealm stages to collect the Vorax Substance on them. Obtaining sufficiently potent doses of Vorax Substances is the foundation of treatment.
The second stage of treatment is to visit Mad Doctor Shelley's underground clinic to start the Surgical Preparation phase.
Here, Hunters will perform surgeries on Vorax-infected monsters in preparation for further surgeries in different directions based on monsters' diverse racial talents.
During this stage, Hunters can choose freely from dozens of Surgical Instruments and Potions, combining them in various ways to gradually cultivate the ultimate Vorax host.
Each race has extremely rare Special Potions. These Special Potions provide a set of special medications, which increase in potency with each round, until a miraculous Potion with super high Ultimate Activity is created.
The surgery officially begins in the third stage of treatment!
Hunters will now have to dispose of the powerful monsters they just created.
Defeat them to recover precious Vorax antidotes from their bodies and exchange them for corresponding rewards.
Antidote Vials in the Operating Theater will fill up as more monsters are defeated, and the rewards earned by exchanging them become increasingly better as their potency increases.

New Development System
Grafting lets Hunters craft Vorax Gear-unrestricted by Strength, Intelligence, or Dexterity, with a shared affix pool across different parts, and even capable of holding Legendary affixes.
Use Normal Organs to add Basic or Advanced affixes to Vorax Gear. Use Special Organs to add Ultimate affixes to Vorax Gear. Use Core Organs and Sutures to add Legendary affixes to Vorax Gear.
Vorax Corrosion increases the tier of Vorax Gear affixes, potentially increasing all pre-fixes and suffixes by 1 - 2 tiers.

rows.season|season_des|922:
Season Background
Take a moment to silently reflect on what you seek in your heart and mind, for the divination is about to begin.
You picked The Empress, The Chariot...
But before I reveal the meaning of your reading, I must ask you one last time...
Are you truly prepared to pay the price of peering into fate?
Knowing that the very future you wish to glimpse will be shaped by every tarot card you draw from this moment forward...
Do you still want to see it?

New Gameplay
Mysterious tarot cards are scattered throughout the Netherrealm stages, each one offering a glimpse into the threads of destiny. Over a dozen tarot-themed trials await daring Hunters, including The Chariot, The Emperor, The Hermit, and The Sun.
Upon completing each Tarot Trial, you will receive a Note of Arcana, a vital key to unlocking your full potential along the Tarot Path.
Beware, though-while the Tarot Path is lined with alluring Chests of Destiny, it is also riddled with traps.
The Notes of Arcana will guide your way, helping you steer clear of traps while helping you claim the Chests of Destiny you seek.
The ultimate challenge of fate starts when you want to open your Chests of Destiny.
At that time, the Tarot Trials corresponding to the Chests of Destiny will be revealed in turn.
When starting a specific wave of battle, the additional tarot themes will be applied to the new Tarot Trial.
Thus, the power of multiple tarot cards will be applied simultaneously as the battle intensifies.
Correspondingly, Hunters' rewards will accumulate to unforeseen heights in this wonderful trial.
The price that must be paid for the gifts of destiny has been marked, and the answer you seek lies in the tarot cards.

New Upgrade System
Hunters can form pacts with up to three Drop Pactspirits and three Battle Pactspirits.
In the Arcana gameplay, Hunters will obtain a variety of Destinies, each of which has different effects. Installing them in the corresponding Battle Pactspirit Talent Nodes will replace the original effects of the Talent Nodes and change destiny.
There are two types of Destinies: Fates and Kismets, with the exceptionally rare Dual Kismets offering even greater potential.
Fates grant Hunters regular stats such as Resistances, Mana Compensation, Curse effects, etc.
Kismets, on the other hand, grant rarer and more potent effects, paving the way for unique and powerful builds that can transform your playstyle.

rows.season|season_des|1401:
Season Background
The story begins with a legend from a time long forgotten.
"Once, in an age beyond memory, there lived a race that called the moon their home.
They were masters of song and dance. Every part of their being resonated like a fine instrument, producing melodies of sublime beauty.
But when the moon fell from the heavens, they turned into cold stone-statues scattered to the four winds.
It is said that these statues will awaken once more when the bright moon shines again. They will join you in a symphony of the full moon, offering treasures long lost to time.
So, Traveler, strum the Lunar Strings.
Call the moon to its zenith, turn the moonlight into song, and uncover the secrets sleeping inside the stone.
Tonight-let's shine together."

New Gameplay
Step into an area teeming with Lunar Stone Statues. Place the Lunar Ring at your feet to encompass as many statues as possible and Strum the Lunar Harp to awaken them, then take them down to earn instant drop rewards. The more statues you wake in one strum, the higher your Combo count, which results in greater Drop Quantity bonuses-and greater loot.
Lunar Omen events will appear at random, bringing both challenges and generous rewards. Fortunate Hunters may even stumble upon the game-changing Rhapsody gameplay-a twist that reshapes the "rhythm" you play and delivers a bountiful run you won't forget.
Install your Lunar Harp with various Lunar Strings to customize bonus effects and select the playstyle that perfectly matches your rhythm.

New Development System
Memory Revival is a crafting method that imbues Hero Memories with special powers.
Revival grants various effects to Hero Memories, increasing the values of their base affixes, upgrading Fixed Affixes, giving them special random affixes, and even adding a powerful Revived Affix.
Revived Affixes even include 1 or more unique Hero Trait Affixes tailored to each hero.

Armor is a defensive mechanic against Hit, Secondary, and Reflected Damage
Characters start with 0 Armor by default
Relevant Stats
Armor
Armor %
Additional Armor %
Gear Armor
Gear Armor %

Damage reduction provided by Armor = Armor/(Armor x0.9+30,000). The max damage reduction provided by Armor is 80%.
Only 60% of the damage reduction provided by Armor will work for Non-Physical Damage.

Double Armor
When receiving damage, double the Armor value will be used to determine the damage reduction. This only takes effect in the damage calculation process and does not change the actual Armor value

rows.collection|unlocked_text|31102:
Dear mother,

Please forgive me for not saying goodbye.

I feel guilty and ashamed for the loss at the Road of the Moon. I failed to make it to the top as uncle Gerald did. I put shame on the Nasso family. But please believe that your son is by no means a weak loser. I will have my revenge at the Road of the Stars. If there will be only one survivor who can step out of the arena and onto a glory road to meet the queen, that would be your son.

Please wait for me. I couldn't find messengers here who help with mail. Is there no order or service on this road at all? But there's no hurry. When I finally meet the queen, I'll ask her to kiss the letter, and send you it with the queen's grace to share this glory with you.

rows.collection|unlocked_text|20702:
To Andrik,

I saw that monster again! I swear it was real, you must trust me!

Last night, I walked around a napping crusader to the alley, and that long, slim thing was right there. It looked very pale but its head was swollen like a watermelon! Its legs looked very weak, but there were lots of arms on its neck and chest!

I was horrified so I hid behind a tree and couldn't move. That monster crawled on its hands across the garden and climbed on Millie's window, peaking inside! I was almost scared to death!

Just when I was about to call crusaders for help, that monster suddenly ran away on its hands. Thank goodness it didn't go inside Millie's house.

Andrik, please, let's go out tonight! I promise you the crusaders won't find us! Let's find out the secret of this monster together!
