rows.gacha|des|201:
In general, the base rate is applied to all Pactspirits. For Rate Up and Minimum Guarantee, the rates are subject to actual rules.
[Boon Rules]
The base rate of acquiring a Legendary Pactspirits is 1.500%. If you fail to obtain any Legendary Pactspirit after 50 Boons, the next Boon's rate of yielding a Legendary Pactspirit will be increased from 1.500% to 3.000%, and if this Boon doesn't yield a Legendary Pactspirit either, then the chance of obtaining a Legendary Pactspirit with the next Boon will be increased from 3.000% to 4.500%. This process repeats itself with a 1.500% rate increase per Boon until the rate of acquiring a Legendary Pactspirit reaches 100.000%. Once a Legendary Pactspirit is obtained, the next Boon's chance will be reset to the base rate.

For every 10 Boons, at least 1 Pactspirit that is Rare or better is guaranteed.

[Rate Ups]
When the PYO (Pick-Your-Own) feature is enabled, you can pick a designated amount of tags in the Tag List to get a 50.000% chance to obtain Pactspirits with the picked tags (multiple Pactspirits with the same tag will share the chance equally). If that doesn't get you a Pactspirit with the designated tags, the next Legendary Pactspirit you get from Boons is guaranteed to have the tags you picked. The PYO feature may lose its effects after you obtain a certain amount of Legendary Pactspirits with the tags you picked, and when it does, the pool will be automatically closed down.

[Duplicate Pactspirits]
When you receive Duplicate Pactspirits, they will be converted into a certain amount of Pactspirit Proofs. Surplus Proofs can be traded for Insight Essence at the in-game shop

[Boon Item List]
Legendary Pactspirits Base Rate: 1.500%
Rare Pactspirits Base Rate: 12.000%
Magic Pactspirits Base Rate: 86.500%
The Boons here belong to Tagged Pactspirit Pools. All Tagged Pactspirit Pools share the rate up effects and Minimum Guarantee chances (not include the PYO feature's remaining amount of attempts) and are independent from other Boons' rate up effects and Minimum Guarantee chances.

rows.season|season_des|841:
Season Background
Unfold a piece of cold Snowpaper and apply colorful Paint to the white snow.
Breathe life into everything as you fill in the snowy landscape with colors.
Eventually, the empty frozen canvas becomes a vibrant work of art.
After the last brush falls, the painter also becomes part of the painting.
What magnificent scenery awaits the one who created the world on this frozen canvas and entered it?

New Gameplay
After collecting Snowpaper Fragments in the Netherrealm, Hunters will select a difficulty and consume these fragments to unfold the canvas. After the canvas is unfolded, Hunters will need to defeat monsters in Netherrealm stages of the corresponding difficulty to collect various colors and types of Paint.
Hunters will need to place the corresponding Paints in the appropriate areas according to the Coloring Paint instructions, upgrade the Paints, and obtain new Coloring Paints until the canvas is completed.
After the painting is completed, Hunters can enter the frozen canvas of their painting to challenge monsters created from paint and the gameplay to get Splendor Eggs containing various rewards.

New Development System
Several Exclusive Support Skills have been added for most Active Skills, increasing the damage dealt by these skills and changing their form, giving them many unexpected amazing effects that will enrich Hunters' combat experience.
Collect Exclusive Support Skills and Inspiration Essences that are used to upgrade skills from the Frozen Canvas gameplay to create more powerful, more diverse, and more creative new builds.

1. This event contains 5 event stages, which can be accessed through the event screen of [The End of the False God].
2. The event stages do not require any admission ticket and can be challenged repeatedly. Failed challenges do not deduct any XP.
3. Complete challenges to unlock stages in the order of False God's Shrine - Oblivion, False God's Shrine - Awakening, False God's Shrine - Ascension, False God's Shrine - Animitta Creation, and False God's Shrine - Echoes of Annihilation.
4. In False God's Shrine - Echoes of Annihilation, the False God's skills can deal massive damage to the Hunters, so please proceed with caution.
5. After completing the challenges, Hunters will need to return to the event screen to claim rewards. Rewards can only be claimed once. Stages can still be challenged repeatedly after rewards are claimed.
6. After the event ends, Hunters will no longer be able to complete challenges or claim unclaimed rewards, so please complete the challenges and claim your rewards in time.

rows.season|season_des|941:
Season Background
Take a moment to silently reflect on what you seek in your heart and mind, for the divination is about to begin.
You picked The Empress, The Chariot...
But before I reveal the meaning of your reading, I must ask you one last time...
Are you truly prepared to pay the price of peering into fate?
Knowing that the very future you wish to glimpse will be shaped by every tarot card you draw from this moment forward...
Do you still want to see it?

New Gameplay
Mysterious tarot cards are scattered throughout the Netherrealm stages, each one offering a glimpse into the threads of destiny. Over a dozen tarot-themed trials await daring Hunters, including The Chariot, The Emperor, The Hermit, and The Sun.
Upon completing each Tarot Trial, you will receive a Note of Arcana, a vital key to unlocking your full potential along the Tarot Path.
Beware, though-while the Tarot Path is lined with alluring Chests of Destiny, it is also riddled with traps.
The Notes of Arcana will guide your way, helping you steer clear of traps while helping you claim the Chests of Destiny you seek.
The ultimate challenge of fate starts when you want to open your Chests of Destiny.
At that time, the Tarot Trials corresponding to the Chests of Destiny will be revealed in turn.
When starting a specific wave of battle, the additional tarot themes will be applied to the new Tarot Trial.
Thus, the power of multiple tarot cards will be applied simultaneously as the battle intensifies.
Correspondingly, Hunters' rewards will accumulate to unforeseen heights in this wonderful trial.
The price that must be paid for the gifts of destiny has been marked, and the answer you seek lies in the tarot cards.

New Upgrade System
Hunters can form pacts with up to three Drop Pactspirits and three Battle Pactspirits.
In the Arcana gameplay, Hunters will obtain a variety of Destinies, each of which has different effects. Installing them in the corresponding Battle Pactspirit Talent Nodes will replace the original effects of the Talent Nodes and change destiny.
There are two types of Destinies: Fates and Kismets, with the exceptionally rare Dual Kismets offering even greater potential.
Fates grant Hunters regular stats such as Resistances, Mana Compensation, Curse effects, etc.
Kismets, on the other hand, grant rarer and more potent effects, paving the way for unique and powerful builds that can transform your playstyle.

rows.system_help|description|35:
In Boss Conquest, you will challenge the supreme boss Aureate Calamity Ordrak.
Boss Conquest consists of many ranks and generous rewards. Each rank you conquer takes you closer to the rewards of the next rank.
You get 2 revive chances when you enter Boss Conquest - Rusted Abyss and will lose 1 revive chance when you are defeated or when you leave and re-enter. The challenge ends when you run out of revive chances. The challenge also has a countdown, and it ends when time runs out.
You can challenge Boss Conquest as many times as you like. If you are unhappy with your result, challenge it again to keep improving your result!
You will also receive a daily reward for your first boss challenge made every day. The rewards correspond to your highest rank achieved, so the higher you climb, the better the daily rewards.
If the character is defeated in Boss Conquest while playing in Hardcore Mode or Solo Self Found Hardcore Mode, the character will still remain available for the current season.
Rewards for this gameplay can only be claimed in Normal Mode on seasonal servers.

rows.season|season_des|1551:
Season Background
Usher Mortuary - Night Watcher Recruitment Letter
After the Calamity, Leptis became a sprawling graveyard. Countless tormented souls still weep in the night wind.
To keep our vow to console the departed, this mortuary hereby resumes the Rite of Vigil. Our Vigil Procession will escort the coffins carrying the gathered souls to their eternal rest in the netherworld.
However, Wraiths lurk along the path to disturb the peace of the dead-a most unbecoming conduct.
We now seek Night Watchers to guard the procession, purge the Wraiths along the way, and ensure an unimpeded passage for the vigil.
Tonight, when the Guiding Lantern kindles, we await you as promised-join us in the Vigil.
-Madam Usher

New Gameplay
Interact with the Nameless Coffins in Netherrealm stages to start the Vigil. As the Vigil Procession advances, your Guiding Lantern will attract Wraiths along the path. Defeat the ceaseless tide of Wraiths and claim generous rewards! Within the time limit, the faster you defeat Wraiths, the faster they spawn-and the greater your rewards!
You may also encounter a gameplay theme that defies convention: the Noble Coffin. The occupants of such coffins are often of extraordinary status, making the challenge more formidable-but the rewards far more bountiful.
During the vigil, Vigil Anomalies may appear at random, bringing Anomaly monsters that grant rich rewards, or altering the gameplay rules for additional rewards.
At the Usher Mortuary, you may awaken different Relics to modify gameplay and greatly improve drops.

New Development System
Install Nether King's Divinity on Divinity Slates to draw upon the might of the gods, and harness the mysterious power of Nether King.
Nether King's Divinity influences other Divinity Slates, enhancing their affix effects, projecting its own affixes onto surrounding slates, and unlocking powerful exclusive affix effects by adjusting the number of adjacent and non-adjacent slates.

rows.season|season_des|1131:
Season Background
TOWER Co. is a megacorporation entrenched in Leptis. Originally founded as an arms factory of the old empire, it has managed to evolve into today's colossal conglomerate through Synthetic Troop technology.
In recent years, TOWER Co. has monopolized key resources, technologies, and basic infrastructure, as well as built a powerful private army for itself.
Under its oppression, righteous outlaws have risen up and become the vanguard against TOWER Co.
Outlaws, listen up! How'd you like to pull off a real robbery?

New Gameplay
TOWER Co.'s Transport Vehicles sit vulnerable in the Netherrealm-loaded with vault-bound riches.
In Carjack, the escort bodyguards will flee in waves with TOWER Supply Caches. You will need to chase them down and defeat their reinforcements within the time limit.
The more escort bodyguards you take down, the bigger your payout.
But don't take too long, because the Transport Vehicles and all security personnel might flee the scene if you do.
Before a Carjack, there's a chance that the Fixer from the Black Market will issue a Bounty Order. You can pay the required amount of TOWER Coins to accept the bounty and complete it to earn additional bounty rewards.
If hijacking convoys is too easy for you, it's time to hit TOWER Co. itself!
TOWER Co. Central Vault is the ultimate endgame challenge of the Outlaw season. Inside this heavily fortified complex, you'll find multiple secure strongrooms-raid as many as you can handle before time runs out, take down the vault's guardian boss, and claim the ultimate strongroom's legendary rewards.

New Upgrade System
R&D can be performed on non-Legendary weapons in the TOWER Sequence system to obtain powerful TOWER Sequences.
To perform R&D, Hunters must spend a set number of Mods. During R&D, Hunters can choose from several chips of random colors in each round. If the colors of the chips you chose match the target sequence (in any order) after all selections have been made, you'll obtain the effects of the target sequence.
There are 2 types of R&D: Basic R&D and In-Depth R&D.
Basic R&D only yields Basic sequences and Intermediate sequences. Advanced sequences can only be obtained from In-Depth R&D. Each weapon can only have 1 sequence, but Hunters can perform R&D repeatedly until the desired target sequence is obtained.
TOWER sequences grant Hunters regular stats and provide core mechanics that can inspire many fantastic builds.

rows.system_help|description|26:
Basic rules
 1. You will encounter Dream Lotuses in the stage and have the chance to have a Sweet Dream or a Nightmare.
 2. If you have a Sweet Dream, you'll need to defeat the Sleepwalkers to awaken the Sweet Dream Lotus. Interact with it to select Dream Omens to enhance your Dream Bubbles, which will also make your Nightmare more dangerous.
 3. If you enter a Nightmare, you'll need to survive the trials of the Nightmare. Pass the trial, and the Dream Bubbles' rewards will become real.
 4. Your chance of entering a Nightmare increases with every level advanced in a Sweet Dream until you finally enter a Nightmare.

Dream Bubbles
 1. The rewards obtained in Twinightmare are collectively called Dream Bubbles and only become real after you escape from the Nightmare.
 2. Dream Bubbles have two attributes: quality and type. You can check the details in the descriptions of Sweet Dream Omens.
 3. Starting from Timemark 7 in Netherrealm, Dream Bubbles of the Orange quality and higher have a chance to drop Profound Dream Talking, which can be used to add advanced Dream Affixes to your gear during Dream Interpretation.

Dream Omens
 1. There are 2 types of Dream Omens: Sweet Dream Omens and Nightmare Omens.
 2. Sweet Dream Omens will change your Dream Bubbles in various ways, such as by changing the quality or type of bubbles, and adding or removing bubbles.
 2.1 When choosing an omen for the first time in each round of dreams, the Sweet Dream Omen that appears is called the Fundamentals of a Sweet Dream, which usually takes effect multiple times in subsequent choices or when entering a Nightmare.
 2.2 Sweet Dream Omens that appear from the second choice onward usually take effect immediately.
 2.3 When taking effect, unless specified otherwise, Sweet Dream Omens will not automatically avoid situations where they can have no practical impact. For example, an omen attempting to upgrade a bubble's quality might still target a max-quality bubble, failing to produce an effect. An omen attempting to add a bubble will still try even if the vision is full, also resulting in no change. Please consider your choices carefully when choosing Sweet Dream Omens.
 3. Nightmare Omens will enhance your Nightmare in various ways. When you enter a Nightmare, all the Nightmare Omens you have chosen will take effect simultaneously.
 4. Every Sweet Dream Omen is accompanied by a Nightmare Omen. Be sure to carefully evaluate the associated Nightmare Omen when making your choice. 

Nightmare Trials
 1. In a Nightmare, you must defeat all Nightmare Roots to make your dreams come true.
 2. Whenever you are defeated in a Nightmare, you will randomly lose 1/6 of your total Dream Bubbles (rounded down). The portion that has been rounded down will be recorded. Once the total rounded-down portion reaches 1, an additional bubble will be deducted when you are defeated, the remaining rounded-down portion less than one will be recorded, and the process will keep repeating.
 3. Bubbles will not be deducted immediately. Instead, all bubble deductions will take effect when settling the successful or unsuccessful escape from the Nightmare.
 4. The Nightmare stage inherits the base drop bonuses from one random map within the current round of gameplay (excluding bonuses from Netherrealm Resonances, Compasses, and Cards). Its Stage Level is the average of all map levels encountered in that round.

rows.gacha|des|15001:
In general, the base rate is applied to all Pactspirits. For Rate Up and Minimum Guarantee, the rates are subject to actual rules.
[Boon Rules]
The base rate of acquiring a Legendary Pactspirits is 1.500%. If you fail to obtain any Legendary Pactspirit after 50 Boons, the next Boon's rate of yielding a Legendary Pactspirit will be increased from 1.500% to 3.000%, and if this Boon doesn't yield a Legendary Pactspirit either, then the chance of obtaining a Legendary Pactspirit with the next Boon will be increased from 3.000% to 4.500%. This process repeats itself with a 1.500% rate increase for every Boon until the rate of acquiring a Legendary Pactspirit reaches 100.000%. Once a Legendary Pactspirit is obtained, the next Boon's chance will be reset to the base rate.

After this Boon ends, should it return in a future season, its draw attempts will be retained. If added to the Past Memories, the draw attempts will be reset.

For every 10 Boons, at least 1 Pactspirit that is Rare or better is guaranteed.

[Rate Ups]
When the PYO (Pick-Your-Own) feature is enabled, you can pick a designated amount of Pactspirits in the Pactspirit List to get a 50.000% chance to obtain the Pactspirits you picked (if you picked multiple Pactspirits, they will share the chance equally). If that doesn't get you a Pactspirit you picked after getting 1 Legendary Pactspirit, the next Legendary Pactspirit you get from Boons is guaranteed to be a Pactspirit you picked. The count will be reset once a Pactspirit you picked is obtained.

[Duplicate Pactspirits]
When you receive Duplicate Pactspirits, they will be converted into a certain amount of Pactspirit Proofs. Surplus Proofs can be traded for Insight Essence at the in-game shop

[Boon Item List]
Legendary Pactspirits Base Rate: 1.500%
Rare Pactspirits Base Rate: 12.000%.
Magic Pactspirits Base Rate: 86.500%.
The Legendary Pactspirit Lady Obituary will only appear in this Boon and will not be available in any other Boon. The season-exclusive gameplay of the season-exclusive Pactspirit will be added to the Season Rotation Pool once the season comes to an end. And the chances of that season-exclusive gameplay appearing in the next season will be reduced. The exclusive Pactspirit is only available in the current pool.
The exclusive Pactspirit's effects remain valid permanently.

rows.season|season_des|541:
Season Background
"The world of Torchlight is essentially an isolated island in a vast void, and countless terrifying and unknown creatures are lurking around us."
"Around us? More like they are lurking in our deepest and most secret dreams."
The wonderful thing about dreams is that you could be in a deep good dream or the claws of a nightmare...

New Gameplay
Hunters have a chance to enter a sweet dream when they interact with the Dream Lotus on the map.
After completing a Sweet Dream, Hunters will receive Dream Bubbles that contain rewards. Hunters will need to search for more lotuses to explore deeper levels of Sweet Dreams. Whenever a Sweet Dream level is completed, Hunters will inherit the rewards from the previous level and get the chance to further upgrade or increase these rewards.
At the same time, Hunters need to be vigilant as their chance of entering a Nightmare increases with each level of a Sweet Dream they complete. Hunters should be familiar with the Nightmares they encounter as they will receive the Nightmare Omens corresponding to the rewards they select on each level of a Sweet Dream, and these omens will come true in a Nightmare that can come for Hunters at any time. In other words, the higher the level of the Sweet Dream, the more dangers Hunters will face in Nightmares.
No matter how beautiful the rewards are in a dream, it could just be a bubble that can pop at any time. These bubbles will only come true after Hunters escape from the Nightmare.

New Development System
When exploring a dream, Hunters will get a new season item called Dream Talking. Whenever Hunters perform Dream Talking Interpretation, they will obtain a dream base, which includes a Sweet Dream affix and a Nightmare affix. The original base affixes on a piece of gear will be replaced when the dream base is recorded onto the gear. Sweet Dream base affixes grant powerful buffs, such as allowing Hunters to gain Legendary affixes that have only appeared on Legendary gear when crafting gear. Nightmare base affixes, on the other hand, grant negative affixes that may weaken the gear. Therefore, Hunters will need to choose the right time to perform Dream Talking Interpretation. While trying to get the Sweet Dream affixes they seek, Hunters will also need to take care to avoid the negative impact of Nightmare affixes.

The Queen of Eternal Sun, a new supreme boss, is featured in the new season. On a long night filled with chaotic dreams, she opens her eyes again and waits for warriors to sacrifice themselves for her.

rows.season|season_des|1541:
Season Background
Usher Mortuary - Night Watcher Recruitment Letter
After the Calamity, Leptis became a sprawling graveyard. Countless tormented souls still weep in the night wind.
To keep our vow to console the departed, this mortuary hereby resumes the Rite of Vigil. Our Vigil Procession will escort the coffins carrying the gathered souls to their eternal rest in the netherworld.
However, Wraiths lurk along the path to disturb the peace of the dead-a most unbecoming conduct.
We now seek Night Watchers to guard the procession, purge the Wraiths along the way, and ensure an unimpeded passage for the vigil.
Tonight, when the Guiding Lantern kindles, we await you as promised-join us in the Vigil.
-Madam Usher

New Gameplay
Interact with the Nameless Coffins in Netherrealm stages to start the Vigil. As the Vigil Procession advances, your Guiding Lantern will attract Wraiths along the path. Defeat the ceaseless tide of Wraiths and claim generous rewards! Within the time limit, the faster you defeat Wraiths, the faster they spawn-and the greater your rewards!
You may also encounter a gameplay theme that defies convention: the Noble Coffin. The occupants of such coffins are often of extraordinary status, making the challenge more formidable-but the rewards far more bountiful.
During the vigil, Vigil Anomalies may appear at random, bringing Anomaly monsters that grant rich rewards, or altering the gameplay rules for additional rewards.
At the Usher Mortuary, you may awaken different Relics to modify gameplay and greatly improve drops.

New Development System
Install Nether King's Divinity on Divinity Slates to draw upon the might of the gods, and harness the mysterious power of Nether King.
Nether King's Divinity influences other Divinity Slates, enhancing their affix effects, projecting its own affixes onto surrounding slates, and unlocking powerful exclusive affix effects by adjusting the number of adjacent and non-adjacent slates.

rows.season|season_des|1231:
Season Background
I walked through a door.
I was certain it was just that-a normal door.
Then I saw those... things. Ashen arms drifting in the air.
Deformed heads crashing to the ground.
Then a fish, its mouth gaping and closing, emitting the director's voice:
"Agent ■■■■■, I don't care what level of the Overrealm you're on, find a "Door" and get back here. Now!"
A door? Where?
I looked up. I looked down. I looked everywhere.
Turns out, it was inside the door.
But as I stepped through the door, it hit me:
My name isn't ■■■■■... and I've never met any director.

New Gameplay
You will find "Doors" within the Netherrealm. Defeating the monsters within these "Doors" grants a chance to enter the Overrealm.
Within the Overrealm, you must defeat monsters before time runs out, accumulate Containment Progress, and open doors to deeper levels. Only the best can reach the fourth and final level.
You can obtain drop bonus affixes called Bottled Shadows in the Overrealm. Stacking multiple instances of these affixes can lead to spectacular drops.
Unlocking Contained Objects in the Containment Dossier grants various practical bonuses, and also causes Contained Objects and Abnormalities that provide assistance or carry drops to appear in the Overrealm.

New Development System
Ethereal Prisms can be installed on Advanced Talent Panels within the Talent system.
An Ethereal Prism will override a single Talent Node, influencing surrounding Talents centered on that position and granting them additional effects.
An Ethereal Prism also provides bonus effects to the Core Talent on its current Advanced Talent Panel, or replaces it with a powerful new Core Talent.
With over 20 new Core Talents, you now have access to a wealth of new mechanics and attributes, providing the foundation for countless creative builds.
There's also a type of special Prism that possesses a remarkable mirroring ability. Based on the center point of the current Talent Panel, it can reflect Talent Nodes from one side to the other, with a chance to significantly enhance the effects of the mirrored Talent Nodes.
Within the Talent system, only one regular Prism and one special Prism can be installed, and the two can coexist.
Using Calibration Prism allows you to add random affixes to Ethereal Prisms, breaking free from traditional Talent constraints and customizing a Talent Panel tailored to your playstyle.

rows.season|season_des|1051:
Season Background
Have you ever looked up at the sky and imagined thriving cities hidden among the islands floating in the clouds?
Loaded with supplies, Airships sail in the Desert Sea, shuttling between islands to trade treasures and wealth.
Yet beneath the seemingly calm quicksand lies a world of conflicts and raids.
Are you ready?
A Sand Bandit from your past has extended an invitation for you to become the master of Cloud Oasis.
Build, explore, and conquer this floating Oasis.
And become the most legendary Sandlord in the Desert Sea!


New Gameplay
Hunters can defeat Sand Pirates in the Netherrealm to gather resources for the Cloud Oasis-or even recruit them as laborers. In the Cloud Oasis, you can build and upgrade buildings, deploy laborers to produce resources, and send airships to trade resources for abundant rewards. Feeling bold? You can also deploy laborers on Gliders to raid Sand Pirates' Treasure Stashes to get rewards at no cost. The Cloud Oasis can operate on its own as long as it has enough resources. So sit back and watch your wealth grow!

New Upgrade System
In the Sandlord gameplay, you can trade to obtain precious Aromatic Materials and blend them according to recipes to grant a Belt unique Blending Affixes.
Blending Affixes can give you powerful bonuses, such as Medium Talents, Core Talents, and even Hero Trait Node of other Heroes.

rows.gacha|des|7002:
In general, the base rate is applied to all Pactspirits. For Rate Up and Minimum Guarantee, the rates are subject to actual rules.
[Boon Rules]
The base rate of acquiring a Legendary Pactspirits is 1.500%. If you fail to obtain any Legendary Pactspirit after 50 Boons, the next Boon's rate of yielding a Legendary Pactspirit will be increased from 1.500% to 3.000%, and if this Boon doesn't yield a Legendary Pactspirit either, then the chance of obtaining a Legendary Pactspirit with the next Boon will be increased from 3.000% to 4.500%. This process repeats itself with a 1.500% rate increase for every Boon until the rate of acquiring a Legendary Pactspirit reaches 100.000%. Once a Legendary Pactspirit is obtained, the next Boon's chance will be reset to the base rate.

For every 10 Boons, at least 1 Pactspirit that is Rare or better is guaranteed.

[Rate Ups]
When the PYO (Pick-Your-Own) feature is enabled, you can pick a designated amount of Pactspirits in the Pactspirit List to get a 50.000% chance to obtain the Pactspirits you picked when you obtain a Legendary Pactspirit(if you picked multiple Pactspirits, they will share the chance equally). If that doesn't get you a Pactspirit you picked after getting 1 Legendary Pactspirit, the next Legendary Pactspirit you get from Boons is guaranteed to be a Pactspirit you picked. The count will be reset once a Pactspirit you picked is obtained.

[Duplicate Pactspirits]
When you receive Duplicate Pactspirits, they will be converted into a certain amount of Pactspirit Proofs. Surplus Proofs can be traded for Insight Essence at the in-game shop.

[Boon Item List]
Legendary Pactspirits Base Rate: 1.500%
Rare Pactspirits Base Rate: 12.000%, Dragon Plant - Truffle's base rate is double the base rate of other Rare Pactspirits
Magic Pactspirits Base Rate: 86.500%, Feasting Samurai - Honey's base rate is double the base rate of other Magic Pactspirits
The Legendary Pactspirit Iron Lion will only appear in this Boon and will not be available in any other Boon.

rows.season|season_des|1031:
Season Background
Have you ever looked up at the sky and imagined thriving cities hidden among the islands floating in the clouds?
Loaded with supplies, Airships sail in the Desert Sea, shuttling between islands to trade treasures and wealth.
Yet beneath the seemingly calm quicksand lies a world of conflicts and raids.
Are you ready?
A Sand Bandit from your past has extended an invitation for you to become the master of Cloud Oasis.
Build, explore, and conquer this floating Oasis.
And become the most legendary Sandlord in the Desert Sea!


New Gameplay
Hunters can defeat Sand Pirates in the Netherrealm to gather resources for the Cloud Oasis-or even recruit them as laborers. In the Cloud Oasis, you can build and upgrade buildings, deploy laborers to produce resources, and send airships to trade resources for abundant rewards. Feeling bold? You can also deploy laborers on Gliders to raid Sand Pirates' Treasure Stashes to get rewards at no cost. The Cloud Oasis can operate on its own as long as it has enough resources. So sit back and watch your wealth grow!

New Upgrade System
In the Sandlord gameplay, you can trade to obtain precious Aromatic Materials and blend them according to recipes to grant a Belt unique Blending Affixes.
Blending Affixes can give you powerful bonuses, such as Medium Talents, Core Talents, and even Hero Trait Node of other Heroes.

rows.TextTable_GameFunc|value|Func_SelectRole:
Out of the Aember, the Aemberons were born. The sudden outburst of Aemberons has formed an aggressive "Dark Surge". Hunters, go and find the Tidemaster's Lair to stop him.

New gear Craftsmanship - Forbidden Craft:
Now you can corrode Legendary or Rare gear with at least 4 affixes by using the new crafting device "Abyss Anvil" in the Hideout. Special materials will be consumed during the process, and only one Corrosion is allowed. Consequences of Corrosion:
- Mutate: Replaces the gear's base affix with a random Aember base affix
- Haughty: Upgrades the tier of 1 affix by 1~2 tiers. If the result tier goes beyond T1, then replaces the affix with a special Aember affix
- Defile: Upgrades the tier of 2 affix by 1~2 tiers. If the result tiers go beyond T1, then replaces both affixes with 2 special Aember affixes

Limited edition Legendary gear for the new season:
More than 20 pieces of powerful season limited edition Legendary gear that bring new possibilities into BD construction.

New map Gameplay:
On the story and Netherrealm maps, Hunters will occasionally encounter groups of monsters infected by Dark Surge. Upon defeating these monsters, Hunters will absorb their Corrosion energy, and when its max is reached, Hunters can release it all to Summon dangerous Aemberons and get a random reward. Possible rewards are:
Weapon
Armor
Trinket
Beacon
Craft Material
Fate Card

When the map is affected by Dark Surge, there is a chance that the boss monster is infected. After defeating the infected boss monster, Hunters can release Corrosion energy to generate a Familiar (Head of Aemberons). Defeating the Familiar drops season limited edition Legendary and special clue shards.
By putting together these clue shards, Hunters will be able to challenge different types of Tidemasters. The more clues put together, the stronger the Tidemaster Hunters get to challenge and the greater reward they get after defeating the Tidemaster. Tidemasters could drop powerful season limited edition Legendary Gear and advanced Forbidden Crafting materials.

rows.gacha|des|33001:
In general, the base rate is applied to all Pactspirits. For Rate Up and Minimum Guarantee, the rates are subject to actual rules.
[Boon Rules]
The base rate of acquiring a Legendary Pactspirits is 1.500%. If you fail to obtain any Legendary Pactspirit after 50 Boons, the next Boon's rate of yielding a Legendary Pactspirit will be increased from 1.500% to 3.000%, and if this Boon doesn't yield a Legendary Pactspirit either, then the chance of obtaining a Legendary Pactspirit with the next Boon will be increased from 3.000% to 4.500%. This process repeats itself with a 1.500% rate increase for every Boon until the rate of acquiring a Legendary Pactspirit reaches 100.000%. Once a Legendary Pactspirit is obtained, the next Boon's chance will be reset to the base rate.

For every 10 Boons, at least 1 Pactspirit that is Rare or better is guaranteed.

[Rate Ups]
When the PYO (Pick-Your-Own) feature is enabled, you can pick a designated amount of Pactspirits in the Pactspirit List to get a 25.000% chance to obtain the Pactspirits you picked (if you picked multiple Pactspirits, they will share the chance equally). If that doesn't get you a Pactspirit you picked after getting 3 Legendary Pactspirits, the next Legendary Pactspirit you get from Boons is guaranteed to be a Pactspirit you picked. The count will be reset once a Pactspirit you picked is obtained.

[Duplicate Pactspirits]
When you receive Duplicate Pactspirits, they will be converted into a certain amount of Pactspirit Proofs. Surplus Proofs can be traded for Insight Essence at the in-game shop

[Boon Item List]
Legendary Pactspirits Base Rate: 1.500%
Rare Pactspirits Base Rate: 12.000%. When obtaining a Rare Pactspirit, there is a 30% chance it will be Hell Cavalry - Sea
Magic Pactspirits Base Rate: 86.500%. When obtaining a Magic Pactspirit, there is a 30% chance it will be Spiny Snail - Cloud
The Legendary Pactspirit Prisoner of Desire will only appear in this Boon and will not be available in any other Boon. The season-exclusive gameplay of the season-exclusive Pactspirit will be added to the Season Rotation Pool once the season comes to an end. And the chances of that season-exclusive gameplay appearing in the next season will be reduced.

rows.season|season_des|621:
Season Background
I am lost within the mist.
I cannot find my way back.
Who extinguished my lantern? Who's calling out my name?
I break the hands of the Clock Tower and tear open the mist.
Then, I saw you.
At that time, I was still you.

New Gameplay
Defeat the Mistville "Residents" in the Netherrealm and journey to Mistville. Dispel the mist with Sanity and face various random events to eventually arrive at the Clock Tower. Complete Advent of Folklores in the Clock Tower to receive a Chest of Folklores that contains various rewards. After that, Hunters must welcome a new day from the bench.
Hunters will find all kinds of Food and Old Stuff while exploring Mistville. Use them well to change your exploration experience and even increase drop quantity.
The new season features brand new Season Talents. Hunters must collect Mistville Intel to gradually unlock these Talents and make exploring Mistville easier than ever.

New Development System
The new season features a batch of brand new skills called Activation Medium Skills. They are often closely linked to auto-triggering, allowing them to significantly simplify gameplay and improve your experience.
Hunters can obtain various Activation Medium Skills from Whispering Mist, and use them to create new, surprising, and powerful builds.

rows.season|season_des|1142:
Season Background
TOWER Co. is a megacorporation entrenched in Leptis. Originally founded as an arms factory of the old empire, it has managed to evolve into today's colossal conglomerate through Synthetic Troop technology.
In recent years, TOWER Co. has monopolized key resources, technologies, and basic infrastructure, as well as built a powerful private army for itself.
Under its oppression, righteous outlaws have risen up and become the vanguard against TOWER Co.
Outlaws, listen up! How'd you like to pull off a real robbery?

New Gameplay
TOWER Co.'s Transport Vehicles sit vulnerable in the Netherrealm-loaded with vault-bound riches.
In Carjack, the escort bodyguards will flee in waves with TOWER Supply Caches. You will need to chase them down and defeat their reinforcements within the time limit.
The more escort bodyguards you take down, the bigger your payout.
But don't take too long, because the Transport Vehicles and all security personnel might flee the scene if you do.
Before a Carjack, there's a chance that the Fixer from the Black Market will issue a Bounty Order. You can pay the required amount of TOWER Coins to accept the bounty and complete it to earn additional bounty rewards.
If hijacking convoys is too easy for you, it's time to hit TOWER Co. itself!
TOWER Co. Central Vault is the ultimate endgame challenge of the Outlaw season. Inside this heavily fortified complex, you'll find multiple secure strongrooms-raid as many as you can handle before time runs out, take down the vault's guardian boss, and claim the ultimate strongroom's legendary rewards.

New Upgrade System
R&D can be performed on non-Legendary weapons in the TOWER Sequence system to obtain powerful TOWER Sequences.
To perform R&D, Hunters must spend a set number of Mods. During R&D, Hunters can choose from several chips of random colors in each round. If the colors of the chips you chose match the target sequence (in any order) after all selections have been made, you'll obtain the effects of the target sequence.
There are 2 types of R&D: Basic R&D and In-Depth R&D.
Basic R&D only yields Basic sequences and Intermediate sequences. Advanced sequences can only be obtained from In-Depth R&D. Each weapon can only have 1 sequence, but Hunters can perform R&D repeatedly until the desired target sequence is obtained.
TOWER sequences grant Hunters regular stats and provide core mechanics that can inspire many fantastic builds.

rows.season|season_des|1201:
Season Background
I walked through a door.
I was certain it was just that-a normal door.
Then I saw those... things. Ashen arms drifting in the air.
Deformed heads crashing to the ground.
Then a fish, its mouth gaping and closing, emitting the director's voice:
"Agent ■■■■■, I don't care what level of the Overrealm you're on, find a "Door" and get back here. Now!"
A door? Where?
I looked up. I looked down. I looked everywhere.
Turns out, it was inside the door.
But as I stepped through the door, it hit me:
My name isn't ■■■■■... and I've never met any director.

New Gameplay
You will find "Doors" within the Netherrealm. Defeating the monsters within these "Doors" grants a chance to enter the Overrealm.
Within the Overrealm, you must defeat monsters before time runs out, accumulate Containment Progress, and open doors to deeper levels. Only the best can reach the fourth and final level.
You can obtain drop bonus affixes called Bottled Shadows in the Overrealm. Stacking multiple instances of these affixes can lead to spectacular drops.
Unlocking Contained Objects in the Containment Dossier grants various practical bonuses, and also causes Contained Objects and Abnormalities that provide assistance or carry drops to appear in the Overrealm.

New Development System
Ethereal Prisms can be installed on Advanced Talent Panels within the Talent system.
An Ethereal Prism will override a single Talent Node, influencing surrounding Talents centered on that position and granting them additional effects.
An Ethereal Prism also provides bonus effects to the Core Talent on its current Advanced Talent Panel, or replaces it with a powerful new Core Talent.
With over 20 new Core Talents, you now have access to a wealth of new mechanics and attributes, providing the foundation for countless creative builds.
There's also a type of special Prism that possesses a remarkable mirroring ability. Based on the center point of the current Talent Panel, it can reflect Talent Nodes from one side to the other, with a chance to significantly enhance the effects of the mirrored Talent Nodes.
Within the Talent system, only one regular Prism and one special Prism can be installed, and the two can coexist.
Using Calibration Prism allows you to add random affixes to Ethereal Prisms, breaking free from traditional Talent constraints and customizing a Talent Panel tailored to your playstyle.

rows.collection|unlocked_text|10901:
To my descendants,

The dragons once enslaved us, but we have overthrown their cruel reign. This great victory will mark our name in the history.

But my dear brother, the greatest king of his time, slowly lost himself in the power brought by the First Flame. He had forgotten the pain our people suffered from the dragons, as well as why we stepped forward against the tyranny. Glory and lust have consumed him. The proud dragonslayer has turned into the dragon.

He claimed that Dwarfs had the sole right to the First Flame as the reward of victory. But we knew too well that the races and creatures on the surface needed its power more than us Dwarfs. If my brother kept the First Flame underground, their civilizations would eventually be devoured by the darkness.

That was why I must do something, even if this means to betray my people. I picked hundreds of warriors who were willing to follow me, and stole the First Flame together. My outrageous brother not only banned us from returning to the kingdom forever, but also laid an evil curse on our descendants, that they would forever be ugly, deformed weaklings.

I didn't notice until my wife gave birth to a freakish child. My followers didn't survive the curse either. That was the price of the betrayal.

I don't know if the children of my children are able to read our text at all. I am in deep grief and feel sorry for their future, but I never regret my decision. Now that the First Flame has returned to where it belongs, this world can finally embrace a new era without dictation and bullying.

My descendants, if you are reading this, I hope you can defend our names and tell the world that we did not betray our people.

For our sacrifice will bring prosperity to the world.

Magnus the Betrayer

rows.season|season_des|532:
Season Background
During the distant Epoch of War, a warrior known as Ralph wielded his blade against thousands of formidable foes in the Eternal Coliseum of gold, and he reigned undefeated. Now, the Epoch of War is but a distant memory, yet his brave and fearless spirit still lives on and shines brilliantly like gold, even to this day. O' warrior, defeat the countless enemies roaming the Netherrealm, advance to the Eternal Coliseum's center, and win the unparalleled rewards of the Invincible Champion!

Combat Frenzy
Blessed by the God of War, the rare monsters in the stage have a chance to be upgraded into Gladiator monsters of various tiers. Defeat them to enlarge your physique, or upgrade your Life and Energy Shield to achieve the same effect.
As your Physique grows, your Skill Area increases, and your Minions deal more damage. Rush into a frenzy and grow endlessly stronger!

Precious Drops
All exclusive items' drop rates are tripled during the preseason. Enjoy the feeling of being surrounded by Precious drops!

rows.handbook|description|10580:
Growth is a base attribute every Spirit Magus possesses, with a minimum value of 100 and a maximum value of 1,000.
Spirit Magus start off at Stage 1 (100 Growth) and grow into the next stage with every 100 Growth gained until they reach Stage 5 (500 Growth).
With every stage they grow, a Spirit Magus gains +5% Physique and +10% additional Skill Area. The also gain different skill and attribute enhancements:
At Stage 2, Spirit Magi have a +30% chance to use Enhanced Skills.
At Stage 3, the effect of Spirit Magi's Enhanced Skills are enhanced.
At Stage 4, Spirit Magi's Empower Skills gain new effects.
At Stage 5, all the attributes of Spirit Magi are increased, and they gain +25% additional damage, +10% additional Skill Area, and +30% additional Movement Speed. Their Tracking Area also increases.

rows.collection|unlocked_text|30002:
Dear Jessomina: 

 My fever dream.

, shall I compare thee to a summer's day... Please forgive me for transcribing this beautiful poem. It reminds me of the first time I saw you. I had just come to Star's Fall at the time. The night here seemed endless, yet the stones here were somehow glimmering like stars. Ever since your tail brushed the end of my nose, I've been feeling boiling blood running through my whole body. I'm aching to show all of the thoughts that are welled up in my mind. They are the smile on my face and tones that bespeak my admiration, all pushing me to write this letter to you...

Yours sincerely,

Will

rows.gacha|des|13002:
In general, the base rate is applied to all Pactspirits. For Rate Up and Minimum Guarantee, the rates are subject to actual rules.
[Boon Rules]
The base rate of acquiring a Legendary Pactspirits is 1.500%. If you fail to obtain any Legendary Pactspirit after 50 Boons, the next Boon's rate of yielding a Legendary Pactspirit will be increased from 1.500% to 3.000%, and if this Boon doesn't yield a Legendary Pactspirit either, then the chance of obtaining a Legendary Pactspirit with the next Boon will be increased from 3.000% to 4.500%. This process repeats itself with a 1.500% rate increase for every Boon until the rate of acquiring a Legendary Pactspirit reaches 100.000%. Once a Legendary Pactspirit is obtained, the next Boon's chance will be reset to the base rate.

For every 10 Boons, at least 1 Pactspirit that is Rare or better is guaranteed.

[Rate Ups]
When the PYO (Pick-Your-Own) feature is enabled, you can pick a designated amount of Pactspirits in the Pactspirit List to get a 100.000% chance to obtain the Pactspirits you picked (if you picked multiple Pactspirits, they will share the chance equally).

[Duplicate Pactspirits]
When you receive Duplicate Pactspirits, they will be converted into a certain amount of Pactspirit Proofs. Surplus Proofs can be traded for Insight Essence at the in-game shop.

[Boon Item List]
Legendary Pactspirits Base Rate: 1.500%
Rare Pactspirits Base Rate: 12.000%
Magic Pactspirits Base Rate: 86.500%
The Legendary Pactspirit Kitty Express will only appear in this Boon and will not be available in any other Boon.

rows.system_help|description|49:
Calibrate Prisms to add random affixes to Ethereal Prisms.

Calibration generates 3 random optional affixes, 1 of which is selected as the final result. Each Prism slot can be calibrated to produce a corresponding type of affix. Slot 1 can be calibrated with a Prism Effect Area affix. Slot 2 can be calibrated with a Prism Additional Effect Affix. Slot 3 can be calibrated with a Prism Legendary Mechanic Affix.

During calibration, a special additional material called Prism Level can be added. Its function is to make it possible to manually refresh the random affix options once.

Prisms that already have 1 or more random affixes can be restored using the restoration feature by spending certain materials. Prisms that have reached the Plasticity upper limit cannot be restored.

rows.drop_filter_list|des|3:
Hides non-Legendary gear that has low crafting value. Hides Hero Relics, Hero Memories, and Divinity Slates that have low-tier affixes. Hides low-value Legendary gear.
[Recommended for players who are starting to pursue Endgame gear]

Permanent:
- After Lv. 20, hides gear that has low-Tier affixes (automatically adapts to the stage level).

Starting from Netherrealm:
- Only displays non-special base gear that has T1 affixes.
- Only displays Hero Relics and Hero Memories that have T1 normal affixes or at least T2 special affixes.
- Only displays Divinity Slates that have at least 1 Major Talent Node affix.
- Only displays Soul Candles that have at least T2 affixes - Hides low-value Legendary gear.

rows.manual_rule_des|des|600001192:
<RichText>This type of attributes refers to things like "Gear drops have a X% chance to become Flame Fuel," "Gear drops have a X% chance to become Flame Elementium," etc.
All Drop Quantity bonuses are applied before the conversion. Converted items are no longer affected by these bonuses.
Note: If the total conversion chance for a type of item exceeds 100%, the conversion chance will be weighted so that the total chance remains 100%. For example, if "Gear drops have a 100% chance to become 1 set of Fuel" and "Gear drops have a 100% chance to become 1 set of Ember" are applied at the same time, the gear drop will have a 50% chance to become 1 set of Fuel and 50% chance to become 1 set of Ember.

Calculation (using the conversion of a piece of gear to Fuel as an example)
Example 1: If a certain drop originally has a 100% chance to drop 10 pieces of gear, with "Gear drops have a 100% chance to become 1 set of Fuel", there is a 100% chance to drop 10 sets of Fuel (this Fuel can be any Fuel item, such as Flame Sand x1, Flame Elementium x1, Flame Elementium x10, etc., and the same applies below)
Example 2: If a certain drop originally has a 100% chance to drop 10 pieces of gear, with "Gear drops have a 100% chance to become 1 set of Fuel" and "+100% Drop Quantity," there is a 100% chance to drop 20 sets of Fuel
Example 3: If a certain drop originally has a 100% chance to drop 10 pieces of gear, with "Gear drops have a 100% chance to become 1 set of Fuel" and "+100% gear Drop Quantity," there is a 100% chance to drop 20 sets of Fuel
Example 4: If a certain drop originally has a 100% chance to drop 10 pieces of gear, with "Gear drops have a 100% chance to become 1 set of Fuel" and "+100% Fuel Drop Quantity," there is a 100% chance to drop 10 sets of Fuel</>

rows.season|season_des|1332:
Season Background
A strange disease called Vorax has infected the monsters of Leptis!
Once infected, they turn crimson and enter a state of extreme hyperactivity and frenzy. They even devour each other, absorbing the endlessly multiplying diseased tissue within their bodies to evolve into more powerful and grotesque monstrosities.
As the crisis looms, Mad Doctor Shelley's underground clinic officially opens for business!

New Gameplay
This clinic is home to the best Vorax specialist in all of Leptis!
The first stage of treatment is to find suitable patients. Defeat Vorax Elites in Netherrealm stages to collect the Vorax Substance on them. Obtaining sufficiently potent doses of Vorax Substances is the foundation of treatment.
The second stage of treatment is to visit Mad Doctor Shelley's underground clinic to start the Surgical Preparation phase.
Here, Hunters will perform surgeries on Vorax-infected monsters in preparation for further surgeries in different directions based on monsters' diverse racial talents.
During this stage, Hunters can choose freely from dozens of Surgical Instruments and Potions, combining them in various ways to gradually cultivate the ultimate Vorax host.
Each race has extremely rare Special Potions. These Special Potions provide a set of special medications, which increase in potency with each round, until a miraculous Potion with super high Ultimate Activity is created.
The surgery officially begins in the third stage of treatment!
Hunters will now have to dispose of the powerful monsters they just created.
Defeat them to recover precious Vorax antidotes from their bodies and exchange them for corresponding rewards.
Antidote Vials in the Operating Theater will fill up as more monsters are defeated, and the rewards earned by exchanging them become increasingly better as their potency increases.

New Development System
Grafting lets Hunters craft Vorax Gear-unrestricted by Strength, Intelligence, or Dexterity, with a shared affix pool across different parts, and even capable of holding Legendary affixes.
Use Normal Organs to add Basic or Advanced affixes to Vorax Gear. Use Special Organs to add Ultimate affixes to Vorax Gear. Use Core Organs and Sutures to add Legendary affixes to Vorax Gear.
Vorax Corrosion increases the tier of Vorax Gear affixes, potentially increasing all pre-fixes and suffixes by 1 - 2 tiers.

rows.collection|unlocked_text|20801:
To dear Anna,

I have made up my mind to leave St. Duran with Mark and Merry.

The more I learn about this place, the more I realize it isn't as good as I thought. All I have is day after day of boring life. Only the smile of Mark and Merry could cheer me up a little.

But I know too well they aren't happy.

Well, I guess there won't be any fun in your Life when you already know what's going to happen in every single day.

When the Aember first happened, I was so scared of the aemberon that came out of it. I was worried that I might be infected, that I could lose everything.

I was a liar, a coward, and a complete fool to run away from you when I found out that you were infected by Aember.

Anna, I have received all your letters. Thank you for telling me the Life of Aember survivors. At least I know there is an organization called Torchlight still fighting against Aember and aemberon far away.

Anna, I no longer fear the Aember. I have submitted my application. Whether you forgive me or not, I will leave St. Duran in three days.

I hope Mark and Merry can still see their mother.

Yours, Lantis

rows.collection|unlocked_text|30801:
Sacred Land Patrol Log - 2284th

No accidents happened in today's patrol. The Eternal Night still looks the same.

I'll skip the step of recording the weather and date from today on. My reasons are as followed:

1. Neither "yesterday" nor "today" means anything to the endless Eternal Night.

2. Nobody reads the patrol log except for the captain.

3. I am the captain.

...

Sacred Land Patrol Log - 3029th

No accidents happened in today's patrol. The Eternal Night still looks the same.

I mean, what accident could possibly happen? Should I look forward to the child of prophecy's descent or a bunch of mobs suddenly rushing in and breaking everything? My family has been the Sacred Land Guardians since my great grandfather, but none of us witnessed the opening of the sacred land. I wonder if my grandchild will see it. Perhaps people like us can peek at it when the Sacred Child passes the trial?

...

Sacred Land Patrol Log

Two sneaky people hide in the corner like shadows stick on a stone. I swear I heard them say "Sacred Child", but there was nothing when I went there. Am I seeing things?

...

Sacred Land Patrol Log

No accidents happened in today's patrol. The Eternal Night still looks the same.

I started to think skipping the date was a wise choice since I saw the shadows. I decided to skip the log number as well. I've read a central-continent novel about a writer who has lived in a hotel in the mountain for a long time. He started to doubt himself because of the disordered dates on his diary. Well, I can't let that happen to me, can I? HA, HA, HA.

...

Sacred Land Patrol Log I

...

Sacred Land Patrol Log I

A messenger came today. When's the last time I saw a stranger? The messenger said that tomorrow would be a big day. Is it about the Child of Prophecy or King Lionheart? Goodness, is he still the king? Anyway, I must buck myself up. See? I've renumbered the log. It's a good sign, isn't it? Though I can't remember the date no matter how hard I try.

rows.season|season_des|1301:
Season Background
A strange disease called Vorax has infected the monsters of Leptis!
Once infected, they turn crimson and enter a state of extreme hyperactivity and frenzy. They even devour each other, absorbing the endlessly multiplying diseased tissue within their bodies to evolve into more powerful and grotesque monstrosities.
As the crisis looms, Mad Doctor Shelley's underground clinic officially opens for business!

New Gameplay
This clinic is home to the best Vorax specialist in all of Leptis!
The first stage of treatment is to find suitable patients. Defeat Vorax Elites in Netherrealm stages to collect the Vorax Substance on them. Obtaining sufficiently potent doses of Vorax Substances is the foundation of treatment.
The second stage of treatment is to visit Mad Doctor Shelley's underground clinic to start the Surgical Preparation phase.
Here, Hunters will perform surgeries on Vorax-infected monsters in preparation for further surgeries in different directions based on monsters' diverse racial talents.
During this stage, Hunters can choose freely from dozens of Surgical Instruments and Potions, combining them in various ways to gradually cultivate the ultimate Vorax host.
Each race has extremely rare Special Potions. These Special Potions provide a set of special medications, which increase in potency with each round, until a miraculous Potion with super high Ultimate Activity is created.
The surgery officially begins in the third stage of treatment!
Hunters will now have to dispose of the powerful monsters they just created.
Defeat them to recover precious Vorax antidotes from their bodies and exchange them for corresponding rewards.
Antidote Vials in the Operating Theater will fill up as more monsters are defeated, and the rewards earned by exchanging them become increasingly better as their potency increases.

New Development System
Grafting lets Hunters craft Vorax Gear-unrestricted by Strength, Intelligence, or Dexterity, with a shared affix pool across different parts, and even capable of holding Legendary affixes.
Use Normal Organs to add Basic or Advanced affixes to Vorax Gear. Use Special Organs to add Ultimate affixes to Vorax Gear. Use Core Organs and Sutures to add Legendary affixes to Vorax Gear.
Vorax Corrosion increases the tier of Vorax Gear affixes, potentially increasing all pre-fixes and suffixes by 1 - 2 tiers.

rows.gacha|des|9004:
In general, the base rate is applied to all Pactspirits. For Rate Up and Minimum Guarantee, the rates are subject to actual rules.
[Boon Rules]
The base rate of acquiring a Legendary Pactspirits is 1.500%. If you fail to obtain any Legendary Pactspirit after 50 Boons, the next Boon's rate of yielding a Legendary Pactspirit will be increased from 1.500% to 3.000%, and if this Boon doesn't yield a Legendary Pactspirit either, then the chance of obtaining a Legendary Pactspirit with the next Boon will be increased from 3.000% to 4.500%. This process repeats itself with a 1.500% rate increase for every Boon until the rate of acquiring a Legendary Pactspirit reaches 100.000%. Once a Legendary Pactspirit is obtained, the next Boon's chance will be reset to the base rate.

For every 10 Boons, at least 1 Pactspirit that is Rare or better is guaranteed.

[Rate Ups]
When the PYO (Pick-Your-Own) feature is enabled, you can pick a designated amount of Pactspirits in the Pactspirit List to get a 50.000% chance to obtain the Pactspirits you picked (if you picked multiple Pactspirits, they will share the chance equally). If that doesn't get you a Pactspirit you picked after getting 1 Legendary Pactspirit, the next Legendary Pactspirit you get from Boons is guaranteed to be a Pactspirit you picked. The count will be reset once a Pactspirit you picked is obtained.

[Duplicate Pactspirits]
When you receive Duplicate Pactspirits, they will be converted into a certain amount of Pactspirit Proofs. Surplus Proofs can be traded for Insight Essence at the in-game shop

[Boon Item List]
Legendary Pactspirits Base Rate: 1.500%
Rare Pactspirits Base Rate: 12.000% When obtaining a Rare Pactspirit, there is a 30% chance it will be Benign Bug
Magic Pactspirits Base Rate: 86.500% When obtaining a Magic Pactspirit, there is a 30% chance it will be Sprouting Grass - Purple Sand
The exclusive Pactspirit's effects remain valid permanently.
rows.season|season_des|1442:
Season Background
The story begins with a legend from a time long forgotten.
"Once, in an age beyond memory, there lived a race that called the moon their home.
They were masters of song and dance. Every part of their being resonated like a fine instrument, producing melodies of sublime beauty.
But when the moon fell from the heavens, they turned into cold stone-statues scattered to the four winds.
It is said that these statues will awaken once more when the bright moon shines again. They will join you in a symphony of the full moon, offering treasures long lost to time.
So, Traveler, strum the Lunar Strings.
Call the moon to its zenith, turn the moonlight into song, and uncover the secrets sleeping inside the stone.
Tonight-let's shine together."

New Gameplay
Step into an area teeming with Lunar Stone Statues. Place the Lunar Ring at your feet to encompass as many statues as possible and Strum the Lunar Harp to awaken them, then take them down to earn instant drop rewards. The more statues you wake in one strum, the higher your Combo count, which results in greater Drop Quantity bonuses-and greater loot.
Lunar Omen events will appear at random, bringing both challenges and generous rewards. Fortunate Hunters may even stumble upon the game-changing Rhapsody gameplay-a twist that reshapes the "rhythm" you play and delivers a bountiful run you won't forget.
Install your Lunar Harp with various Lunar Strings to customize bonus effects and select the playstyle that perfectly matches your rhythm.

New Development System
Memory Revival is a crafting method that imbues Hero Memories with special powers.
Revival grants various effects to Hero Memories, increasing the values of their base affixes, upgrading Fixed Affixes, giving them special random affixes, and even adding a powerful Revived Affix.
Revived Affixes even include 1 or more unique Hero Trait Affixes tailored to each hero.

rows.season|season_des|311:
Season Background 
Whoever created the Cube must have become a part of it too... According to the legends, this strange Cube has been drifting through worlds, devouring everything it touches and converting them into something else. Some worship it because it grants all their wishes. Those who make a sacrifice to it will definitely receive something in return. But some also fear it because they know someone, such as their siblings, parents, or friends, who have never returned after approaching the Cube. It has now come to the Aember-ravaged Leptis. Here, it is absorbing Aember and transforming it into horrific Aember monsters never seen before. This has become a new problem for Torchlight... Of course, it is a problem that can be exploited. 
New Gameplay 
Defeat the new monster Malice Incarnation summoned here by the Cube of Rapacity to get Desire Crystals and spend a certain amount of Desire Crystals to draw amazing rewards from the Cube of Rapacity. However, you will lose all the rewards you got if you get too greedy and anger the Cube. 
The Cube of Rapacity will summon powerful special monsters. Each stage has a unique and powerful boss that significantly changes the dull stage-clearing experience. 
The new Season Talent feature has been introduced to the new season. Hunters can change the Talent Nodes for different experiences at little cost. 
The Law Bearer is a new supreme boss who will be introduced in the new season. As the supreme judge of the High Court of Desire, he is more than happy to erase the existence of those who violate the old laws. This supreme boss will be even more challenging than ever. 

New Development System 
Hunters will able to get their hands on a new item called Divinity Slate during their adventure. Each Divinity Slate is related to a god and can carry up to 2 Talent Affixes of the god. 
A new talent panel, Statue of The New God, will be added in the new season. Hunters can combine and place multiple Divinity Slates on the Statue of The New God to gain powerful buffs. This means that Hunters can harness the power of the Six Gods free of the restraint of different gods. 
Hunters can enhance Divinity Slates at a cost, increasing the Talent Affixes allowed to be equipped on them and the strength of affixes. When enhancing a Divinity Slate, there is also a chance to obtain the exclusive Talent Affixes of the new god, granting the power to control order and chaos. However, enhanced Divinity Slates will have a "brand" and become untradeable. 
The new god's Legendary Divinity Slate comes with more special abilities, which have better order-and-chaos effects and allow Hunters to devour the power of the Six Gods for even powerful buffs.

rows.collection|unlocked_text|31302:
This is a study of songs that eulogize the queen:

"Paloma was an abandoned child that came along the Partatar River. Perhaps it's because she was bathed in the river before drinking her mother's breast milk, the ancient Ichi people thought her beauty is bestowed by the nature. There are lots of statues of the queen in the imperial city, and it seems like she didn't like gorgeous dresses, and her clothes only had some gold as ornaments. There's an apothegm carved on the pedestal, 'The radiance of daylight covers me.'"

There are also countless poems describing her beauty, making it vivid. The poems were inspired by her three-colored eyes, the shape of her lips, and even the number of her eyelashes. The ancient Ichi people saw various kinds of beauty in Paloma-

The ones who loved sexual attractiveness would see stunning beauty in her;

The ones who admired power would see incomparable, forbidding beauty in her;

The ones who indulged themselves in slaughter would see cruel, cold beauty in her.

The statues of the Queen were made for beauty, but I see no mercy or love in those poems.

rows.system_help|description|2:
Basic Rules:
Corrosion grants one of the following random effects.
1. Mutation: Removes all base affixes, adds 1 Aember base affix, and sets the gear to Corroded.
2. Chaos: Re-rolls the value of all pre-fixes/suffixes without changing affix tiers and sets the gear to Corroded.
3. Desecration (Darkest Corrosion only): Upgrades 2 pre-fixes/suffixes by 1 - 2 tiers and sets the gear to Corroded.
4. Arrogance: Upgrades 1 prefix/suffix by 1 - 2 tiers and sets the gear to Corroded.
5. Void: Sets the gear to Corroded.

Vorax Corrosion can be performed on Vorax Gear.
Each Corrosion randomly grants the Corroded Vorax Gear one of the following effects:
1. Hyperplastic: Upgrades 1 random affix by 1 - 2 tiers and sets the gear to Corroded.
2. Limb-Stitched: Upgrades 2 random affixes by 1 - 2 tiers and sets the gear to Corroded.
3. Metamorphosized: Upgrades all pre-fixes by 1 - 2 tiers and sets the gear to Corroded.
4. Derived: Upgrades all suffixes by 1 - 2 tiers and sets the gear to Corroded.
5. Festered: sets the gear to Corroded and binds the gear.

<RichText>1. Trial of Divinity is not affected by any Pactspirit Drop Quantity bonuses.
2. Every level advanced increases the Drop Quantity at the end of the trial.
3. Every 10 levels advanced significantly increases the difficulty of subsequent trials and the Drop Quantity at the end of the trial.
4. The chances of an exclusive Legendary gear or related Fluorescent Memory Shards dropping increases with the Drop Quantity at the end of the trial.
5. The chance of a Divinity Emblem dropping in Six Gods is affected by Drop Quantity bonuses.
6. If you fail during the Trial of Divinity, you have the option to either challenge again based on the remaining challenge attempts for this trial or leave the gameplay area during the trial and wait for the trial to end in the safe zone in the lower left corner. If you choose to leave, you can still claim the rewards you've earned according to your progress.</><RichText Id="2017">If you run out of challenge attempts, you will not be able to claim any rewards. rows.season|season_des|1151:
Season Background
TOWER Co. is a megacorporation entrenched in Leptis. Originally founded as an arms factory of the old empire, it has managed to evolve into today's colossal conglomerate through Synthetic Troop technology.
In recent years, TOWER Co. has monopolized key resources, technologies, and basic infrastructure, as well as built a powerful private army for itself.
Under its oppression, righteous outlaws have risen up and become the vanguard against TOWER Co.
Outlaws, listen up! How'd you like to pull off a real robbery?

New Gameplay
TOWER Co.'s Transport Vehicles sit vulnerable in the Netherrealm-loaded with vault-bound riches.
In Carjack, the escort bodyguards will flee in waves with TOWER Supply Caches. You will need to chase them down and defeat their reinforcements within the time limit.
The more escort bodyguards you take down, the bigger your payout.
But don't take too long, because the Transport Vehicles and all security personnel might flee the scene if you do.
Before a Carjack, there's a chance that the Fixer from the Black Market will issue a Bounty Order. You can pay the required amount of TOWER Coins to accept the bounty and complete it to earn additional bounty rewards.
If hijacking convoys is too easy for you, it's time to hit TOWER Co. itself!
TOWER Co. Central Vault is the ultimate endgame challenge of the Outlaw season. Inside this heavily fortified complex, you'll find multiple secure strongrooms-raid as many as you can handle before time runs out, take down the vault's guardian boss, and claim the ultimate strongroom's legendary rewards.

New Upgrade System
R&D can be performed on non-Legendary weapons in the TOWER Sequence system to obtain powerful TOWER Sequences.
To perform R&D, Hunters must spend a set number of Mods. During R&D, Hunters can choose from several chips of random colors in each round. If the colors of the chips you chose match the target sequence (in any order) after all selections have been made, you'll obtain the effects of the target sequence.
There are 2 types of R&D: Basic R&D and In-Depth R&D.
Basic R&D only yields Basic sequences and Intermediate sequences. Advanced sequences can only be obtained from In-Depth R&D. Each weapon can only have 1 sequence, but Hunters can perform R&D repeatedly until the desired target sequence is obtained.
TOWER sequences grant Hunters regular stats and provide core mechanics that can inspire many fantastic builds.

rows.gacha|des|12002:
In general, the base rate is applied to all Pactspirits. For Rate Up and Minimum Guarantee, the rates are subject to actual rules.
[Boon Rules]
The base rate of acquiring a Legendary Pactspirits is 1.500%. If you fail to obtain any Legendary Pactspirit after 50 Boons, the next Boon's rate of yielding a Legendary Pactspirit will be increased from 1.500% to 3.000%, and if this Boon doesn't yield a Legendary Pactspirit either, then the chance of obtaining a Legendary Pactspirit with the next Boon will be increased from 3.000% to 4.500%. This process repeats itself with a 1.500% rate increase for every Boon until the rate of acquiring a Legendary Pactspirit reaches 100.000%. Once a Legendary Pactspirit is obtained, the next Boon's chance will be reset to the base rate.

For every 10 Boons, at least 1 Pactspirit that is Rare or better is guaranteed.

[Rate Ups]
When the PYO (Pick-Your-Own) feature is enabled, you can pick a designated amount of Pactspirits in the Pactspirit List to get a 100.000% chance to obtain the Pactspirits you picked (if you picked multiple Pactspirits, they will share the chance equally).

[Duplicate Pactspirits]
When you receive Duplicate Pactspirits, they will be converted into a certain amount of Pactspirit Proofs. Surplus Proofs can be traded for Insight Essence at the in-game shop.

[Boon Item List]
Legendary Pactspirits Base Rate: 1.500%
Rare Pactspirits Base Rate: 12.000%
Magic Pactspirits Base Rate: 86.500%
The Legendary Pactspirit Squiddle will only appear in this Boon and will not be available in any other Boon.

rows.season|season_des|1111:
Season Background
TOWER Co. is a megacorporation entrenched in Leptis. Originally founded as an arms factory of the old empire, it has managed to evolve into today's colossal conglomerate through Synthetic Troop technology.
In recent years, TOWER Co. has monopolized key resources, technologies, and basic infrastructure, as well as built a powerful private army for itself.
Under its oppression, righteous outlaws have risen up and become the vanguard against TOWER Co.
Outlaws, listen up! How'd you like to pull off a real robbery?

New Gameplay
TOWER Co.'s Transport Vehicles sit vulnerable in the Netherrealm-loaded with vault-bound riches.
In Carjack, the escort bodyguards will flee in waves with TOWER Supply Caches. You will need to chase them down and defeat their reinforcements within the time limit.
The more escort bodyguards you take down, the bigger your payout.
But don't take too long, because the Transport Vehicles and all security personnel might flee the scene if you do.
Before a Carjack, there's a chance that the Fixer from the Black Market will issue a Bounty Order. You can pay the required amount of TOWER Coins to accept the bounty and complete it to earn additional bounty rewards.
If hijacking convoys is too easy for you, it's time to hit TOWER Co. itself!
TOWER Co. Central Vault is the ultimate endgame challenge of the Outlaw season. Inside this heavily fortified complex, you'll find multiple secure strongrooms-raid as many as you can handle before time runs out, take down the vault's guardian boss, and claim the ultimate strongroom's legendary rewards.

New Upgrade System
R&D can be performed on non-Legendary weapons in the TOWER Sequence system to obtain powerful TOWER Sequences.
To perform R&D, Hunters must spend a set number of Mods. During R&D, Hunters can choose from several chips of random colors in each round. If the colors of the chips you chose match the target sequence (in any order) after all selections have been made, you'll obtain the effects of the target sequence.
There are 2 types of R&D: Basic R&D and In-Depth R&D.
Basic R&D only yields Basic sequences and Intermediate sequences. Advanced sequences can only be obtained from In-Depth R&D. Each weapon can only have 1 sequence, but Hunters can perform R&D repeatedly until the desired target sequence is obtained.
TOWER sequences grant Hunters regular stats and provide core mechanics that can inspire many fantastic builds.

rows.gacha|des|3004:
In general, the base rate is applied to all Pactspirits. For Rate Up and Minimum Guarantee, the rates are subject to actual rules.
[Boon Rules]
The base rate of acquiring a Legendary Pactspirits is 1.500%. If you fail to obtain any Legendary Pactspirit after 50 Boons, the next Boon's rate of yielding a Legendary Pactspirit will be increased from 1.500% to 1%, and if this Boon doesn't yield a Legendary Pactspirit either, then the chance of obtaining a Legendary Pactspirit with the next Boon will be increased from 3.000% to 4.500%. This process repeats itself with a 1.500% rate increase for every Boon until the rate of acquiring a Legendary Pactspirit reaches 100.000%. Once a Legendary Pactspirit is obtained, the next Boon's chance will be reset to the base rate.

For every 10 Boons, at least 1 Pactspirit that is Rare or better is guaranteed.

[Rate Ups]
When the PYO (Pick-Your-Own) feature is enabled, you can pick a designated amount of Pactspirits in the Pactspirit List to get a 50.000% chance to obtain the Pactspirits you picked (if you picked multiple Pactspirits, they will share the chance equally). If that doesn't get you a Pactspirit you picked after getting 1 Legendary Pactspirit, the next Legendary Pactspirit you get from Boons is guaranteed to be a Pactspirit you picked. The count will be reset once a Pactspirit you picked is obtained.

[Duplicate Pactspirits]
When you receive Duplicate Pactspirits, they will be converted into a certain amount of Pactspirit Proofs. Surplus Proofs can be traded for Insight Essence at the in-game shop

[Boon Item List]
Legendary Pactspirits Base Rate: 1.500%
Rare Pactspirits Base Rate: 12.000%
Magic Pactspirits Base Rate: 86.500%
The Legendary Pactspirits, Warbler of Plum Blossoms/Poisoned Omen will only appear in this Boon and will not be available in any other Boon.

rows.season|season_des|1531:
Season Background
Usher Mortuary - Night Watcher Recruitment Letter
After the Calamity, Leptis became a sprawling graveyard. Countless tormented souls still weep in the night wind.
To keep our vow to console the departed, this mortuary hereby resumes the Rite of Vigil. Our Vigil Procession will escort the coffins carrying the gathered souls to their eternal rest in the netherworld.
However, Wraiths lurk along the path to disturb the peace of the dead-a most unbecoming conduct.
We now seek Night Watchers to guard the procession, purge the Wraiths along the way, and ensure an unimpeded passage for the vigil.
Tonight, when the Guiding Lantern kindles, we await you as promised-join us in the Vigil.
-Madam Usher

New Gameplay
Interact with the Nameless Coffins in Netherrealm stages to start the Vigil. As the Vigil Procession advances, your Guiding Lantern will attract Wraiths along the path. Defeat the ceaseless tide of Wraiths and claim generous rewards! Within the time limit, the faster you defeat Wraiths, the faster they spawn-and the greater your rewards!
You may also encounter a gameplay theme that defies convention: the Noble Coffin. The occupants of such coffins are often of extraordinary status, making the challenge more formidable-but the rewards far more bountiful.
During the vigil, Vigil Anomalies may appear at random, bringing Anomaly monsters that grant rich rewards, or altering the gameplay rules for additional rewards.
At the Usher Mortuary, you may awaken different Relics to modify gameplay and greatly improve drops.

New Development System
Install Nether King's Divinity on Divinity Slates to draw upon the might of the gods, and harness the mysterious power of Nether King.
Nether King's Divinity influences other Divinity Slates, enhancing their affix effects, projecting its own affixes onto surrounding slates, and unlocking powerful exclusive affix effects by adjusting the number of adjacent and non-adjacent slates.

System Distribution: The right to pick up drops will be automatically assigned in sequence to team members in the stage. When the designated member for an item leaves the stage, the right will be assigned to all team members (excluding team members entering the stage after the drop).

Free Distribution: The right to pick up drops will be automatically assigned to all team members in the stage.
