rows.season|season_des|1232:
Season Background
I walked through a door.
I was certain it was just that-a normal door.
Then I saw those... things. Ashen arms drifting in the air.
Deformed heads crashing to the ground.
Then a fish, its mouth gaping and closing, emitting the director's voice:
"Agent ■■■■■, I don't care what level of the Overrealm you're on, find a "Door" and get back here. Now!"
A door? Where?
I looked up. I looked down. I looked everywhere.
Turns out, it was inside the door.
But as I stepped through the door, it hit me:
My name isn't ■■■■■... and I've never met any director.

New Gameplay
You will find "Doors" within the Netherrealm. Defeating the monsters within these "Doors" grants a chance to enter the Overrealm.
Within the Overrealm, you must defeat monsters before time runs out, accumulate Containment Progress, and open doors to deeper levels. Only the best can reach the fourth and final level.
You can obtain drop bonus affixes called Bottled Shadows in the Overrealm. Stacking multiple instances of these affixes can lead to spectacular drops.
Unlocking Contained Objects in the Containment Dossier grants various practical bonuses, and also causes Contained Objects and Abnormalities that provide assistance or carry drops to appear in the Overrealm.

New Development System
Ethereal Prisms can be installed on Advanced Talent Panels within the Talent system.
An Ethereal Prism will override a single Talent Node, influencing surrounding Talents centered on that position and granting them additional effects.
An Ethereal Prism also provides bonus effects to the Core Talent on its current Advanced Talent Panel, or replaces it with a powerful new Core Talent.
With over 20 new Core Talents, you now have access to a wealth of new mechanics and attributes, providing the foundation for countless creative builds.
There's also a type of special Prism that possesses a remarkable mirroring ability. Based on the center point of the current Talent Panel, it can reflect Talent Nodes from one side to the other, with a chance to significantly enhance the effects of the mirrored Talent Nodes.
Within the Talent system, only one regular Prism and one special Prism can be installed, and the two can coexist.
Using Calibration Prism allows you to add random affixes to Ethereal Prisms, breaking free from traditional Talent constraints and customizing a Talent Panel tailored to your playstyle.

<RichText>Text color indicates the difficulty level of the stage:
</><RichText Id="3405">Red</><RichText>: Monsters are over 5 levels higher than your character, making the stage quite challenging.
</><RichText Id="3404">Yellow</><RichText>: Monsters are up to 5 levels higher than your character, offering a balanced level of difficulty.
</><RichText Id="3403">Green</><RichText>: Monsters are 5 levels or fewer below your character, making the stage relatively easy.
</><RichText Id="3402">Gray</><RichText>: Monsters are more than 5 levels below your character, making the stage quite easy.

</><RichText Id="2017">When the level difference between the stage and your character is more than 5 levels, your character's XP gain will be significantly reduced. When the difference is more than 10 levels, your character will not be able to gain any XP.
</><RichText>It's recommended to challenge stages where the monster level is yellow or green.</>

rows.handbook|description|10170:
Evasion is a defensive mechanic against Hit Damage. When the damage of a hit is evaded, the hit does not deal any damage or trigger its hit effects and subsequent effects. The chance of evading an attack is determined by the attacker's Accuracy and the target's Evasion Rate.

Heroes' hits against monsters will not be evaded
Evasion
Characters start with 0 Evasion by default, which is its lowest value
Each level increases Evasion by 3
Each Dexterity increases Evasion by 0.02%
Relevant Stats
Evasion
Evasion %
Additional Evasion %
Gear Evasion
Gear Evasion %

Evasion Rate
Evasion Rate =1-1.15x attacker's Accuracy/(attacker's Accuracy +0.5x defender's Evasion^0.75), which means it is determined by the attacker's Accuracy and the defender's Evasion
The maximum Evasion rate is 75%, and the minimum Evasion rate is 0%
For Spell Damage, Evasion drops by additional 40% by default
Currently, the highest Accuracy monsters can have is 1,247

rows.season|season_des|721:
Season Background
I am lost within the mist.
I cannot find my way back.
Who extinguished my lantern? Who's calling out my name?
I break the hands of the Clock Tower and tear open the mist.
Then, I saw you.
At that time, I was still you.

New Gameplay
Defeat the Mistville "Residents" in the Netherrealm and journey to Mistville. Dispel the mist with Sanity and face various random events to eventually arrive at the Clock Tower. Complete Advent of Folklores in the Clock Tower to receive a Chest of Folklores that contains various rewards. After that, Hunters must welcome a new day from the bench.
Hunters will find all kinds of Food and Old Stuff while exploring Mistville. Use them well to change your exploration experience and even increase drop quantity.
The new season features brand new Season Talents. Hunters must collect Mistville Intel to gradually unlock these Talents and make exploring Mistville easier than ever.

New Development System
The new season features a batch of brand new skills called Activation Medium Skills. They are often closely linked to auto-triggering, allowing them to significantly simplify gameplay and improve your experience.
Hunters can obtain various Activation Medium Skills from Whispering Mist, and use them to create new, surprising, and powerful builds.

rows.season|season_des|1322:
Season Background
A strange disease called Vorax has infected the monsters of Leptis!
Once infected, they turn crimson and enter a state of extreme hyperactivity and frenzy. They even devour each other, absorbing the endlessly multiplying diseased tissue within their bodies to evolve into more powerful and grotesque monstrosities.
As the crisis looms, Mad Doctor Shelley's underground clinic officially opens for business!

New Gameplay
This clinic is home to the best Vorax specialist in all of Leptis!
The first stage of treatment is to find suitable patients. Defeat Vorax Elites in Netherrealm stages to collect the Vorax Substance on them. Obtaining sufficiently potent doses of Vorax Substances is the foundation of treatment.
The second stage of treatment is to visit Mad Doctor Shelley's underground clinic to start the Surgical Preparation phase.
Here, Hunters will perform surgeries on Vorax-infected monsters in preparation for further surgeries in different directions based on monsters' diverse racial talents.
During this stage, Hunters can choose freely from dozens of Surgical Instruments and Potions, combining them in various ways to gradually cultivate the ultimate Vorax host.
Each race has extremely rare Special Potions. These Special Potions provide a set of special medications, which increase in potency with each round, until a miraculous Potion with super high Ultimate Activity is created.
The surgery officially begins in the third stage of treatment!
Hunters will now have to dispose of the powerful monsters they just created.
Defeat them to recover precious Vorax antidotes from their bodies and exchange them for corresponding rewards.
Antidote Vials in the Operating Theater will fill up as more monsters are defeated, and the rewards earned by exchanging them become increasingly better as their potency increases.

New Development System
Grafting lets Hunters craft Vorax Gear-unrestricted by Strength, Intelligence, or Dexterity, with a shared affix pool across different parts, and even capable of holding Legendary affixes.
Use Normal Organs to add Basic or Advanced affixes to Vorax Gear. Use Special Organs to add Ultimate affixes to Vorax Gear. Use Core Organs and Sutures to add Legendary affixes to Vorax Gear.
Vorax Corrosion increases the tier of Vorax Gear affixes, potentially increasing all pre-fixes and suffixes by 1 - 2 tiers.

Below are the core dogmas of St. Duran Church and shall be treated by all members with the utmost importance.

I. Church members shall pray when the sun rises, and rest after sunset.

All members must arrive at the front hall before sunrise and stand in rows according to their ranks.

When the sun shines on the seventh stair at the church entrance, Arcbishop will announce the beginning of the prayer. All members must close their eyes, stand still, and put their hands together.

Two Chaplains shall start chanting the prayer while other members recite gently after them.

Members shall return to their positions in order after the prayer.

All members need to leave the church as soon as possible after sunset and return to their home.


II. All members must lodge a written application and take Aember scans should they need to leave the church.

In principle, church members are not allowed to leave.

In special cases, written applications must be submitted to the council and reviewed by a Vicar Bishop before applicants can receive a pass to go out.

Upon returning to the church, members should voluntarily take Aember checks to avoid bringing it inside St. Duran.


III. Members should actively report any intruders in St. Duran

Strict standards apply to all those who wish to move to St. Duran. Any personnel found without proper permission should be regarded as an intruder.

All members should refrain from direct confrontation and immediately report to the supervisor or crusaders.

IV. Members of the crusaders must set high standards for themselves and strictly follow St. Duran principles.

The crusaders only report to Arcbishop Derrick and are exempt from daily duties such as prayers.

The crusaders' duty is to protect all church members and residents of the Holy Capital, and expunge all intruders.

They must patrol at least twice per day.

rows.season|season_des|1041:
Season Background
Have you ever looked up at the sky and imagined thriving cities hidden among the islands floating in the clouds?
Loaded with supplies, Airships sail in the Desert Sea, shuttling between islands to trade treasures and wealth.
Yet beneath the seemingly calm quicksand lies a world of conflicts and raids.
Are you ready?
A Sand Bandit from your past has extended an invitation for you to become the master of Cloud Oasis.
Build, explore, and conquer this floating Oasis.
And become the most legendary Sandlord in the Desert Sea!


New Gameplay
Hunters can defeat Sand Pirates in the Netherrealm to gather resources for the Cloud Oasis-or even recruit them as laborers. In the Cloud Oasis, you can build and upgrade buildings, deploy laborers to produce resources, and send airships to trade resources for abundant rewards. Feeling bold? You can also deploy laborers on Gliders to raid Sand Pirates' Treasure Stashes to get rewards at no cost. The Cloud Oasis can operate on its own as long as it has enough resources. So sit back and watch your wealth grow!

New Upgrade System
In the Sandlord gameplay, you can trade to obtain precious Aromatic Materials and blend them according to recipes to grant a Belt unique Blending Affixes.
Blending Affixes can give you powerful bonuses, such as Medium Talents, Core Talents, and even Hero Trait Node of other Heroes.

rows.season|season_des|101:
Out of the Aember, the Aemberons were born. The sudden outburst of Aemberons has formed an aggressive "Dark Surge". Hunters, go and find the Tidemaster's Lair to stop him.

New Gear Craftsmanship - Corrosion Crafting:
Now you can corrode Legendary or Rare gear with at least 4 affixes via the new character in the Hideout "Zenoth the Lightless". Special materials will be consumed during the process, and only one Corrosion is allowed. Consequences of Corrosion:
- Mutate: Replaces the gear's base affix with a random Aember base affix
- Haughty: Upgrades the tier of 1 affix by 1-2 tiers. If the result tier goes beyond T1, then replaces the affix with a special Aember affix
- Defile: Upgrades the tier of 2 affixes by 1-2 tiers. If the result tiers go beyond T1, then replaces both affixes with 2 special Aember affixes

Limited edition Legendary gear for the new season:
More than 20 pieces of powerful season limited edition Legendary gear that bring new possibilities into BD construction.

New map gameplay:
On the story and Netherrealm maps, Hunters will occasionally encounter groups of monsters infected by the Dark Surge. Upon defeating these monsters, Hunters will absorb their Corrosion energy, and when its max is reached, Hunters can release it all to summon dangerous Aemberons and get a random reward. Possible rewards are:
Weapon
Armor
Trinket
Compass
Craft Material
Fluorescent Memory

When the map is affected by the Dark Surge, there is a chance that the boss monster is also infected. After defeating the infected boss monster, Hunters can release Corrosion energy to generate a Familiar (Head of Aemberons). Defeating the Familiar drops season limited edition Legendary and Dark Surge Edicts.
By putting together these Dark Surge Edicts, Hunters will be able to challenge the season boss of two varying difficulties. The season boss may drop powerful season limited edition Legendary Gear and advanced Corrosion Crafting materials.

rows.gacha|des|313001:
In general, the base rate is applied to all Pactspirits. For Rate Up and Minimum Guarantee, the rates are subject to actual rules.
[Boon Rules]
The base rate of acquiring a Legendary Pactspirits is 1.500%. If you fail to obtain any Legendary Pactspirit after 50 Boons, the next Boon's rate of yielding a Legendary Pactspirit will be increased from 1.500% to 3.000%, and if this Boon doesn't yield a Legendary Pactspirit either, then the chance of obtaining a Legendary Pactspirit with the next Boon will be increased from 3.000% to 4.500%. This process repeats itself with a 1.500% rate increase for every Boon until the rate of acquiring a Legendary Pactspirit reaches 100.000%. Once a Legendary Pactspirit is obtained, the next Boon's chance will be reset to the base rate.

After this Boon ends, should it return in a future season, its draw attempts will be retained. If added to the Past Memories, the draw attempts will be reset.

For every 10 Boons, at least 1 Pactspirit that is Rare or better is guaranteed.

[Rate Ups]
When the PYO (Pick-Your-Own) feature is enabled, you can pick a designated amount of Pactspirits in the Pactspirit List to get a 50.000% chance to obtain the Pactspirits you picked (if you picked multiple Pactspirits, they will share the chance equally). If that doesn't get you a Pactspirit you picked after getting 1 Legendary Pactspirit, the next Legendary Pactspirit you get from Boons is guaranteed to be a Pactspirit you picked. The count will be reset once a Pactspirit you picked is obtained.

[Duplicate Pactspirits]
When you receive Duplicate Pactspirits, they will be converted into a certain amount of Pactspirit Proofs. Surplus Proofs can be traded for Insight Essence at the in-game shop

[Boon Item List]
Legendary Pactspirits Base Rate: 1.500%
Rare Pactspirits Base Rate: 12.000%.
Magic Pactspirits Base Rate: 86.500%.
The Legendary Pactspirit Intern Shelley will only appear in this Boon and will not be available in any other Boon. The season-exclusive gameplay of the season-exclusive Pactspirit will be added to the Season Rotation Pool once the season comes to an end. And the chances of that season-exclusive gameplay appearing in the next season will be reduced. The exclusive Pactspirit is only available in the current pool.
The exclusive Pactspirit's effects remain valid permanently.

rows.collection|unlocked_text|10202:
The dwarves call this place the Ancient Battleground... Although the scars of battle have been erased by the passage of thousands of years. This place is said to once bear witness to the last glory of my ancestors on the earth, quarrels between brothers, betrayal, and collapse. Anyway, only happy goblins live here now.

When I see how the goblins use the huge weapons of war created by the dwarves to modify their homes and improve their lives, I'm sincerely happy for these former weapons of war. Even if the mountains are cut down by axes, and the ground is hollowed out by drills, the yearning for peace will not be shaken by any forces. In these times of war due to Aember, it is a common belief like this that unites the people.

I drank with the high priest of the goblins, an alcoholic drink made of ancient herbs that they serve to guests. We talked and drank until late at night. Aember sweeps the land with a gale of death and blood. Tonight, we will still sing tuneless praises to the sun of tomorrow, and this is how the people of Leptis live.

rows.season|season_des|1542:
Season Background
Usher Mortuary - Night Watcher Recruitment Letter
After the Calamity, Leptis became a sprawling graveyard. Countless tormented souls still weep in the night wind.
To keep our vow to console the departed, this mortuary hereby resumes the Rite of Vigil. Our Vigil Procession will escort the coffins carrying the gathered souls to their eternal rest in the netherworld.
However, Wraiths lurk along the path to disturb the peace of the dead-a most unbecoming conduct.
We now seek Night Watchers to guard the procession, purge the Wraiths along the way, and ensure an unimpeded passage for the vigil.
Tonight, when the Guiding Lantern kindles, we await you as promised-join us in the Vigil.
-Madam Usher

New Gameplay
Interact with the Nameless Coffins in Netherrealm stages to start the Vigil. As the Vigil Procession advances, your Guiding Lantern will attract Wraiths along the path. Defeat the ceaseless tide of Wraiths and claim generous rewards! Within the time limit, the faster you defeat Wraiths, the faster they spawn-and the greater your rewards!
You may also encounter a gameplay theme that defies convention: the Noble Coffin. The occupants of such coffins are often of extraordinary status, making the challenge more formidable-but the rewards far more bountiful.
During the vigil, Vigil Anomalies may appear at random, bringing Anomaly monsters that grant rich rewards, or altering the gameplay rules for additional rewards.
At the Usher Mortuary, you may awaken different Relics to modify gameplay and greatly improve drops.

New Development System
Install Nether King's Divinity on Divinity Slates to draw upon the might of the gods, and harness the mysterious power of Nether King.
Nether King's Divinity influences other Divinity Slates, enhancing their affix effects, projecting its own affixes onto surrounding slates, and unlocking powerful exclusive affix effects by adjusting the number of adjacent and non-adjacent slates.

rows.collection|unlocked_text|30901:
Citizens of Ichi! Patriots! My proud compatriots,

I can see my face in your eyes.

Just like the sunshine falling onto your forehead,

this is the Sun's blessing.

However the beauty will eventually wither,

just like the Sun will restrain its radiance at night.

We are all going to rest forever someday,

and Ichi is destined to be changed.

But it won't happen today.

Today we feast.

Today's the perfect day for our warriors.

Today's so precious, so how can we keep today forever?

I am Paloma, the Queen of Eternal Sun.

Let's forge the eternal daylight with everlasting gold,

make the sun hang in the sky of Ichi forever,

and build two paths named Star and Moon converging in the Sun Arena.

Ichi warriors will fight there.

Their strong bodies will make the Sun Rite shine.

The champion shall earn the honor to join me in my chamber, and we'll bath in the eternal sunlight.

As bards once sang,

"We want beautiful lives to multiply

so that beauty will never die."

rows.season|season_des|1532:
Season Background
Usher Mortuary - Night Watcher Recruitment Letter
After the Calamity, Leptis became a sprawling graveyard. Countless tormented souls still weep in the night wind.
To keep our vow to console the departed, this mortuary hereby resumes the Rite of Vigil. Our Vigil Procession will escort the coffins carrying the gathered souls to their eternal rest in the netherworld.
However, Wraiths lurk along the path to disturb the peace of the dead-a most unbecoming conduct.
We now seek Night Watchers to guard the procession, purge the Wraiths along the way, and ensure an unimpeded passage for the vigil.
Tonight, when the Guiding Lantern kindles, we await you as promised-join us in the Vigil.
-Madam Usher

New Gameplay
Interact with the Nameless Coffins in Netherrealm stages to start the Vigil. As the Vigil Procession advances, your Guiding Lantern will attract Wraiths along the path. Defeat the ceaseless tide of Wraiths and claim generous rewards! Within the time limit, the faster you defeat Wraiths, the faster they spawn-and the greater your rewards!
You may also encounter a gameplay theme that defies convention: the Noble Coffin. The occupants of such coffins are often of extraordinary status, making the challenge more formidable-but the rewards far more bountiful.
During the vigil, Vigil Anomalies may appear at random, bringing Anomaly monsters that grant rich rewards, or altering the gameplay rules for additional rewards.
At the Usher Mortuary, you may awaken different Relics to modify gameplay and greatly improve drops.

New Development System
Install Nether King's Divinity on Divinity Slates to draw upon the might of the gods, and harness the mysterious power of Nether King.
Nether King's Divinity influences other Divinity Slates, enhancing their affix effects, projecting its own affixes onto surrounding slates, and unlocking powerful exclusive affix effects by adjusting the number of adjacent and non-adjacent slates.

rows.system_help|description|55:
Gameplay Info:
After starting the Vigil, you must defeat the Wraiths swarming around the Undead Vigil Procession within the time limit.
In a standard Vigil, waves of Wraiths spawn at set intervals. However, Wraiths will stop spawning if too many of them are on the field.
During the Vigil, your Guiding Lantern draws Wraiths in and signals the current battle intensity.
Guiding Lantern: Stable (Blue)-The faster you defeat Wraiths, the faster they spawn. Guiding Lantern: Flickering (Yellow)-Wraiths are starting to pile up. Thin them out before it gets worse. Guiding Lantern: Overloaded (Red)-Too many Wraiths are on the field. Spawning is paused. Clear them fast or risk losing rewards. At the Usher Mortuary, you can spend Remnant Souls to awaken Relics. Once awakened, there's a chance Vigil Anomalies and Noble Coffins will appear during runs-some of them can shake up the rules and greatly improve drops.

Usher Mortuary:
Usher Mortuary is the Vigil gameplay's progression system. This is where you invest Remnant Souls to unlock Vigil Anomalies, Noble Coffins, or upgrade your gameplay effects.
Every time you finish a Vigil run (win or lose), you earn 1 Remnant Soul, up to the cap.
You can cancel or reset any awakened Relic anytime, and all Remnant Souls are refunded in full.
Relic Effect changes only take effect when you enter the next map.

rows.system_help|description|5:
Basic Rules:
1. You can select a total of four Talent Panels.
2. The first Talent Panel needs to be selected from a set of six Basic Talent Panels.
3. The second Talent Panel can be selected from four Advanced Talent Panels corresponding to the Basic Talent Panels.
4. You can select the third and the fourth Talent Panel without any restrictions.

About Talent Nodes:
1. Each Talent Panel contains a number of Talent Nodes, and activating Talent Nodes will grant their corresponding effects.
2. Activating Talent Nodes costs corresponding Talent Points.
3. You gain 1 Talent Point for every level and additional Talent Points by completing a set of key quests.
4. Talent Nodes are divided into Minor, Medium, Legendary Medium, and Core Talent Nodes.
5. In order to activate a Medium or Legendary Medium Node, you typically need to activate the preceding Minor Node first.
6. After a certain amount of Talent Nodes have been unlocked on a Talent Panel, Core Talent slots can be unlocked: You can select and activate one from several Core Talents. You can switch the activated Core Talent anytime.

About Forgetting:
1. Activated Talent Nodes can be reset. Resetting costs Oblivion Points. Use Elixir of Oblivion to obtain Oblivion Points.
2. Resetting Talent Nodes does not cost Oblivion Points until you reach Lv. 90.

rows.manual_rule_des|des|1002000122:
<RichText Id="3103">Ailment Damage Base Value</><RichText>
The base value of Ailment Damage generally comes from the two following sources:
Ailment Damage base value that is directly added, and Ailment Damage base value that is a percentage of added Flat Damage.
The added Flat Damage of Attack Skills is equal to the sum of Weapon Damage and additional Flat Damage.
The added Flat Damage of Spell Skills is equal to additional Flat Damage.
The base value of Ailment Damage now has a minimum and maximum value. Whenever Ailment Damage is dealt, the Ailment Base Damage is randomly determined within this range.
Lucky Damage, minimum damage, and maximum damage do not affect Ailment Base Damage.
Regardless of its source, the base value of Ailment Damage is not affected by Skill Damage Multiplier bonuses.</>

rows.season|season_des|1511:
Season Background
Usher Mortuary - Night Watcher Recruitment Letter
After the Calamity, Leptis became a sprawling graveyard. Countless tormented souls still weep in the night wind.
To keep our vow to console the departed, this mortuary hereby resumes the Rite of Vigil. Our Vigil Procession will escort the coffins carrying the gathered souls to their eternal rest in the netherworld.
However, Wraiths lurk along the path to disturb the peace of the dead-a most unbecoming conduct.
We now seek Night Watchers to guard the procession, purge the Wraiths along the way, and ensure an unimpeded passage for the vigil.
Tonight, when the Guiding Lantern kindles, we await you as promised-join us in the Vigil.
-Madam Usher

New Gameplay
Interact with the Nameless Coffins in Netherrealm stages to start the Vigil. As the Vigil Procession advances, your Guiding Lantern will attract Wraiths along the path. Defeat the ceaseless tide of Wraiths and claim generous rewards! Within the time limit, the faster you defeat Wraiths, the faster they spawn-and the greater your rewards!
You may also encounter a gameplay theme that defies convention: the Noble Coffin. The occupants of such coffins are often of extraordinary status, making the challenge more formidable-but the rewards far more bountiful.
During the vigil, Vigil Anomalies may appear at random, bringing Anomaly monsters that grant rich rewards, or altering the gameplay rules for additional rewards.
At the Usher Mortuary, you may awaken different Relics to modify gameplay and greatly improve drops.

New Development System
Install Nether King's Divinity on Divinity Slates to draw upon the might of the gods, and harness the mysterious power of Nether King.
Nether King's Divinity influences other Divinity Slates, enhancing their affix effects, projecting its own affixes onto surrounding slates, and unlocking powerful exclusive affix effects by adjusting the number of adjacent and non-adjacent slates.
rows.system_help|description|54:
After assigning Regular Drop Pactspirits for a specific gameplay, all drops from that gameplay will benefit from the Regular Pactspirit combination and are affected solely by that combination.

This feature is unlocked via the Golden Season Pass. Certain gameplay modes are temporarily free during the season. If this feature is locked, gameplay drops will apply the currently equipped Drop Pactspirit Plan.

Refer to each gameplay's effective rules for detailed drop mechanics.

rows.system_help|description|37:
City Defense is a cooperative defensive mode where Hunters must work together to fend off invaders and protect their Core.
City Defense features 7 difficulty levels, each consisting of 15 waves of enemies.
Hunters will receive new rewards for every 3 waves they successfully repel.
In addition to earning rewards, Hunters will also be ranked on a leaderboard. To improve your ranking, aim to clear City Defense at the highest difficulty you can manage and defeat as many waves as quickly as possible.
If the character is defeated in City Defense while playing in Hardcore Mode or Solo Self Found Hardcore Mode, the character will still remain available for the current season.
Rewards for this gameplay can only be claimed in Normal Mode and Solo Self Found Mode on seasonal servers.

rows.collection|unlocked_text|10601:
Dwarves hid underground... Truly unexpected. This large population possessed a entirely different form of technologynt from ours on the surface. Yes, their facilities looked exactly like the ancient mechanical remains i saw in Andalin, which made me think of the legend of King Kazsan.

No! No! It's not a legend, it's history that was intentionally hidden. But... Not every dwarf dares to face that history. In the history books we wrote for the future generations, the records on the ancient dwarves always stop at their victory in the war against the dragons.

But we all know what really happened after that. King Magnus was imprisoned for trying to persuade King Kazsan. However, he dug a hole at his prison right to the Heart of the Ridge and took the Spark without alerting anyone. It is said that when King Magnus fled back toward the surface with the Spark, the tunnels behind him darkened as they had lost the Spark, but the darkness ahead was illuminated. Hundreds were attracted by its light and left the underground kingdom with King Magnus. They are the ancestor of the dwarves on the surface.

Season Background
A strange disease called Vorax has infected the monsters of Leptis!
Once infected, they turn crimson and enter a state of extreme hyperactivity and frenzy. They even devour each other, absorbing the endlessly multiplying diseased tissue within their bodies to evolve into more powerful and grotesque monstrosities.
As the crisis looms, Mad Doctor Shelley's underground clinic officially opens for business!

New Gameplay
This clinic is home to the best Vorax specialist in all of Leptis!
The first stage of treatment is to find suitable patients. Defeat Vorax Elites in Netherrealm stages to collect the Vorax Substance on them. Obtaining sufficiently potent doses of Vorax Substances is the foundation of treatment.
The second stage of treatment is to visit Mad Doctor Shelley's underground clinic to start the Surgical Preparation phase.
Here, Hunters will perform surgeries on Vorax-infected monsters in preparation for further surgeries in different directions based on monsters' diverse racial talents.
During this stage, Hunters can choose freely from dozens of Surgical Instruments and Potions, combining them in various ways to gradually cultivate the ultimate Vorax host.
Each race has extremely rare Special Potions. These Special Potions provide a set of special medications, which increase in potency with each round, until a miraculous Potion with super high Ultimate Activity is created.
The surgery officially begins in the third stage of treatment!
Hunters will now have to dispose of the powerful monsters they just created.
Defeat them to recover precious Vorax antidotes from their bodies and exchange them for corresponding rewards.
Antidote Vials in the Operating Theater will fill up as more monsters are defeated, and the rewards earned by exchanging them become increasingly better as their potency increases.

New Development System
Grafting lets Hunters craft Vorax Gear-unrestricted by Strength, Intelligence, or Dexterity, with a shared affix pool across different parts, and even capable of holding Legendary affixes.
Use Normal Organs to add Basic or Advanced affixes to Vorax Gear. Use Special Organs to add Ultimate affixes to Vorax Gear. Use Core Organs and Sutures to add Legendary affixes to Vorax Gear.
Vorax Corrosion increases the tier of Vorax Gear affixes, potentially increasing all pre-fixes and suffixes by 1 - 2 tiers.

rows.season|season_des|851:
Season Background
Unfold a piece of cold Snowpaper and apply colorful Paint to the white snow.
Breathe life into everything as you fill in the snowy landscape with colors.
Eventually, the empty frozen canvas becomes a vibrant work of art.
After the last brush falls, the painter also becomes part of the painting.
What magnificent scenery awaits the one who created the world on this frozen canvas and entered it?

New Gameplay
After collecting Snowpaper Fragments in the Netherrealm, Hunters will select a difficulty and consume these fragments to unfold the canvas. After the canvas is unfolded, Hunters will need to defeat monsters in Netherrealm stages of the corresponding difficulty to collect various colors and types of Paint.
Hunters will need to place the corresponding Paints in the appropriate areas according to the Coloring Paint instructions, upgrade the Paints, and obtain new Coloring Paints until the canvas is completed.
After the painting is completed, Hunters can enter the frozen canvas of their painting to challenge monsters created from paint and the gameplay to get Splendor Eggs containing various rewards.

New Development System
Several Exclusive Support Skills have been added for most Active Skills, increasing the damage dealt by these skills and changing their form, giving them many unexpected amazing effects that will enrich Hunters' combat experience.
Collect Exclusive Support Skills and Inspiration Essences that are used to upgrade skills from the Frozen Canvas gameplay to create more powerful, more diverse, and more creative new builds.

rows.season|season_des|641:
Season Background
I am lost within the mist.
I cannot find my way back.
Who extinguished my lantern? Who's calling out my name?
I break the hands of the Clock Tower and tear open the mist.
Then, I saw you.
At that time, I was still you.

New Gameplay
Defeat the Mistville "Residents" in the Netherrealm and journey to Mistville. Dispel the mist with Sanity and face various random events to eventually arrive at the Clock Tower. Complete Advent of Folklores in the Clock Tower to receive a Chest of Folklores that contains various rewards. After that, Hunters must welcome a new day from the bench.
Hunters will find all kinds of Food and Old Stuff while exploring Mistville. Use them well to change your exploration experience and even increase drop quantity.
The new season features brand new Season Talents. Hunters must collect Mistville Intel to gradually unlock these Talents and make exploring Mistville easier than ever.

New Development System
The new season features a batch of brand new skills called Activation Medium Skills. They are often closely linked to auto-triggering, allowing them to significantly simplify gameplay and improve your experience.
Hunters can obtain various Activation Medium Skills from Whispering Mist, and use them to create new, surprising, and powerful builds.

rows.collection|unlocked_text|31501:
I still remember how grand the gold city was. Followers were coming and going to the queen's court, kissing the toes of her statues and praying that she would lay her finger on their worthless lives until the dragon flew next to the eternal sun, and the sky became nothing but dusk. The dragon's breath ignited the dying artificial sun, making it lose its eternal shape. Then the winged birds fell like rain, humans the beasts ran for their lives as the scorching gold made them gold statues with flesh inside.

The gold covered the dragon as well, but the dragon's death and waiting of a thousand years couldn't subside its malice. The strong power inside its body always wants to break out. It's been a thousand years. The eternal faith of fighting for the Queen let me and other numerous Ichi warriors have an undying soul. We guarded the abyss border and fought with the Shadowborn born from the dragon's rotten flesh.

Now the Queen has returned, and the eternal sun has risen again, but I didn't gain strength from its radiance like what happened before. The sun's radiance is no longer pure gold, and its impurities are rotting our will. The Shadowborn even gains some kind of nourishment from it.

I wrote this in the hope of telling whoever is reading that we had fought with the evil dragon's Shadowborn, then our comrades, and finally the rotten will of ourselves. We couldn't even suicide to clear our minds. How should a soul that has been dead for a thousand years be relieved? This is not a battle. There's no enemy, spoil, blood, or glory, only shadows from the past and overdrawn eternity. How I wish to close my eyes and wake up in a nightmare! That would be an endless ecstasy...

In general, the base rate is applied to all Pactspirits. For Rate Up and Minimum Guarantee, the rates are subject to actual rules.
[Boon Rules]
The base rate of acquiring a Legendary Pactspirits is 1.500%. If you fail to obtain any Legendary Pactspirit after 50 Boons, the next Boon's rate of yielding a Legendary Pactspirit will be increased from 1.500% to 3.000%, and if this Boon doesn't yield a Legendary Pactspirit either, then the chance of obtaining a Legendary Pactspirit with the next Boon will be increased from 3.000% to 4.500%. This process repeats itself with a 1.500% rate increase for every Boon until the rate of acquiring a Legendary Pactspirit reaches 100.000%. Once a Legendary Pactspirit is obtained, the next Boon's chance will be reset to the base rate.

For every 10 Boons, at least 1 Pactspirit that is Rare or better is guaranteed.

[Rate Ups]
When the PYO (Pick-Your-Own) feature is enabled, you can pick a designated amount of Pactspirits in the Pactspirit List to get a 100.000% chance to obtain the Pactspirits you picked (if you picked multiple Pactspirits, they will share the chance equally).

[Duplicate Pactspirits]
When you receive Duplicate Pactspirits, they will be converted into a certain amount of Pactspirit Proofs. Surplus Proofs can be traded for Insight Essence at the in-game shop.

[Boon Item List]
Legendary Pactspirits Base Rate: 1.500%
Rare Pactspirits Base Rate: 12.000%
Magic Pactspirits Base Rate: 86.500%
The Legendary Pactspirit Azure Gunslinger will only appear in this Boon and will not be available in any other Boon.

rows.manual_rule_des|des|1002000320:
<RichText>Ignite deals Fire Damage Over Time and has a default duration of 4s.
When inflicted on an enemy, Ignite deals Fire Damage Over Time equal to the Base Ignite Damage every second to the target.
By default, the maximum number of Ignite stacks is 1 but can be upgraded later. When multiple Ignite effects act on a unit simultaneously, the N (Ignite Stack Limit) stacks of Ignite with the highest damage will take effect.
After reaching max stacks of Ignite, the duration of Ignite effects that deal more damage will not be affected by subsequently inflicted Ignite effects that deal less damage.</>

rows.manual_rule_des|des|1002000120:
<RichText>Ailments include the following 6 types:
Ignite: A negative effect that deals Fire Damage Over Time.
Frostbite: A negative effect that slows enemies.
Freeze: A negative effect that is inflicted at 100 Frostbite Rating.
Shock: A negative effect that makes subsequent hits deal additional Secondary Lightning Damage.
Numbed: A negative effect that increases the damage taken by enemies.
Trauma: A negative effect that deals Physical Damage Over Time.
Wilt: A negative effect that deals Erosion Damage Over Time.
Ailments are generally inflicted by hits.</>

rows.gacha|des|6002:
In general, the base rate is applied to all Pactspirits. For Rate Up and Minimum Guarantee, the rates are subject to actual rules.
[Boon Rules]
The base rate of acquiring a Legendary Pactspirits is 1.500%. If you fail to obtain any Legendary Pactspirit after 50 Boons, the next Boon's rate of yielding a Legendary Pactspirit will be increased from 1.500% to 3.000%, and if this Boon doesn't yield a Legendary Pactspirit either, then the chance of obtaining a Legendary Pactspirit with the next Boon will be increased from 3.000% to 4.500%. This process repeats itself with a 1.500% rate increase for every Boon until the rate of acquiring a Legendary Pactspirit reaches 100.000%. Once a Legendary Pactspirit is obtained, the next Boon's chance will be reset to the base rate.

For every 10 Boons, at least 1 Pactspirit that is Rare or better is guaranteed.

[Rate Ups]
When the PYO (Pick-Your-Own) feature is enabled, you can pick a designated amount of Pactspirits in the Pactspirit List to get a 50.000% chance to obtain the Pactspirits you picked (if you picked multiple Pactspirits, they will share the chance equally). If that doesn't get you a Pactspirit you picked after getting 1 Legendary Pactspirit, the next Legendary Pactspirit you get from Boons is guaranteed to be a Pactspirit you picked. The count will be reset once a Pactspirit you picked is obtained.

[Duplicate Pactspirits]
When you receive Duplicate Pactspirits, they will be converted into a certain amount of Pactspirit Proofs. Surplus Proofs can be traded for Insight Essence at the in-game shop

[Boon Item List]
Legendary Pactspirits Base Rate: 1.500%
Rare Pactspirits Base Rate: 12.000%, Letice - Withered Leaf and Hell Cavalry - Twilight's base rates are double the base rate of other Rare Pactspirits
Magic Pactspirits Base Rate: 86.500%, Shocket - Green Leaf and Awooawoo - Blue Sky's base rates are double the base rate of other Magic Pactspirits
The Legendary Pactspirits Captain Kitty of the Furious Sea / Backup Power will only appear in this Boon and will not be available in any other Boon.

There is a certain chance to deal a Critical Strike when dealing hit damage.
Final Critical Strike Rating = Base Critical Strike Rating x (100 + all non-additional bonuses)% x (100 + additional bonus 1)% x (100 + additional bonus 2)%...
Critical Hit Chance = Final Critical Strike Rating/100
When attacking, the base Critical Strike Rating of the weapon will be factored in when calculating the Critical Strike Rating of the skill.
When casting a spell, the base Critical Strike Rating of the spell will be factored in when calculating the Critical Strike Rating of the skill.

rows.system_help|description|14:
1. In the stage affected by Void Pirates, some monsters will drop Void Sea Flames when they are defeated. Void Sea Seal will appear after the stage is completed.

2. Place Void Sea Flames into the Void Sea Seal to lure over Void Pirates. Defeat 3 waves of Void Pirates to reveal 3 Seal Whispers.

3. Different Void Sea Flames have different effects. Some make Void Pirates give additional drops, while others affect the type of Seal Whisper that is revealed after defeating Void Pirates.

4. The number of monsters that can drop Void Seas Flames increases with the difficulty of the stage, and monsters will only drop Gold Void Sea Flames in Netherrealm stages played at Timemark 7 and Timemark 8.

5. If there are unselected Seal Whispers when a Void Sea Flame is placed into the Void Sea Seal or the Void Sea Terminal is already open, the additional Void Sea Flame effects selected this time will not take effect, and the drop results of Void Sea Flames in the stage at this Timemark will not change.

rows.season|season_window2|1101:
New Gameplay
Hijack TOWER Transport Vehicles in the Netherrealm and chase down the escort bodyguards who are fleeing with the payload and take down their reinforcements within a limited time.
Break into the heavily guarded TOWER Co. and blast open vaults to loot as much treasure as you can!

New Upgrade System
Craft a TOWER Sequence for non-Legendary weapons and shields. During the crafting process, you'll get to choose from several chips of random colors in each round. If the colors of the chips you chose match the target sequence (in any order) after all selections have been made, you'll obtain the effects of the target sequence.

rows.collection|unlocked_text|31203: The ancient Ichi lived in such an extravagant way that it was as if they were going to die tomorrow, yet they built things endlessly as if they were going to live forever. Such contradiction is reflected in this magnificent arena. Its walls, ceilings and columns were built with gold, yet blood spilled everywhere I stood.\n\nAbsurdity came to pass. The Queen and her people rose an artificial sun, longing to eternize the moments like they did the days. The sun fell, and the golden arena melted in all directions, and all were turn into amber cast in gold, frozen in this moment forever. The very thing they once desired most led to the ultimate tragedy. Hot liquid gold still pours from the earth now and then, washing over the wailing souls here.

Ignite deals Fire DoT with a default duration of 4s.
After Igniting an enemy, Fire Damage equal to the Base Ignite Damage is dealt to the target every second.
By default, Ignite has the following effect: "+30% additional Affliction effect".
The default maximum number of Ignite Damage stacks is 1. This can be increased by upgrading the maximum number of stacks later. When a unit is under the effect of more than 1 Ignite effect, the first N (Ignite limit) stacks of Ignite that deal the most damage will take effect.

rows.handbook|description|10180:
Blocking is a defensive mechanic that counteracts Hit and Reflected damage. When taking Hit or Reflected damage, whether this damage is blocked will be determined based on the Attack or Spell tags of the source of this damage and the hero's corresponding Attack and Spell Block Chance. When blocking successfully, the damage will be reduced based on the Block Ratio and additional damage blocked.

Heroes start with 0 Block Chance. The Block Chance includes the Attack Block Chance and Spell Block Chance. When taking damage, the corresponding tag is applied to determine whether the block is successful or not. The Block Chance from different sources can be stacked up to the maximum Block Chance of 100%
Relevant Stats
Block Chance %
Attack Block Chance %
Spell Block Chance %
Heroes start with a Block Ratio of 35% by default, which can be increased up to 75%. After a successful block is determined, a corresponding amount of damage will be offset according to the Block Ratio.
Heroes do not have additional damage blocked by default. When both Block Ratio and a fixed Block Chance are available, the Block Ratio is factored into the calculation before the fixed Block Chance
Relevant Stats
Block Ratio %
Additional Damage Blocked

rows.collection|unlocked_text|20002:
Keegan, Vicar Bishop August 31, Sunny

Today I left the Cathedral and started my first day in the Sanctuary of Dawn.

My old colleagues laughed at me for being "old and insane", but they didn't mean anything to me.

Three days ago, Keegan once again turned down my "Feasibility Analysis of Curing the Disqualified with Ember Components", and accused me of incompetency and "harming the Church using the Disqualified".

If only the Arcbishop wasn't so ill, Keegan wouldn't dare to be so arrogant.

No one spoke for me except Romer, the Knight of Commandments.

Arcbishop Derrick adopted him, and saw him as the future leader of all Knights of Commandments.

Thanks to Romer, I was only sent to the Sanctuary of Dawn instead of being exiled.

When I opened my luggage and put them under the sun, Romer came to the Sanctuary and told me that he completely agreed with me. The light should never be a privilege for the selected few, and the Disqualified also had the same right to redemption.

Honestly, he was one of the only few men of justice in the Church.

I will continue to stay in the Sanctuary and look for a way to save the Disqualified.


September 2, Overcast & Storm

My research wasn't going well. After some debating, I took my savings and went to the Disciple's Alleys.

A young Disqualified girl rode her motorbike off the wall, almost scaring me to death. Somehow, she managed to stop right in front of me without making any noise.

After hearing my request for the cheapest Ember component, she burst out into laughter for no reason. I was pissed off, but she soon stopped laughing and grabbed my money bag, then threw it back.

"Pay me later!"

She soon disappeared in the night.

Shocked, I stood there until the heavy rain completely soaked me.


September 3, Sunny

When I tried to dry my wet blanket from the leaked roof, that Disqualified girl leaped off the roof and walked blatantly to me.

I was frightened and immediately took her to the back of my house. 

"Hey, old man! Look! Your Ember components!" She tried to lower her voice but I could still feel the joy in her words.

She tossed me a very full bag. My hands were shaking when I opened it. I saw all sorts of Ember components, both new and old. My heart was racing fast, and I had to act calm and picked the oldest one of them. Unlike those filthy rich guys in the church, I had no money to waste.

I counted my gold coins from my wallet, then the girl gladly whispered and jumped onto the walls, disappearing among the white bricks.


September 6, Sunny

After studying the Ember component for a few days, I had completely understood how it worked.

An "Ember component" was made from engraving fixed patterns on a thin piece of Ember Crystal. It was said that these gadgets could awaken and amplify the Ember power within Disqualified, and eventually turning it into a fancy "move".

I carved a component named "Firebolt" and tried to feel it in my hand, but all I felt was a little warmth.

I improved the pattern and made some new Ember components.

Hope they can find their real owner.
rows.season|season_des|1431:
Season Background
The story begins with a legend from a time long forgotten.
"Once, in an age beyond memory, there lived a race that called the moon their home.
They were masters of song and dance. Every part of their being resonated like a fine instrument, producing melodies of sublime beauty.
But when the moon fell from the heavens, they turned into cold stone-statues scattered to the four winds.
It is said that these statues will awaken once more when the bright moon shines again. They will join you in a symphony of the full moon, offering treasures long lost to time.
So, Traveler, strum the Lunar Strings.
Call the moon to its zenith, turn the moonlight into song, and uncover the secrets sleeping inside the stone.
Tonight-let's shine together."

New Gameplay
Step into an area teeming with Lunar Stone Statues. Place the Lunar Ring at your feet to encompass as many statues as possible and Strum the Lunar Harp to awaken them, then take them down to earn instant drop rewards. The more statues you wake in one strum, the higher your Combo count, which results in greater Drop Quantity bonuses-and greater loot.
Lunar Omen events will appear at random, bringing both challenges and generous rewards. Fortunate Hunters may even stumble upon the game-changing Rhapsody gameplay-a twist that reshapes the "rhythm" you play and delivers a bountiful run you won't forget.
Install your Lunar Harp with various Lunar Strings to customize bonus effects and select the playstyle that perfectly matches your rhythm.

New Development System
Memory Revival is a crafting method that imbues Hero Memories with special powers.
Revival grants various effects to Hero Memories, increasing the values of their base affixes, upgrading Fixed Affixes, giving them special random affixes, and even adding a powerful Revived Affix.
Revived Affixes even include 1 or more unique Hero Trait Affixes tailored to each hero.

rows.system_help|description|40:
R&D can be performed on non-Legendary weapons in the TOWER Sequence system. To perform R&D, Hunters must spend a set number of Mods.
Once initiated, each round presents a random selection of colored Chips to choose from. If the selected Chip colors (in any order) match a target sequence, the R&D succeeds, granting the weapon the corresponding effects. If the colors do not match any sequence, the R&D fails.
There are 2 types of R&D: Basic R&D and In-Depth R&D. Basic R&D only requires Hunters to choose 3 Chips, whereas In-Depth R&D requires Hunters to choose 4. Basic R&D only yields Intermediate sequences. Advanced sequences can only be obtained from In-Depth R&D. Each weapon can only have 1 sequence, but Hunters can perform R&D repeatedly until the desired target sequence is obtained.
Materials consumed by R&D will not be returned if R&D is interrupted.

rows.season|season_des|401:
Season Background
Legend has it that in our homeland, the eternal, invincible realm. The very barren, tainted land the world called Aeterna. Boundless riches and the secret of immortality are buried beneath the ruined facade. Our people wandered among the dense mist and broken walls, awaiting eternal grace. When candlelight burns again, the city that fell a thousand times shall be rebuilt, and the people who fell a thousand times shall stand once more. And who shall venture into the eternal Aeterna? Hunters who are destined to trample the myriad ruins of the Aeterna, yet refuse to yield to eternity. I see you treading toward the innermost candlelight.

New Gameplay
Interact with the Monument of Aeterna to enter the edge of Aeterna-the Ruins of Aeterna. In the ruins, Hunters must kindle candelabra in the allotted time for prizes and obtain a Mark of the Ruins that has the condition of all candelabra recorded on it.
Hunters must obtain more Marks of the Ruins and cover the map of Aeterna to rebuild the city. Once the city is rebuilt, its roads, landscape, and rewards will change. So, it brings a whole new experience each time it's rebuilt.
The new season features a brand new Major Season Talent. Gradually unlock all talents to obtain massive buffs and bonus rewards, expand the map of the city, and ultimately unlock the Infinite City of Aeterna.
After the Infinite City of Aeterna is unlocked, every time you clear the city will push it one step closer to reaching true eternity, making it even more dangerous. As the city becomes more dangerous, there will be more rewards too, and there's no limit to the city's tier.
The Lone King of Aeterna, a new supreme boss, is featured in the new season. He waits at the end of Aeterna, stoically watching everything you do in the city. When you dare usurp Aeterna, he will slay you without mercy.

New Development System
You will get a brand new item, Soul Candle, when exploring the city. You need to equip Soul Candles in the Skill panel. And they will nourish your soul and significantly improve skill effects.
A Soul Candle usually has 1 to 3 affixes of random tiers, but you can fuse them to upgrade, evolve, or even mutate their affixes.
Soul Candle Fusion, a new development system, has been added to the season. You can acquire a special item, Tear of Aeterna, from monsters in the city. By spending Tears of Aeterna, you can fuse two Soul Candles.
When fusing Soul Candles, affixes of identical effects and tiers from the two Soul Candles will be fused into one, and the remaining affixes will be either retained or discarded randomly.
When both Soul Candles have the same T1 affixes, the fused affix has a chance of evolving into a more powerful T0 affix with one guaranteed negative affix, and any T0 affix of the fused Soul Candle has a small chance of mutating into a rare, special affix.
Mutated affixes are very powerful, however, they can also have serious negative impacts on you. Therefore, you must balance the power and the negative effects brought by Soul Candles by making the most of the positive affixes and avoiding the negative affixes, using the potent but dangerous Soul Candles to your advantage.

rows.system_help|description|29:
1. This is the Mistville exploration screen. Hunters must dispel the thick mist at the cost of their Sanity, unveiling the obscured Cells and seeking out the Clock Tower to welcome a new day.

2. Cells available for exploration will have a Sanity cost indicator on them, denoting the amount of Sanity Hunters need to spend to explore them. When Sanity runs out, the current gameplay round will end.

3.Each Cell houses a variety of elements, from Sanatoriums to Banks and Alchemy Workshops, each with its distinct purpose. To discover what a Cell has to offer, simply click on "View Cell Effect" or click and hold the Cell.

4. On odd-numbered days, Hunters will face the eerie Advent of Folklores within the Clock Tower. Overcoming the Folklores' challenges will reward Hunters with a Chest of Folklores that contains various types of rewards. Upon opening a Chest of Folklores, a bench will appear. Interact with the bench, and a new day will begin. Furthermore, completing the Advent of Folklores within the allotted time replenishes a portion of your Sanity.

5. On even-numbered days, interacting with the Clock Tower replenishes a portion of your Sanity and begins a new day directly.

6. As you traverse through various Cells, you can obtain a variety of Old Stuff and Food that can alter your exploration experience. Old Stuff will remain effective throughout your exploration, while Food items will be available in limited quantities.

rows.gacha|des|11001:
In general, the base rate is applied to all Pactspirits. For Rate Up and Minimum Guarantee, the rates are subject to actual rules.
[Boon Rules]
The base rate of acquiring a Legendary Pactspirits is 1.500%. If you fail to obtain any Legendary Pactspirit after 50 Boons, the next Boon's rate of yielding a Legendary Pactspirit will be increased from 1.500% to 3.000%, and if this Boon doesn't yield a Legendary Pactspirit either, then the chance of obtaining a Legendary Pactspirit with the next Boon will be increased from 3.000% to 4.500%. This process repeats itself with a 1.500% rate increase for every Boon until the rate of acquiring a Legendary Pactspirit reaches 100.000%. Once a Legendary Pactspirit is obtained, the next Boon's chance will be reset to the base rate.

After this Boon ends, should it return in a future season, its draw attempts will be retained. If added to the Past Memories, the draw attempts will be reset.

For every 10 Boons, at least 1 Pactspirit that is Rare or better is guaranteed.

[Rate Ups]
When the PYO (Pick-Your-Own) feature is enabled, you can pick a designated amount of Pactspirits in the Pactspirit List to get a 50.000% chance to obtain the Pactspirits you picked (if you picked multiple Pactspirits, they will share the chance equally). If that doesn't get you a Pactspirit you picked after getting 1 Legendary Pactspirit, the next Legendary Pactspirit you get from Boons is guaranteed to be a Pactspirit you picked. The count will be reset once a Pactspirit you picked is obtained.

[Duplicate Pactspirits]
When you receive Duplicate Pactspirits, they will be converted into a certain amount of Pactspirit Proofs. Surplus Proofs can be traded for Insight Essence at the in-game shop

[Boon Item List]
Legendary Pactspirits Base Rate: 1.500%
Rare Pactspirits Base Rate: 12.000%.
Magic Pactspirits Base Rate: 86.500%.
The Legendary Pactspirit Prof. SOURCE will only appear in this Boon and will not be available in any other Boon. The season-exclusive gameplay of the season-exclusive Pactspirit will be added to the Season Rotation Pool once the season comes to an end. And the chances of that season-exclusive gameplay appearing in the next season will be reduced. The exclusive Pactspirit is only available in the current pool.
The exclusive Pactspirit's effects remain valid permanently.

rows.gacha|des|38001:
In general, the base rate is applied to all Pactspirits. For Rate Up and Minimum Guarantee, the rates are subject to actual rules.
[Boon Rules]
The base rate of acquiring a Legendary Pactspirits is 1.500%. If you fail to obtain any Legendary Pactspirit after 50 Boons, the next Boon's rate of yielding a Legendary Pactspirit will be increased from 1.500% to 3.000%, and if this Boon doesn't yield a Legendary Pactspirit either, then the chance of obtaining a Legendary Pactspirit with the next Boon will be increased from 3.000% to 4.500%. This process repeats itself with a 1.500% rate increase for every Boon until the rate of acquiring a Legendary Pactspirit reaches 100.000%. Once a Legendary Pactspirit is obtained, the next Boon's chance will be reset to the base rate.

For every 10 Boons, at least 1 Pactspirit that is Rare or better is guaranteed.

[Rate Ups]
When the PYO (Pick-Your-Own) feature is enabled, you can pick a designated amount of Pactspirits in the Pactspirit List to get a 50.000% chance to obtain the Pactspirits you picked (if you picked multiple Pactspirits, they will share the chance equally). If that doesn't get you a Pactspirit you picked after getting 1 Legendary Pactspirit, the next Legendary Pactspirit you get from Boons is guaranteed to be a Pactspirit you picked. The count will be reset once a Pactspirit you picked is obtained.

[Duplicate Pactspirits]
When you receive Duplicate Pactspirits, they will be converted into a certain amount of Pactspirit Proofs. Surplus Proofs can be traded for Insight Essence at the in-game shop

[Boon Item List]
Legendary Pactspirits Base Rate: 1.500%
Rare Pactspirits Base Rate: 12.000%. When obtaining a Rare Pactspirit, there is a 30% chance it will be Dragon Plant - Lettuce
Magic Pactspirits Base Rate: 86.500%. When obtaining a Magic Pactspirit, there is a 30% chance it will be Feasting Samurai - Mint
The Legendary Pactspirit Rainbowpaint Owl will only appear in this Boon and will not be available in any other Boon. The season-exclusive gameplay of the season-exclusive Pactspirit will be added to the Season Rotation Pool A once the season comes to an end. And the chances of that season-exclusive gameplay appearing in the next season will be reduced. The exclusive Pactspirit is only available in the current pool.
The exclusive Pactspirit's effects remain valid permanently.

rows.gacha|des|2002:
In general, the base rate is applied to all Pactspirits. For Rate Up and Minimum Guarantee, the rates are subject to actual rules.
[Boon Rules]
The base rate of acquiring a Legendary Pactspirits is 1.500%. If you fail to obtain any Legendary Pactspirit after 50 Boons, the next Boon's rate of yielding a Legendary Pactspirit will be increased from 1.500% to 2%, and if this Boon doesn't yield a Legendary Pactspirit either, then the chance of obtaining a Legendary Pactspirit with the next Boon will be increased from 3.000% to 4.500%. This process repeats itself with a 1.500% rate increase for every Boon until the rate of acquiring a Legendary Pactspirit reaches 100.000%. Once a Legendary Pactspirit is obtained, the next Boon's chance will be reset to the base rate.

For every 10 Boons, at least 1 Pactspirit that is Rare or better is guaranteed.

[Rate Ups]
When the PYO (Pick-Your-Own) feature is enabled, you can pick a designated amount of Pactspirits in the Pactspirit List to get a 33.000% chance to obtain the Pactspirits you picked (if you picked multiple Pactspirits, they will share the chance equally). If that doesn't get you a Pactspirit you picked after getting 2 Legendary Pactspirits, the next Legendary Pactspirit you get from Boons is guaranteed to be a Pactspirit you picked. The count will be reset once a Pactspirit you picked is obtained.

[Duplicate Pactspirits]
When you receive Duplicate Pactspirits, they will be converted into a certain amount of Pactspirit Proofs. Surplus Proofs can be traded for Insight Essence at the in-game shop

[Boon Item List]
Legendary Pactspirits Base Rate: 1.500%
Rare Pactspirits Base Rate: 12.000%
Magic Pactspirits Base Rate: 86.500%
The Legendary Pactspirits, Melting Flames/Ice Puppet/Bitter Thunder will only appear in this Boon and will not be available in any other Boon.

rows.system_help|description|6:
Intro:
1. The Path of Progression contains a set of goals that span the entire game cycle, helping Hunters to have a better understanding of each section of the game.
2. These goals are tied to seasons and can be accomplished by any character within that season.
3. Path of Progression rewards are Account Level rewards that are divided into first rewards and regular rewards. Any character under the current account can receive the first reward when completing goals in Path of Progression for the first time. Upon completing Path of Progression goals again in subsequent seasons, regular rewards can be claimed instead. All rewards claimed in subsequent seasons after claiming the first reward are regular rewards.
4. The rewards and goals of Path of Progression will be reset every season. Due to seasonal content updates, the goals and rewards in future seasons may be adjusted.

rows.gacha|des|36001:
In general, the base rate is applied to all Pactspirits. For Rate Up and Minimum Guarantee, the rates are subject to actual rules.
[Boon Rules]
The base rate of acquiring a Legendary Pactspirits is 1.500%. If you fail to obtain any Legendary Pactspirit after 50 Boons, the next Boon's rate of yielding a Legendary Pactspirit will be increased from 1.500% to 3.000%, and if this Boon doesn't yield a Legendary Pactspirit either, then the chance of obtaining a Legendary Pactspirit with the next Boon will be increased from 3.000% to 4.500%. This process repeats itself with a 1.500% rate increase for every Boon until the rate of acquiring a Legendary Pactspirit reaches 100.000%. Once a Legendary Pactspirit is obtained, the next Boon's chance will be reset to the base rate.

For every 10 Boons, at least 1 Pactspirit that is Rare or better is guaranteed.

[Rate Ups]
When the PYO (Pick-Your-Own) feature is enabled, you can pick a designated amount of Pactspirits in the Pactspirit List to get a 50.000% chance to obtain the Pactspirits you picked (if you picked multiple Pactspirits, they will share the chance equally). If that doesn't get you a Pactspirit you picked after getting 1 Legendary Pactspirit, the next Legendary Pactspirit you get from Boons is guaranteed to be a Pactspirit you picked. The count will be reset once a Pactspirit you picked is obtained.

[Duplicate Pactspirits]
When you receive Duplicate Pactspirits, they will be converted into a certain amount of Pactspirit Proofs. Surplus Proofs can be traded for Insight Essence at the in-game shop

[Boon Item List]
Legendary Pactspirits Base Rate: 1.500%
Rare Pactspirits Base Rate: 12.000%. When obtaining a Rare Pactspirit, there is a 30% chance it will be First Mate of the Furious Sea - Silent Night
Magic Pactspirits Base Rate: 86.500%. When obtaining a Magic Pactspirit, there is a 30% chance it will be Happy Chonky - Violet
The Legendary Pactspirit Mistville Orphan will only appear in this Boon and will not be available in any other Boon. The season-exclusive gameplay of the season-exclusive Pactspirit will be added to the Season Rotation Pool once the season comes to an end. And the chances of that season-exclusive gameplay appearing in the next season will be reduced. The exclusive Pactspirit is only available in the current pool.
The exclusive Pactspirit's effects remain valid permanently.

rows.season|season_des|1122:
Season Background
TOWER Co. is a megacorporation entrenched in Leptis. Originally founded as an arms factory of the old empire, it has managed to evolve into today's colossal conglomerate through Synthetic Troop technology.
In recent years, TOWER Co. has monopolized key resources, technologies, and basic infrastructure, as well as built a powerful private army for itself.
Under its oppression, righteous outlaws have risen up and become the vanguard against TOWER Co.
Outlaws, listen up! How'd you like to pull off a real robbery?

New Gameplay
TOWER Co.'s Transport Vehicles sit vulnerable in the Netherrealm-loaded with vault-bound riches.
In Carjack, the escort bodyguards will flee in waves with TOWER Supply Caches. You will need to chase them down and defeat their reinforcements within the time limit.
The more escort bodyguards you take down, the bigger your payout.
But don't take too long, because the Transport Vehicles and all security personnel might flee the scene if you do.
Before a Carjack, there's a chance that the Fixer from the Black Market will issue a Bounty Order. You can pay the required amount of TOWER Coins to accept the bounty and complete it to earn additional bounty rewards.
If hijacking convoys is too easy for you, it's time to hit TOWER Co. itself!
TOWER Co. Central Vault is the ultimate endgame challenge of the Outlaw season. Inside this heavily fortified complex, you'll find multiple secure strongrooms-raid as many as you can handle before time runs out, take down the vault's guardian boss, and claim the ultimate strongroom's legendary rewards.

New Upgrade System
R&D can be performed on non-Legendary weapons in the TOWER Sequence system to obtain powerful TOWER Sequences.
To perform R&D, Hunters must spend a set number of Mods. During R&D, Hunters can choose from several chips of random colors in each round. If the colors of the chips you chose match the target sequence (in any order) after all selections have been made, you'll obtain the effects of the target sequence.
There are 2 types of R&D: Basic R&D and In-Depth R&D.
Basic R&D only yields Basic sequences and Intermediate sequences. Advanced sequences can only be obtained from In-Depth R&D. Each weapon can only have 1 sequence, but Hunters can perform R&D repeatedly until the desired target sequence is obtained.
TOWER sequences grant Hunters regular stats and provide core mechanics that can inspire many fantastic builds.

rows.gacha|des|8001:
In general, the base rate is applied to all Pactspirits. For Rate Up and Minimum Guarantee, the rates are subject to actual rules.
[Boon Rules]
The base rate of acquiring a Legendary Pactspirits is 1.500%. If you fail to obtain any Legendary Pactspirit after 50 Boons, the next Boon's rate of yielding a Legendary Pactspirit will be increased from 1.500% to 3.000%, and if this Boon doesn't yield a Legendary Pactspirit either, then the chance of obtaining a Legendary Pactspirit with the next Boon will be increased from 3.000% to 4.500%. This process repeats itself with a 1.500% rate increase for every Boon until the rate of acquiring a Legendary Pactspirit reaches 100.000%. Once a Legendary Pactspirit is obtained, the next Boon's chance will be reset to the base rate.

For every 10 Boons, at least 1 Pactspirit that is Rare or better is guaranteed.

[Rate Ups]
When the PYO (Pick-Your-Own) feature is enabled, you can pick a designated amount of Pactspirits in the Pactspirit List to get a 50.000% chance to obtain the Pactspirits you picked (if you picked multiple Pactspirits, they will share the chance equally). If that doesn't get you a Pactspirit you picked after getting 1 Legendary Pactspirit, the next Legendary Pactspirit you get from Boons is guaranteed to be a Pactspirit you picked. The count will be reset once a Pactspirit you picked is obtained.

[Duplicate Pactspirits]
When you receive Duplicate Pactspirits, they will be converted into a certain amount of Pactspirit Proofs. Surplus Proofs can be traded for Insight Essence at the in-game shop

[Boon Item List]
Legendary Pactspirits Base Rate: 1.500%
Rare Pactspirits Base Rate: 12.000%. When obtaining a Rare Pactspirit, there is a 30% chance it will be Dragon Plant - Lettuce
Magic Pactspirits Base Rate: 86.500%. When obtaining a Magic Pactspirit, there is a 30% chance it will be Feasting Samurai - Mint
The Legendary Pactspirit Rainbowpaint Owl will only appear in this Boon and will not be available in any other Boon. The season-exclusive gameplay of the season-exclusive Pactspirit will be added to the Season Rotation Pool A once the season comes to an end. And the chances of that season-exclusive gameplay appearing in the next season will be reduced. The exclusive Pactspirit is only available in the current pool.
The exclusive Pactspirit's effects remain valid permanently.

rows.gacha|des|10002:
In general, the base rate is applied to all Pactspirits. For Rate Up and Minimum Guarantee, the rates are subject to actual rules.
[Boon Rules]
The base rate of acquiring a Legendary Pactspirits is 1.500%. If you fail to obtain any Legendary Pactspirit after 50 Boons, the next Boon's rate of yielding a Legendary Pactspirit will be increased from 1.500% to 3.000%, and if this Boon doesn't yield a Legendary Pactspirit either, then the chance of obtaining a Legendary Pactspirit with the next Boon will be increased from 3.000% to 4.500%. This process repeats itself with a 1.500% rate increase for every Boon until the rate of acquiring a Legendary Pactspirit reaches 100.000%. Once a Legendary Pactspirit is obtained, the next Boon's chance will be reset to the base rate.

For every 10 Boons, at least 1 Pactspirit that is Rare or better is guaranteed.

[Rate Ups]
When the PYO (Pick-Your-Own) feature is enabled, you can pick a designated amount of Pactspirits in the Pactspirit List to get a 100.000% chance to obtain the Pactspirits you picked (if you picked multiple Pactspirits, they will share the chance equally).

[Duplicate Pactspirits]
When you receive Duplicate Pactspirits, they will be converted into a certain amount of Pactspirit Proofs. Surplus Proofs can be traded for Insight Essence at the in-game shop.

[Boon Item List]
Legendary Pactspirits Base Rate: 1.500%
Rare Pactspirits Base Rate: 12.000%, Benign Bug - Ghost Light Yellow's base rate is double the base rate of other Rare Pactspirits
Magic Pactspirits Base Rate: 86.500%, Sprouting Grass - Green Porcelain's base rate is double the base rate of other Magic Pactspirits
The Legendary Pactspirit Portrait of a Fallen Saintess will only appear in this Boon and will not be available in any other Boon.

rows.system_help|description|16:
1. A certain amount of Desire Crystals is consumed every time you make demands on the Cube.

2. The rewards claimed from the Cube need to be manually claimed again on the reward screen to be really obtained. Claiming the Cube's rewards will destroy the Cube and forcibly end the current round.

3. The Cube is only active in the current round. All the Cube's content will be reset at the beginning of a new stage.

4. Up to 40 unused Desire Crystals can be carried over to the next stage.

5. When a Cube of Craving is triggered, a Greed button will appear on the reward screen. If Greed is successful, all demanded rewards will be doubled; if Greed fails, the Cube will be destroyed and all rewards will be lost.

You encounter a dog at the end of an alley. The skinny dog has been infected with Mistosis and is basically a bag of bones.

<RichText Id="3103">Critical Strike Rating</><RichText>
When attacking, the base Critical Strike Rating of the weapon will be factored in when calculating the Critical Strike Rating of the skill. When casting a spell, the base Critical Strike Rating of the spell will be factored in when calculating the Critical Strike Rating of the skill.
Final Critical Strike Rating = The sum of Base Critical Strike Rating x (1 + all non-additional bonus percentages) x (1 + additional bonus percentage 1) x (1 + additional bonus percentage 2)...
Critical Hit Chance = Final Critical Strike Rating/100.</>

rows.gacha|des|9003:
In general, the base rate is applied to all Pactspirits. For Rate Up and Minimum Guarantee, the rates are subject to actual rules.
[Boon Rules]
The base rate of acquiring a Legendary Pactspirits is 1.500%. If you fail to obtain any Legendary Pactspirit after 50 Boons, the next Boon's rate of yielding a Legendary Pactspirit will be increased from 1.500% to 3.000%, and if this Boon doesn't yield a Legendary Pactspirit either, then the chance of obtaining a Legendary Pactspirit with the next Boon will be increased from 3.000% to 4.500%. This process repeats itself with a 1.500% rate increase for every Boon until the rate of acquiring a Legendary Pactspirit reaches 100.000%. Once a Legendary Pactspirit is obtained, the next Boon's chance will be reset to the base rate.

For every 10 Boons, at least 1 Pactspirit that is Rare or better is guaranteed.

[Rate Ups]
When the PYO (Pick-Your-Own) feature is enabled, you can pick a designated amount of Pactspirits in the Pactspirit List to get a 50.000% chance to obtain the Pactspirits you picked (if you picked multiple Pactspirits, they will share the chance equally). If that doesn't get you a Pactspirit you picked after getting 1 Legendary Pactspirit, the next Legendary Pactspirit you get from Boons is guaranteed to be a Pactspirit you picked. The count will be reset once a Pactspirit you picked is obtained.

[Duplicate Pactspirits]
When you receive Duplicate Pactspirits, they will be converted into a certain amount of Pactspirit Proofs. Surplus Proofs can be traded for Insight Essence at the in-game shop

[Boon Item List]
Legendary Pactspirits Base Rate: 1.500%

In general, the base rate is applied to all Pactspirits. For Rate Up and Minimum Guarantee, the rates are subject to actual rules.
[Boon Rules]
The base rate of acquiring a Legendary Pactspirits is 1.500%. If you fail to obtain any Legendary Pactspirit after 50 Boons, the next Boon's rate of yielding a Legendary Pactspirit will be increased from 1.500% to 3.000%, and if this Boon doesn't yield a Legendary Pactspirit either, then the chance of obtaining a Legendary Pactspirit with the next Boon will be increased from 3.000% to 4.500%. This process repeats itself with a 1.500% rate increase for every Boon until the rate of acquiring a Legendary Pactspirit reaches 100.000%. Once a Legendary Pactspirit is obtained, the next Boon's chance will be reset to the base rate.

For every 10 Boons, at least 1 Pactspirit that is Rare or better is guaranteed.

[Rate Ups]
When the PYO (Pick-Your-Own) feature is enabled, you can pick a designated amount of Pactspirits in the Pactspirit List to get a 50.000% chance to obtain the Pactspirits you picked when you obtain a Legendary Pactspirit (if you picked multiple Pactspirits, they will share the chance equally). If that doesn't get you a Pactspirit you picked after getting 1 Legendary Pactspirit, the next Legendary Pactspirit you get from Boons is guaranteed to be a Pactspirit you picked. The count will be reset once a Pactspirit you picked is obtained.

[Duplicate Pactspirits]
When you receive Duplicate Pactspirits, they will be converted into a certain amount of Pactspirit Proofs. Surplus Proofs can be traded for Insight Essence at the in-game shop

I found something ridiculous while interpreting ancient Dwarven text. According to it, the Goblins and Ratlins were in fact cursed Dwarfs. I never knew my ancestors were good at telling jokes.

Why would my ancestors deny this simply truth? They claimed Goblins used to be renowned Dwarven heroes who left our people because of a stupid oath. Their betrayal eventually cursed them into ugly, weak Goblins.

How could one believe Goblins were derived from Dwarfs? What nonsense. This joke ain't funny at all.
